sanskrit: virājate jagaccitracitradarpaṇarūpiṇīsvātmacittattvamātramiti bodhanārthamidaṃ prakaraṇamitimāhātmyaṃ tripurākhyāyā yacchruti parasādhanamśrotāramabhimukhayituṃ śrutamityādiyacchrutvā na punaḥ kvāpi manuṣyaḥ śokamṛcchatimahādbhutatvamevāha - yacchrutvetivijñānaṃ samyagālocya yadetat praviniścitamātmatattvaniścāyakopapattijālam [k: tattvaṃ niścā-]mayā śrīdattaguruṇā bhārgavāya nirūpitamtathānyadityarthaḥatroktenāpi no veda yadi kaścidvimūḍhadhīḥvyatirekamukhena draḍhayati - atretina tasya syādapi jñānaṃ sākṣācchivanirūpitamaho satāmadbhutaṃ [k: sattam-] hi vṛttaṃ sarvaguṇottaramśreṣṭhamanugrāhakatā caiṣā satāṃ sahajasambhavāeṣā śuśruṣāevaṃ dattātreyamukhācchrutvā māhātmyavaibhavamdraṣṭavyam]bhaktyāpahṛtasaccittastūṣṇīṃ kiñcid babhūva habhaktyā apahṛtaṃ nilīnaṃ sat śuddhaṃ cittaṃ yasyaromāñcapīvaravapuḥ svāntarānandanirbharaḥtena nirbharaḥ pūrṇaḥpraṇanāma dattaguruṃ daṇḍavaccaraṇāntikeromāñcapīvaravapuriti sambandhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ śrīguro tvatprasādataḥyatprāha - tadevāha - dhanya itiyasmiṃstuṣṭe brahmapadamapi syāt tṛṇasammitammamākāṇḍādeva guruḥ so'dya tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥtoṣaṇīyaḥnātha māhātmyamakhilaṃ śrutaṃ tvatkṛpayādhunāguruṃ pratyāha - nāthetyāditadupāstikramaṃ brūhi mahyaṃ sukṛpayā guroyogyatāṃ tripuropāstau sacchraddhābhaktibṛṃhitāmmantrayantravāsanābhiranvitaṃ [k: tama] nikhilaṃ kramamkramapaddhatiḥ]māditottamaḥ] mattaḥparikramya guruṃ natvā mahendrādrimupāyayauabhūdupāsanaparo varṣadvādaśakaṃ tadāsadā śrītripureśānyā mūrtidhyānaikatatparaḥathaikadā [gh: tatha-] sukhāsīno nāmadagnyo'nucintayattanmayā naiva viditamaṃśenāpi tadā nanujñānammāhātmyaṃ tripurāśakteḥ śrutaṃ śrīguruvaktrataḥpraṣṭuṃ vismṛtammayā sṛṣṭiprasaṅgena pṛṣṭaṃ kiñcid guruṃ prati49-62 ślokeṣu] jñeyamnābravīdaprakṛtatastanme tattādṛśaṃ sthitamkuto nābravīttadāha - aprakṛtata iti | tādṛśam aviditamkasmādidaṃ samuditaṃ jagadāḍambaraṃ mahat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asthiraṃ tu prapaśyāmi sarvaṃ sarvatra kiñcanaasthiraṃ pratikṣaṇapariṇāmicitrāṃ jagadvyavahṛtiṃ prapaśyāmyavimarśinīmavimarśinīmavicāravatīmlokasya vyavahāro vai sarvasyāpyabhilakṣitaḥandhaparamparayaiva vyavahāra ityāha - aho itinūnaṃ mama śaiśave kiṃ jātaṃ tanme na bhāvitamkṛtirvyavahāraḥ | tadevāha - nūnamiti | me mayāidānīmanyathaivāti vyāpāro mama sarvathāyadyatkāle yacca yacca kriyate yena yena vaiphalaṃ kiṃ tatra saṃprāptaṃ kena vā sukhamātmanaḥphalāvaṣṭambhaḥ phalaprāptiniścayaḥna phalaṃ tadahaṃ manye punaryasmāt karoti saḥyacca phalaṃ dhanādi tasyāvicāreṇaiva phalatvamityāha - yaccetiyasmānnityaṃ karotyeva janaḥ sarvaḥ phelehayākartavyaśeṣe no duḥkhanāśo vā sukhameva vāabhāvasyāsato na phalatvaṃ yuktamityāha - sukhaṃ ca vetitatsattve tu kathaṃ te sto duḥkhābhāvaḥ sukhaṃ ca vāsukhaṃ ceti dvetathā kartavyaśeṣasya sukhalābha ihocyateetadeva dṛṣṭāntairupapādayati - yathetyāditathā kartavyaśeṣasya sukhalābha ihocyatetathā kartavyaśeṣasya sukhalābha ihocyatepūrṇāśayā mahātmānaḥ sarvadehasuśītalāḥsarvāṅgaśītalāśca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śūlaprote'pi ca nare syāt sukhaṃ gandhamālyajamkenacid vastramālyādināsukhamastīha yasyārthe karotyeva sadā janaḥanantakartavyaśailākrāntāḥ suakhyaṃ labhanti catathaiva yatate nityamapi bhikṣāṭane rataḥtadyena yānti sarve'pi yāmyahaṃ tānanukramātyenāvicāritena mārgeṇa kramād yānti tānahamanuyāmitadalaṃ medhayānena bhūyo gatvā dayānidhimvicāreṇa saha gatvā | yāvadvicāro na naśyettāvaditi tātparyampāraṃ prapatsye suśubhaṃ guruvākplavamāśritaḥpratasthe tadgirivarād gurudarśanakāṅkṣyāguruṃ padmāsanāsīnaṃ bhūbhāsvantamiva sthitamśirasā'pīḍayat pādapadmaṃ nijakarāśritamāśirbhiryojayāmāsa samutthāpayadādarātātmabhavaṃ śarīrādau bhavamutpannamupaviśya prasannātmā baddhāñjalipuṭo'bravītkathaṃ sa paribhūyeta vidhisṛṣṭairathāmayaiḥatheti apyarthaḥ | vidhisṛṣṭairapītyarthaḥsantāpayet kathaṃ vyādhiścaṇḍāṃśuratibhīṣaṇaḥsadā sthitaṃ kintu bhavatpādābjaviyutiṃ vināāntaraṃ manaḥ | bāhyaṃ śarīram | bhavatpādābjayorviyutirviyogaḥtadbhavaccaraṇāmbhojadarśanādadya vai punaḥtat kiñciccirasaṃvṛttaṃ hṛdi me parivartateājñapto bhavatādyāhaṃ pṛcchāmi vicikitsitampraṣṭavyārthe cirāt saṃśayitam āntaraṃ mano yasya
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samprahṛṣṭamanā rāmamūce prītyātha bhārgavamtava bhaktyā prasanno'smi prabravīmi tavepsitampraśrayāvanato bhūtvā saṃpraṣṭumupacakramepṛcchetyājñaptaḥ | praśrayaḥ vinayaḥpurā me nṛpavaṃśeṣu krodhaḥ kāraṇato hyabhūtsvasya nirvedapāptiprakāramāha - puretimayā triḥsaptakṛtvo vai kṣatrāsṛgbharite hradetat krodhāddhetoḥmatkrodhaṃ śāmayāmāsuḥ śāntaḥ pitrājñayāpyahamkrodhāndhastena bhūyo'haṃ saṅgato baladarpitaḥjīvan kathañcinnryāto brahmaṇyenānukampinātato'tyantaṃ pathi mayā bahudhā paridevitamparidevitaṃ pralapitambhasmacchannāgnivad gūḍhaṃ kathañcidavidaṃ tadāsamāsadamāsāditavānsaṅgamyaivātiśiśirabhāvamāsādayaṃ tadāsaṅgamaphalamāha - saṅgamyetisusārapiṇḍavat sarvaṃ niṣkṛṣya pratyapādayatpeśalaṃ sundaram | sarvaṃ praśnārthambhūyaḥ saṃprārthitaḥ so'tha bhavantaṃ me vinirdiśattat saṃvartoktam | raṅkaḥ daridrīandho janasamāyogamivātyantasukhāvahamśrutaṃ māhātmyamakhilaṃ tripurābhaktikārakamtat saṃvartoktaṃ śravaṇādhikāraṃ svasminnāha - śrutamitievaṃ me vartamānasya kiṃ phalaṃ samavāpyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: punarupāsanaṃ piṣṭapeṣaṇavadityāha - evamitiaviditvā ca tannāsti kvacīcca kṛtakṛtyatākiṃ saṃvartoktena upāsanameva kurviti cedāha - aviditvetitadvālakrīḍanamiva pratibhāti samantataḥtadaviditvopāsanamanyadvā karma sarvaṃ vyarthamityāha - taduktamitiprabhūtānnagaṇairiṣṭā devāḥ śakramukhā nanudakṣiṇānām ucchraya ādhikyaṃ yeṣumanye tadahamalpaṃ yat duḥkhameveti sarvathāyataḥ sukhātyaye duḥkhaṃ bhaved gurutaraṃ kilaetadeva nirūpayati - asukhamiti | tatra hetuḥ - yata itimṛtyūpayogo yadbhūyo na tatra syāt kadācanamṛtyugrasanaṃ karmabhirdurnivāramiti bhāvaḥbālakrīḍeva me bhāti sarvaṃ tanmānasaṃ yataḥniyataṃ cāpyanyathā tad vacobhedasamāśrayātniyamenāniyamena vā kartuṃ śakyamityarthaḥniścitam | kratusamaṃ kathaṃ na bhavediti śeṣaḥathāpi nityaṃ [k: nitya] kartavyametannāsyāvadhiḥ kvacitkartavyaleśaviṣamaviṣajvālāvinirgataḥkartavyeti | yato vinirgataḥ tataḥ śītalaḥvane dāvāgnisaṅkīrṇe himāmbusthagajopamaḥlokavyavahāraṃ hasannivāste | tasya sarvaśītalatve dṛṣṭāntaḥ - vana itikathametāṃ daśāṃ prāpto yacca māmāha tatpurākarmatyāgādabhayadaśāṃ saṃvartaḥ prāptaḥkartavyakālabhujaganigīrṇaṃ māṃ vimocayakimetena te prayojanamiti cedāha - kartavyeti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathābhūtam ārtaṃ mumukṣumvatsa bhārgava dhanyo'si yasya te buddhirīdṛśīkartavyasya duḥkhahetutvabuddhiḥetāvadeva sukṛtiḥ kriyābhirupasaṅgataḥbuddhiprāptimityarthaḥsā devī tripurā sarvahṛdayākāśarūpiṇītadrūpiṇīhṛdayāntaḥ pariṇatā mocayed mṛtyujālataḥbuddhyā rūpeṇa] pariṇatā saiva mocayediti bhāvaḥna tāvat sukhamāpnoti vetālāviṣṭavat sadāasyā buddhervyatirekamukhena padasādhanatāmāha - yāvaditikarālagaralajvālākrāntāṅgānāmiva kvacitsarpadaṣṭānāmiva kartavyayutānāṃ na sukhamityāha - nṛṇāmitiandhībhūtaṃ na jānāti kriyāṃ svasya hitātmikāmna jānāti | evaṃrūpaṃ jagat paśyaevaṃvidho hi lokoayaṃ kartavyaviṣamūrcchitaḥvihāyānyathā ceṣṭate | atra heturviṣamūrcchita itimahā]viṣamuṣṭiphalānyāśu tindukasya phalehayāatha te tadviṣajvālājvalitāṅgāḥ supīḍitāḥnaṣṭarasendriyā itiaviditvā muṣṭiphalaṃ tindūphalaniṣevaṇātmuṣṭiphalaṃ bhakṣitamityaviditvābhrāntyā jambīrabuddhyā tat sarvirāsīt subhakṣitamtindūphalajāmevāṅge jvālāṃ matva āsaduḥ prāptāḥ | tad dhatturaphalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: andhībhūtātigahane patanto nimnabhūmiṣuadhikṣipantaścānyonyaṃ kalahaṃ cakruruccakaiḥatha te dīrṇasarvāṅgāḥ puraṃ kañcit samāsaduḥpuradvārādhipālaiste pratiruddhāḥ praveśaneatha te prahṛtā dvārapālairatitarāṃ yadādvārādhipaiḥ kalahaṃ cakruḥpatitāḥ parikhe kecid bhakṣitā makarādibhiḥparikhājalasthamakarādibhiḥapare tairvinihatāḥ kecijjīvagrahaṃ gatāḥaho vināśaṃ yāntyuccairmohenāndhīkṛtāḥ khaludārṣṭāntike yojayati - evamitivicāraḥ sarvamūlaṃ hi sopānaṃ prathamaṃ bhavetsuvicāramṛte kṣemaprāptiḥ kasya kathaṃ bhavetvimṛśyakarī jayati sarvatrābhīṣṭasaṅgamātvicāraparamā devāḥ sarvataḥ sukhabhāginaḥavicāreṇa ke hatāḥ ke vā vicāreṇa sukhinastadāha - avicāretivicāraḥ sukhavṛkṣasya bījamaṅkuraśaktikambhāvaḥvicārādvidhirutkṛṣṭo vicārāt pūjyate hariḥavicārānmṛgāsakto rāmo buddhimatāṃvaraḥbaddhvā laṅkāpurīṃ rakṣogaṇākīrṇāṃ samākramatśiraśchedaṃ samagamaditi saṃśrutameva tebhasmībhāvāt svasya bhītaḥ palāyanaparo'bhavatśāpena paramaṃ duḥkhamāptam(mavāpā)tyantaduḥsahamavicāravaśādeva vipadaṃ prāpnuvanti hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vijahāti vicāro no namastebhyo nirantaramvicāraparān stauti - mahetivicārya kṛtvā sarvebhyo mucyate'pārasaṅkaṭaiḥapārasaṅkaṭaiḥ aparihāryaduḥkhaprāpakaiḥ saha sarvebhyo duḥkhebhyaḥyasyāvicāro yāvat syāt kutastāvadvimarśanamvicārāvicārayorvirodhaṃ sadṛṣṭāntamāha - yasyetievaṃ cirāvicārāgnijvālāmālāparīvṛtesādhanaṃ tvekamevātra paramaṃ sarvato'dhikamtāṃ vinā syāt kathaṃ kasya mahāśreyaḥ susādhanaḥtat kim ? tadāha - parā kṛpetitatra mūlaṃ bhavedbhaktyā devatāparirādhanamvicārarūpatāṃ yāti cittākāśe raviryathāsarveśvareśvarī (1|58) itisarvāntaraniketāṃ śrīmaheśīṃ cinmayīṃ śivāmnijātmetiārādhane'pi mūlaṃ syādbhaktiḥ śraddhā ca nirmalāārādhanaprakāramāha - akāpaṭyāditi | kāpaṭyam phalābhisandhiḥataste prathamaṃ rāma māhātmyaṃ sampravartitamtatrāpi bhaktyādau | sampravartitaṃ śrāvitambhīritaḥavicārātmadoṣeṇa grastasya prativāsaramapi tāvadbhaved bhītiryāvaddhātoraśuddhatādevatārādhanaparasyāpi vicārodayaparyantamavicāreṇa bhayamastīti bhāvaḥyāvatsu janmasu nṛṇāṃ vicāro na bhavet paraḥparo mokṣasādhanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa eva saphalo janmavṛkṣo yatra vimarśanamyathā kūpe samutpanno bheko no veda kiñcanate kūpamaṇḍukasadṛśaḥtathā janā api vṛthotpannā brahmāṇḍakūpakeutpadyotpadya naśyanti na jānanti svakaṃ hitamprāpyāvicāramāhātmyāt pacyante sṛtipāvakesṛtirjanmādirūpaḥ saṃsāraḥyathā pādaśatāghātaistāḍito'pi mahākharaḥtad dhanādirūpaṃ duḥkhasādhanam | atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - yathetitvaṃ tu rāma vicārātmā pāraṃ duḥkhasya saṅgataḥbhūyaḥ kliśyamāno'pi na tyajatītyarthaḥjāmadagnyaḥ punarapi papraccha vinayānvitaḥtāya namaḥ] dattātreyetiavicārāt paro nāśaḥ saṃprāptaḥ sarvathā janaiḥmahāntatra māhātmyaśrutausvābhāvikaṃ tadyadi syāttatsarvairna kutaḥ śrutamsvābhāvikamevaitaditi cedāha - tatsarvairitiduḥkhaṃ matto'dhikaṃ prāptā vihatāśca pade pademāhātmyaśravaṇe | duḥkhaprāptirevātra mūlamiti cedāha - duḥkhamitiityāpṛṣṭaḥ prāha bhūyo hṛṣṭo datto dayānidhiḥmāhātmyaṃ śrutavantaḥ etadvadetyarthaḥsadbhiḥ saṅgaḥ paraṃ mūlaṃ sarvaduḥkhanibarhaṇamnidānamādikāraṇam | paraṃ mūlamādikāraṇamtvaṃ cāpi tena hi satā saṃvartena mahātmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvā pratyabhijānāti tatparo maṇimañjasāsa] maṇiṃ so'yaṃ maṇiriti pratyabhijānātina vijānāti tadiha brahman sunipuṇo'pi saniha loke tat tasmād atatparatvāddhetoḥ so'yaṃ maṇiriti na vijānātiajñātatvāt paṇḍitāstu śrutajñānayutā apiśrutajanitaparokṣajñānayutā api na vijānantītyanvayaḥyathā hi tārakāṃ paśyannapi jānāti na kvacityatheti | mūḍho na jānātītyanvayaḥpaśyannapi ca no vetti tatparatvavivarjanātmayā jñeyaṃ sarvatheti tatparo buddhimān naraḥpratyabhijñāsyatītyanvayaḥevamajñānato mūḍhāścānye tātparyavarjanātvijānantīti yojanābhikṣāmaṭati durdaivād yathā vai vismṛtākaraḥdṛṣṭāntadvāreṇāha - bhikṣāmiti | tathaite iti śeṣaḥata eva śiśūnāṃ hi sarvadā nirvikalpakamnirvikalpakamastīti śeṣaḥpratyabhijñātmakaṃ yattu jñānaṃ syāt savikalpakamjñānamevājñānanāśakamityāha - pratyabhijñātmakamitianekajanmasu kṛtaiḥ santuṣṭā svātmadevatākṛtaiḥ sukṛtairiti śeṣaḥcetanatvaṃ janmavatsu paramaṃ durlabhaṃ bhavetmumukṣutvasādhanamapyatidurlabhamityāha - cetanatvamititatrāpi sūkṣmabuddhitvamatyantaṃ hi sudurlabhamteṣvapi cetaneṣvapi | tatrāpi mānuṣatve prāpte'pi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na dṛśyate jaṅgamaṃ vai teṣāmapi śatāṃśataḥetadevodāharaṇena viśadayati - paśyeti | teṣāmapi jaṅgamānāmapipaśutulyāḥ pradṛśyante manuṣyāṇāṃ hi koṭayaḥjanmano] manuṣyā api vyavahāre paśutulyāḥanye'pi koṭiśo martyāḥ pravṛttaḥ kāmanāparāḥpravṛttimārgāśritāḥevaṃvidhajanānāṃ tu ke'pyanye buddhimadvidhāḥbhagavanmāyayācchannamadvaitaṃ paramaṃ padamkathamevamiti cedadvaitajñānamatidurlabhamityāha - bhagavaditimāyāndhānāṃ tatpadaṃ tu na buddhimuparohati [kh: mava]atyantapuṇyapākādevādvaitajñānamiti bhāvaḥkukalpanaiḥasti ced ghaṭa ivopalabhyeta ityādi kutarkairapalapantīti bhāvaḥcintāmaṇi hastagataṃ tyajanti hi kukalpanaiḥte māyayā vinirmuktāḥ sutarkāḥ śraddhayā yutāḥsutarkaśraddhābhyāṃ śreyaḥprāptiriti bhāvaḥtatkramaṃ te'bhidhāsyāmi brahman saṃśṛṇu saṃyataḥtatkramaṃ paraśreyaḥprāptikramamtayā saṃrādhya suciraṃ tatprasādāttataḥ paramtayā bhaktyā | tataḥ paraṃ vairasyaṃ prāpnuyādityanvayaḥvairāgyatatparatvābhyāṃ śraddhayā cāpi saṅgataḥśraddhāgurusevādīnāṃ tatparo bhavatītyāha - vairasyamityādietajjñānaṃ parokṣaṃ vai hyastyadvaitamitīha yatkīdṛśaṃ tat parokṣajñānamiti cedāha - astītiupapādya sutarkaistu saṃśayāṃstena nāśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anudhayayedā'parokṣaṃ haṭhavṛttyāpi yatnataḥāparokṣamiti | aparokṣānubhavaparyantamityarthaḥsaṃsāramūlamajñānaṃ nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥvikalpaviṣayīkṛtamadvaitātmatattvamajñānaṃ nāśayetāsādya paścāt saṃsmṛtya pratyabhijñānavān bhavetetadvistarastu pratyabhijñātātparyavivṛtau draṣṭavyaḥsaṃsāramūlamajñānaṃ sāṅgaṃ nāśayati drutamyāvat | pratyabhijñātātmatattvo nāśayativikalpo vividhakhyātirekadhā nirvikalpakaḥsamādherghaṭādyākāratvābhāvena jñānaikarūpatvānnirvikalpatvamvikalpe varjite paścānnirvikalpaṃ svataḥ sthitamvikalpavarjanamātreṇa nirvikalpatāsampattirityāha - vikalpa itisampādanaṃ śuddhabhitteścitrasammārṣṭireva hiatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - citra iti | saṃmārṣṭiḥ saṃmārjanamnirvikalpātmasampattirvikalpatyāga eva hidārṣṭāntike yojayati - evamiti | apohe anullekhanena nirasaneatra muhyanti vibudhā api māyāmahitvataḥmāhātmyāttridhā'dhikāriṇo brahman uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ- tridhetyādivicāro dhyānamapi ca śrutikālasamaṃ bhavetcedāha - vicāra iti | śrutikāle eva bhavetahaṃ purā nidāghasya rātrau jyotsnāsumaṇḍitevāṭikāṅgaṇa iti sambandhaḥparārddhyaśayanāsīno madirāmadaghūrṇitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parārddhyamuttamamhyavidaṃ padamśravaṇakāla evāvidamevamardhamuhūrtena jñātvā tatpāvanaṃ padamparamānandavārāśiparimagno hyaśeṣataḥbrahmānandaikarūpa iti bhāvaḥaho'dbhutapadaṃ hyetadānandāmṛtanirbharamatha samādhyanantaraṃ vicāraparamaḥ vicāraikaparaḥnaitasya leśamātraṃsyādaindrādisukhamapyalamsamādhisukhasya | alaṃ pūrṇaṃ sukhamapiadyāvadhi vyartha eṣa kālo me hyativāhitaḥativāhito'tikrāmitaḥ kālaḥ prakṛtānandānadhigamād vyarthaḥyathā bhikṣāmaṭati vai muṣṭipiṣṭapralipsayānirūpayati - aviditveti | svaṃ svīyambāhyaṃ sukhaṃ leśamātraṃ prāpnuvanti mahāśramaiḥsvātmānandājñānena vimohitāḥanantānandasandohatatparaḥ syāṃ hi sarvadāpiṣṭapeṣaṇakalpena copālambhapadena vaiprayojanamiti śeṣaḥ | upālambhapadena nindāsthānabhūtenabhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi yoṣitsambhogakāśca tebhūtā]gatānugatikatvānme jugupsā nahi jāyateavicāraparatvāditi yāvat | paryuṣitaprāyaviṣayabhoge jugupsātāvadanyo vimarśo māṃ suśubhaḥ pratyupasthitaḥantarmukhatāyāmudyataḥ | vimarśo vicāraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ānandaparipūrṇātmā sa evāhaṃ sthito'pi sankimaprāptaṃ mayā kutra kadā vā prāpyate kathamkathaṃ kenopāyenaaho'nantacidānandarūpe me syāt kathaṃ kriyāniṣkriyasya na kāpi kriyā sambhavatītyāha - aho itimamaiva tāni sarvāṇi tvakhaṇḍaikacidātmanaḥbhavanti | kuta iti cedakhaṇḍaikacidātmana iti viśeṣaṇamanyānyapyaniruddhāni manāṃsi ca mamaiva hinirodhe'pyanyeṣāmanirodhānna tena vikṣepanivṛttiriti bhāvaḥniruddhānyaniruddhāni manāṃsi mayi bhāntyalamca manāṃsi mayyeva bhāntītyaviśeṣād mamaiva tāni sarvāṇīti bhāvaḥmahākāśāt suvitate kuto mayi nirodhanammahākāśasyāpi cidātmaprakāśyatvena tato vitatatvaṃ jñeyamcidānandaprapūrṇasya pūrṇasya gaganādapiānandāvirbhāvo vā prāpyo nāstīti sūcitamananteṣu śarīrātmābhāseṣu manmahitvataḥmanmāhātmyādeva kriyādyābhāsa ityāha - manmahitvata itikartavyaṃ vā'pyakartavyaṃ mama nāstyapi leśataḥato mama na kartavyākartavye ityāha - kartavyaṃ vetisamādhāvasamādhau vā satyapūrṇasvabhāvakaḥnirodhena na kiñcit phalamityāha - tasmāditiityahaṃ sarvathā svasthaḥ sumahānandamandiraḥdehāhambhāvavarjanāt svarūpasthaḥuttamādhikṛtasyaivaṃ sthitirme samprakīrtitāuktarītyā sthitirjñānaprāptiprakāraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vicāraṇamna tūttamānāmivākrameṇa tatkālevijñānaphalasaṃyuktaḥ samādhirdurlabho bhavetpratyabhijñānamtasmādvijñānahīnaistaiḥ phalaṃ nāsti samādhibhiḥsthitakṣaṇasamādhibhiḥbhāvānavijñāya teṣāmajñānaṃ na nivartateiti | avijñāya viṣayavikalpamakṛtvā sthitasya tadajñānaṃ na nivartatetat sarvadā bhāsamānamapyabhātavidhaṃ nanusavikalpakāle'pibhāsamānameva bhūyo bhātakalpamapūrvataḥvikalpānāmitievameṣa bhavedātmavijñānakrama uttamaḥupasaṃharati - evamiti | uttamaphaladatvāduttamaḥatha vijñāyātmatattvaṃ kṛtārthastvaṃ bhaviṣyasiso'hamiti pratyabhijñāyapūjitastvabhyanujñāto gatvā svaṃ sthānamādarātjīvanmukto'bhavad drutambhavedityādi sandeham | drutamityaṣṭāvakrasyottamādhikāritā dyotitāupalabdhidaśāstasyā bahudhā saṃśrutā nanuevaṃ janakoktarītyā | sā ātmarūpiṇī | tasyāḥ vedyarahitasaṃvidaḥsā daśā bhāvyate sūkṣmadṛśaiva nānyathā kvacitvedyarahitasaṃviddaśā | sūkṣmadṛśā abahirmukhamanasāmanasā vedyate vedyaṃ manaso'to na vedyatāmanahsvarūpavedane karaṇābhāvānna manaso vedyatā'sti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tanmano vedyanirmuktā vittirityabhidhīyatetanmana iti | vedyanirmuktaṃ mana eva śuddhamātmatattvamiti bhāvaḥanyopalabdhyapekṣāyāmāndhyaṃ syādanavasthiteḥca vittyantareṇetyanavasthāyāṃ na kiñcit prakāśeteti bhāvaḥna bhāsi cenna tvamasi tataḥ praśnastu te kathampraśnānupapattimāha - tata itikathaṃ tavatmānamahaṃ sādhayāmi vibhāvayamūḍhasyātmasādhanamanyena kartumaśakyamiti bhāvaḥiti ced rāma sāmānyameva te rūpamavyayambhāvaḥaho jānannapi punaralaṃ muhyasi vai vṛthāataḥ sāmānyarūpastvaṃ vibhāsi svata eva hiniḥsāmānyaviśeṣavapuṣā bhāsata iti bhāvaḥśarīrātmatayā bhāsi saṅkalpenaiva nānyathābhāsi na svata ityarthaḥbhāti kiṃ tava dehatvaṃ dehastaccāpi te bhavetsambandhāviśeṣāttaccāpi tava deho bhavedityāha - deha ititena sarvamayastvaṃ syāḥ kathaṃ dehātmamātrakaḥtasmād dṛṅmātrarūpo'si na dṛg dṛśyā kadācanabhavatītyāha - na dṛgitidehadeśakālabhedacitravaicitryacitritābhāvaḥśeṣaṃ śuddhacite rūpaṃ svātmānamupalakṣayasvato'bhivyajyamānam | śeṣaṃ saṅkalpatyāgāvadhibhūtamajñānaṃ sarvasaṃsārakāraṇaṃ tad vilīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣaṇikasamādhirūpānnirvikalpādāpātapratyabhijñānād veti bhāvaḥsaṅkalpavarjanācchuddhasvarūpasya prathaiva saḥsvarūpaprathātmako mokṣo bhavediti bhāvaḥkevalaṃ mohamātrasya nirāsena kṛtārthatākevalamiti | moho'jñānamsvarūpādatiriktaścecchaśaśṛṅgasamo hi saḥsambandhaḥsvarūpe sambhavan(ved)mokṣo darpaṇapratibimbavatevetyāha - svarūpa itivigamo'bhāva eva syāt satyo'bhāvātmakaḥ kathamviruddhabhāvābhāvobhayarūpaṃ bhavediti bhāvaḥtathā ca svāpnabhāvāśca bhāvābhāvobhayātmakāḥnāstītyubhayapratyayaviṣayatvādubhayātmatvam | satyāḥ syuriti sambandhaḥbādho'bhāvapratyayaḥ syāt pratyayābhāvakālikaḥnāsatyateti tātparyamasti sarvasya dṛśyasya bādho'pratyayakālikaḥḥyasyābhāvasparśaleśaḥ kadācit kutracinnahipratyayābhāvakālikābhāvapratyayasambandho nahitasmādvibhinnamokṣastu na satyaḥ syāt kathañcana| tasmāditi | ātmabhinnadṛśyamātrasyāsattvādityarthaḥcetyavarjanamātreṇa citiḥ pūrṇā prakīrtitācetyasamparkādapūrṇeva bhavatīti bhāvaḥcetyābhāne citiḥ pūrṇā paricchedavivarjanātacetitaḥ paricchedaścetito vā bhaved vada
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paricchedakaḥ kālādiḥ | cetito vā'cetitaḥ citiprakāśito vā na vetyarthaḥloke kālaparicchinno bhavo yaḥ ko'pi bhāvitaḥsodāharaṇamupapādayati - loka iti bhāvitaḥ dṛṣṭaḥcitā vyāptau bhavetāṃ vai yadā tarhi tathāvidhaubhāvakālayostathāvidhatā paricchedyaparicchedakatāciterbahiryadā cetyamasti tat syāt paricchidiḥparicchedastena citeḥ syādityāha - citeriti | tat tadāyo bahiḥ sa kathaṃ siddhyeccitisambandhavarjitaḥcidvyāptyā prakāśamānasyaiva svarūpasiddhirnānyasyetyāha - citerititatsambandhāṃśamātrasya bhānādanyanna siddhyaticedanyāṃśasyābhāvādityāha - tatsambandhetievaṃ ca sarvātmanaiva magnaṃ cetyamapīṣyatāmcitinirmagnaṃ cetyamiṣyatāmityāha - ata iticetyamevaṃvidhaṃ rāma vicāraya suyuktitaḥsādhayitumupakramate - cetyamiti | evaṃvidhaṃ citinirmagnamna bhāvodarago bhāvo bhavan loke sudṛśyatecaturdaśādhyāye ca] | anyathā'nupapattimeva darśayati - na bhāvetibahiḥpadārthaste prokto bhramamūlo hi sarvathācitisvarūpaḥ svātmaiva tattadbhāvātmanā sadāiti vākyaṃ samākarṇya punaḥ papraccha bhārgavaḥsvarūpātiriktaṃ kvacit kiñcidapi nahi vidyateśuddhā citirvicitraikā bhāsata ityasambhavātdurghaṭaṃ pratibhātitatra cetyaṃ citā bhāsyaṃ svaprabhā citirastu tesvaprabhaivāstu | citeḥ svaprakāśatvaṃ tvaduktamevāstviti tātparyam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ citā bhāsitaṃ tu cetyamastu pṛthagvidhamālokabhātamālokādyathā bhinnam evaṃ cito bhinnaṃ cetyamastvityarthaḥatha ca prāgabhihitaṃ janakena mahātmanāyadabhihitaṃ tat kathamiti vyavahitena sambandhaḥtadeva nirvikalpaṃ syājjñānaṃ saṃsāranāśanamsaṃsāranāśanam pratyabhijñānadvārā saṃsāranivartakamityarthaḥātmano hi manaḥ proktaṃ karaṇaṃ jñānakarmaṇijñānakriyāyāmmano jaḍādviśeṣaḥ syādātmano bhagavannanujaḍatvaprasaktirityāha - mana itimano mokṣa iti cocyata iti bhāvaḥ] mokṣaḥ syānnirvikalpakammano mokṣa iti cocyata iti bhāvaḥ] bandho mokṣa itinirvikalpasya saṃsiddhāvapi dvaitaṃ tu śiṣyatenahi bhrāntirasatyā syāttadadvaitaṃ kathaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ hi jāgataṃ vastu sthiramarthakriyākaramsarvaṃ ca bhrāntivijñānaṃ bhrāntyabhrāntibhidā kathamjñānabhedavyavahāraḥ kathamityāha - sarvamitisandeha eṣa cirato [k, kh: virato] hṛdi me parivartatesarveṣāmekarūpā bhrāntirvā kathaṃ syādityāha - bhrāntiritisādhupraśnaprahṛṣṭātmā pravaktumupacakramesamastavit sarvajñaḥyāvanna manasastoṣastāvad bhūyo viśodhayet- yāvaditi | saṃśayanivṛttyā toṣaḥ | viśodhayet vicārayetprāṇināṃ hi buddhibhedāttarkaḥ pṛthagavasthitaḥjñātumaśakyatvena sakṛdupadeśena śaṅkā'nivṛtteriti bhāvaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: santa eva hi saṃyātā diśanti paramaṃ sukhamtacca rāma eva nidarśayati - tvaṃ ceti | satsaṅgaṃ stauti - santa itiloke'pi yādṛśaṃ saṅgaṃ yo yaḥ prāpnoti mānavaḥatra [k: atreti] te kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇu rāma kathāmimāmvaktumākhyāyikāmupakramate - atretitasya putrau hemacūḍamaṇicūḍau babhūvatuḥkadācinmṛgayotsāhāt senābhiḥ parivāritaumahābalau viviśaturdhanurbāṇadharau kilajaghanturniśitairbāṇairlāghavāt kārmukacyutaiḥna dṛśyate tatra śilā vṛkṣaḥ puruṣa eva vānihatā śarkarāvarṣaiḥ senātyantaṃ palāyitāaśvārūḍhau rājaputrāvapi dūraṃ palāyitauupāsaduḥ saṃśritā babhūvuḥkadalīkharjūravanairākrāntamatisundarampradyotamānāṃ vapuṣā taptahemasuvarcasāsmayamāna ivā'pṛcchat kā tvaṃ padmānane vanekasya tvamapi kenātra nivasasyekalā kathamkena hetornivasasi ? kathamekalā nivasasīti sambandhaḥsvāgataṃ te rājaputra viṣṭaraṃ pratipadyatāmviṣṭaram āsanamśrāntaṃ tvāmabhipaśyāmi vyathitaṃ caṇḍavāyunāmadvṛttamarhasi śrotumityuktaḥ sa tathā'karotevaṃ taṃ viśramaṃ prāptaṃ rājaputramaninditāsadrasaṃ svādūdakamrājaputra vyāghrapādo muniḥ śivapadāśrayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: apṛṣṭurvidyā hi sudṛḍhā praśno bījaṃ nirūpaṇepraśna iticitirekaiva vaicitryādbhāsata iti sambhavettataḥ apraṣṭurvidyābhāvāt krameṇottaraṃ vaktumupakramate - citiritipaśya svapnavikalpādau mana ekaṃ hi kevalamevaṃ śuddhaiva sā saṃvidvicitrākārabhāsinīevameva śuddhasaṃvidvicitrākārabhāsinīālokamantarā tvandho bhāvaṃ jānāti vai nanughaṭāderbhāsanātnaivaṃ citerabhāne kiṃ kadā kutra vibhāsatecitimanapekṣya kiṃ vibhāsate na kiñcidityarthaḥādarśānnātirikto'taḥ pratibimbo bhavedyathābhāti ato hetoreva yathā pratibimba ādarśānnātiriktaḥata eva mano'pyanyat sarvatha nāsti vai citeḥkalpitaṃ kāryasaṃsiddhyai karaṇaṃ kevalaṃ manaḥsakalakāryanirvāha evaṃ jāgratyapītyāha - kalpitamitirāma kriyā'satyarūpā satyaṃ tatkaraṇaṃ katham [kh: tathā]manaso'satyatvamavarjjanīyamityāha - kriyetitasmānnāsti mano rāma cāsat kāryasya kāraṇamsadṛṣṭāntamāha - asateti | kārakaṃ karaṇamyathā [kh: tathā rāma] tathā sarvadāpi mano nāsti kriyākaramparikalpya vyavahared dṛśyadraṣṭṛādibhedataḥsvīyamāyaśaktyaiva sarvaṃ parikalpya vyavaharedityarthaḥśṛṇu bhārgava cittattvaṃ paripūrṇamapi svayambhāsata ityupapādayitumupakramate - śṛṇviti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ākāśaśca cidātmā ca na vilakṣaṇatāṃ gataucaitanyamātramevātmano'dhikamityāha - ākāśaścetisarvādhāro'pyasaṅgātmā sarvāntarabahirbhavaḥsarvānusyūtaḥvastutaścaitanyapūrṇa ātmaivākāśa ucyatecaitanyam | avāstavo hyākāśātmanorbheda ityāha - vastutastvitiya ākāśaḥ sa ātmaiva yaścātmākāśa eva saḥsaurālokaṃ yatholūkastamomātraṃ prapaśyatievamavidyādos.ādātmānamevākāśaṃ paśyanti janāḥparā citiḥ pareśānī svacchasvātantryavaibhavātmāhātmyād avabhāsayediti sambandhaḥyathā rāma svamātmānaṃ svapne bahuvidhaṃ pṛthakatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - yatheti | pṛthag bhāsayasītyanvayaḥanekadhā'vabhāso'pi paricchinnadṛśaiva hisvadṛṣṭyetyāha - anekadhetiaindrajālika eko'pi svamātmānamanekadhāatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - aindrajālika itieka eva nirvikāra evaṃ sā paramā citiḥsvadṛṣṭyā nirvikāraikarūpetyāha - evaṃ setiśuddha ekarasaḥ ekaḥ akhaṇḍaḥ bhāso yasyāḥ sāyathaindrajāliko māyāvṛtaścānyadṛśo bhavetsvadṛṣṭyanā] anekatvaṃ ceti bhāvaḥloke'pi yogino'nye ca māntrikā aindrajālikāḥmāyetyarthaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - loke'pītidurghaṭaṃ ghaṭayantyeva tato naitadvicitritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vicitramityarthaḥanekadhā paricchinnaṃ bhāsitaṃ bhṛgunandanaevaṃ proktopapattyāsā'pyapūrṇatvavikhyātiryā'vidyā parigīyate[k: pūrṇā]svātmānamanudāhṛtya bahirdṛṣṭitayā sthiteḥtatrāpi heturbahirdṛṣṭitayā sthiteritianudāhṛtya cātmānaṃ yāvanna hyavalokayetprakāśādirūpatā vā itaradasadvā aprākśādirūpatā vāato mayoktaṃ rāma tvaṃ sampaśyātmani saddṛśātyaktabahirmukhatvadṛṣṭyāsā prakāśamayī yasmājjaḍavyāvṛttarūpiṇīdīpādijaḍavyāvṛttaprakāśamayītyarthaḥjaḍāścidātmaviśrāntāścidatmani vibhāsataḥbhavediti śeṣaḥ | jaḍānāṃ na svātmaviśrāntirityāha - jaḍā iticitestu kevalaṃ svasminnananyāpekṣayā sadābhāsamānatvāt svasmin viśrāntirupapadyata iti sambandhaḥpūrṇāhantā parā seyaṃ yā jaḍeṣu na vidyatesvātmaviśrama iti bhāvaḥ | seyaṃ svatmaviśrāntireva pūrṇāhantāsarvamasyāṃ yataḥ saṃsthamādarśe nagaraṃ yathā[k, kh: paricchinnā] vyāvṛttisparśo nāstītievaṃ pūrṇasvarūpāyāḥ pūrṇaṃ yatsphuraṇaṃ sthitampūrṇamaparicchinnaṃ yat svarūpasphuraṇaṃ tadeva kathyata iti sambandhaḥakhaṇḍaikarasaṃ hyetadetāvad rāma vai bhavetdvayamapyetadakhaṇḍaikarasam | akhaṇḍamekam ekarasaṃ cinmātram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evāvadeva svātantryaṃ yataḥ śaktirhi tanmayītanmayaṃ tadekarasamityarthaḥevaṃ svātantryaviśrāntisahitaikarasātmikāsahitā citiḥādarśavadyatsvarūpe cidekarasarūpiṇīnirūpayati - ādarśavadititathā bhāsanakāle'pi svarūpādanivartanamcidekarasasvarūpādanivartanamiti yat etadeva tasyā atidurghaṭatvamiti śeṣaḥsā'vidyā jaḍaśaktiḥ sā śūnyaṃ prakṛtireva caevānātmābhāsaḥ | ābhāsābhāsyayostādātmyādāha - sā'vidyetisarvaṃ tadeva samproktaṃ paricchedanamādimamityarthaḥtasyaikadeśatābhrāntikṛtamākāśabhāsanamrāma ya iti | tasya pūrṇātmaviśramasya | ekadeśatābhrāntikṛtamākāśaḥ sa hi samproktaḥ sa hi saṃsārakāraṇamsaṃsārakāraṇamrāma sūkṣmadṛśā paśya ya ākāśastvayekṣyateākāśātmanorabhedamanubhāvayati - rāmetiyathā'nyadeheṣvākāśo bhāsate yaḥ sadā tavaākāśaḥ | yaḥ sa evātmetyanvayaḥevaṃ svakalpitākāśagrastaṃ yaccidvapuḥ sthitamākāśagrastam ākāśaparicchinnamtatrāvaraṇamukhyatvāt pramāṇaṃ mana ucyatepramāṇaṃ jñānakaraṇaṃ mana ityarthaḥevamākāśāvṛto'pi cidātmā bhūya eva tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcabhūtātmakadehenāpyāvṛta ityāha - evamitikaṭhinaśliṣṭaghanatāmālinyānāṃ prakalpanaiḥkumbhodaragato dīpa udaraṃ vyāpya bhāsatebhāsata iti yojanīyamāste gūḍhapradīpātmā tadantarmātrabhāsanaḥdīpaḥ evaṃ dehāntarmātrabhāsanaḥevamakṣadvāramukhād bhūyo niryāti vai citiḥcitistattadviṣayākāreṇa punarnūtanatvenāpi prakāśata ityarthaḥsvātmāvaraṇamākāśaṃ sphūrtiśaktiścidātmanaḥna vastutaściterniryāṇamasti kintu tadābhāsanamātramityāha - svātmetimanovyāpāra eṣa syāt sphūrttyāpahatirāvṛteḥevamāvaraṇanivṛttireva manovyāpāro'pītyāha - mana iticalā citirmanonāmnī niścalātmasvarūpiṇīpunarniṣkrṣyāha - caletietadeva vikalpaḥ syād vikalpaparivarjaneparivarjane kṛte satīti śeṣaḥrāma tyajātra sandehaṃ vikalpasya vivarjaneāvṛtirnahi satyā'sti yataḥ svenaiva kalpitākalpitatvāditi bhāvaḥtāḍyamānastarjyamāno yāvat saṅkalpavarjanamkuryāditi sambandhaḥkiṃ tatra śiṣyate bandhastathā'trāpi vibhāvayasaṅkalpavarjane bandho na śiṣyata ityarthaḥjadātmabhrāntimutsṛjya ko'yaṃ bandho vicārayajaḍātmakadvaitabhrāntikṛta eva bandha iti bhāvaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛṣā bhītasya bālasya yakṣagraha iva sthitaḥdṛṣṭāntaḥ - mṛṣetina tāvat saṃsṛtermukto bhavet kvāpi mahodyamaiḥbandhasatyatvabhrāntim kvāpi kāle deśe vāpratibimbātmakaiḥ svātmādarśāntaḥpravibhāvitaiḥcennetyāha - pratibimbātmakairitibandhasya satyatābuddhirmanaso'stitvaniścayaḥdvividhabhramātirikto bandho nāstītyāha - bandhasyetiyāvadetad dvayamalaṃ sadvicāramahājalaiḥdvayamalaṃ proktabhramadvayātmakamalamahaṃ vā brahmadevo vā viṣṇurvāpi ca śaṅkaraḥtasmādrāma dvayaṃ caitat parityajya sukhī bhavadvayaṃ proktabhramadvayamātmamātratvatastasya dvaitaṃ na pariśiṣyatemanaso'nanyatvādityarthaḥ | tasya manasaḥātmaiva mana iti tātparyamrajjurūpe hi sarpasya bhāsinīti viniścayaḥrajjusarpasya bhrāntiḥ sarpasya bhāsinīcidrūpādātmano'nyattu rajjujñānaṃ sthitaṃ bhavetbhavedityarthaḥrajjubādhe hi tajjñānaṃ kathaṃ śiṣyet kimāśrayampṛthak śiṣyata iti tātparyamcidātmānatiriktatvād dvaitaṃ tena kathaṃ bhavetcidātmānatirekāttena bhramajñānena kathaṃ dvaitaṃ bhavetsvāpnavastu sthiramiti svapne sarvairvibhāvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svāpnānubhavasiddhamityāha - svāpnetijāgrati svapnamithyātvaniścayo bhavati dhruvamsvapnānubhūtasya mithyātvaniścayaḥnaitāvataiva satyatvaṃ jāgradvyavahṛterbhavetsvapne jāgradanubhūtasya na mithyātvanirṇayaḥ | etāvatā bhedenaivadṛśyate kiṃ tathā svapne dṛśyate nahi vā vadadṛśyate kimiti yojanāarthakriyākarā vāpi sthirā vā bhānti tatsamamtat tasmāt | samaṃ jāgrat svapnaśceti dvayaṃ tulyampaśyaindrajālikakṛte sthairyamarthakriyāmapigajaturagādausatyāsatyavibhāgo vai prākrṭairvidito nahikadāpyabhāvāsaṃspṛṣṭaṃ satyaṃ rāma pracakṣatepratiyogitvenābhāvāsaṃspṛṣṭam | abhāvāpratiyogītyarthaḥabhānamacitāmasti hyanekatvāvabhāsataḥcidabhānaṃ kadā kutra syād rāma pravicārayatasyābhānaṃ kadācidvā setsyatīti bhāvaḥna bhāyādvā kathaṃ bhāyādabhāne yadi taddvayoḥsetsyatīti cedāha - abhāna iti | taddvayoḥ tatkālatadanupalabdhyoḥrāma satyāsatyabhedaṃ śṛṇu saṃkṣepato bruveprakārāntareṇa vaktumāha - rāmetianyathā rajjusarpādyamapi satyaṃ bhavennanusarpādyamapi satyaṃ bhavedityarthaḥabhāve bhāvavijñānamapi sambhavati sphuṭamtanmate syāditi bhāvaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti pakṣo na yuktaḥ syāt sarvathā vyabhicārataḥtvatpakṣo na yuktaḥ proktarītyā sarvathā vyabhicārāttasmādyaścinna bhātīti vadet tārkikasatkharaḥtasmāditi | uktānupapatterityarthaḥyasyātmani syāt sandeho bhānābhāvena sarvadātadā gaṇḍaśilā'pyeṣā'pyanyamohaṃ vināśayetsarvameva hi vijñānaṃ bhrāntireva na saṃśayaḥyathā hi bādhavijñānāt pūrvaṃ bhrāntirbhavettathākathaṃ bhātīti cedāha - yathetiyathā ca rajatajñānaṃ śuktijñānād bhramātmakamtarhi kadaiteṣāṃ bhrāntitvaṃ gṛhyata iti cedāha - yathetinabhonīlabhramaḥ sarvasamāno bhāsate tathātatheti yojanīyamabhrāntiḥ śuddhavijñānaṃ yaccidātmatayā sthitamcinmātrarūpamsandehamatra santyajya rāma proktaṃ viniścinuupasaṃharati - evamiti | yuktyanusaṅgataṃ yuktiyuktam | mayā proktamtatte pravakṣyāmi rāma śṛṇu samyak samāhitaḥpurā pañcadaśādhyāyādau mukte kathaṃ vyavahṛtiriti pṛṣṭamprārabdhopanatairbhogaiḥ khidyamānāḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇeprāptairbhogairviṣayajanitasukhaduḥkhaiḥyetu prārabdhasaṃprāptān bhuñjānā api no viduḥkhidyamānā mandajñānino'dhamajñānina ityarthaḥ | samprāptān viṣayānye tu prārabdhakoṭīnāṃ phalairapi vicitritaiḥmadhyamānā]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na vismayanti cāścaryairna hṛṣyanti mahāsukhaiḥsvasthiteḥ svarūpasamāhiteḥevaṃ buddhivibhedena jñānapākavibhedataḥbuddhyādibhedena tṛtīyeṣvapi vyavahāravacitryamityāha - evamitimadhumattādivatteṣāṃ vyavahāro'pi sambhavetteṣāṃ jñānināmbhūyaḥ papraccha muktānāṃ vyavahārakramaṃ kramātnirūpayituṃ rāmapraśnamavatārayati - itītiyathā buddhivibhedena jñānapākavicitratāupeyaṃ ca tadeva syādyanmokṣastatprathātmakaḥjñānātmaprathātmakaḥsādhanānyapi bhidyante'thavā neti tadīrayasādhanānivistareṇa tamevārthaṃ pravaktumupacakrametena rāmeṇa | tamevārthaṃ jñānaparipākabhedamsādhane na vibhedo'sti jñānaṃ na citrasādhanamjñānasādhane vibhedo nāsti | etadeva spaṣṭamāha - jñānamitipūrṇe tu sādhane jñānamanāyāsena siddhyatitviti | anekaprāgjanmārjitasādhanapūrtisampattauvastutaḥ sādhanaṃ kiñcid jñāne naivopayujyatecaitanyameva vijñānaṃ tat sadā svaprakāśakamsyāditi cedāha - caitanyamiticittakaraṇḍe'tisunirmale[kh, g: vṛttameveti] tātparyamnirodhasalilaiḥ samyag vāsanāpaṅkamārjane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadupalakṣaṇayuktimāha - nirodheti | mārjane kṛte saticirāt saṃghaṭite rāma suyuktyodghāṭite tataḥ| dṛśyadehāditādātmyahāne iti tātparyamsādhanānupayogāt | sādhanamupayuktaṃ smṛtamyasya yāvad vāsanaugho buddhimācchādya saṃsthitaḥvāsanā vividhāḥ proktāstatra mukhyā vadāmi tevāsanāḥ parigaṇayati - vāsaneti | vāsanāḥ saṃskārāḥaśraddhaivāparādhaḥ syād mukhyaḥ svātmavināśanaḥgurvāgamoktaṃ yat tattathaiveti dṛḍhaniścayaḥ tadabhāvo'śraddhāprāyaḥ kalāsu kuśalā aparādhavaśānnanuśāstrajñānāmapyetadvaśādeva jñānānudaya ityāha - prāya itinirviśeṣaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ nāsti naiva ca sambhavettattvamiti tṛtīyaḥviparītagraho vāpi caitatsaṃśaya eva vāśāstravidyāsu kuśalāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥeṣo'parādha evādyā vāsanetyāha - aparādha itipurā duṣkṛtasaṃskāravaśād buddhau tu yat sthitamanayā aparādharūpavāsanayā | dvitīyāṃ vāsanāmāha - puretiyenācāryaiḥ samyaguktamapi no gṛhyate khalumālinyaṃ mauḍhyam | yena buddhau sthitenakāmaḥ kartavyaśeṣaḥ syādananto bahuśākhakaḥasaṃkhyeyabhedaḥpārthivānāmaṇūnāṃ vā tathā tārāgaṇasya vāasaṃkhyeyatvameva nirūpayati - rāmetiiyaṃ rāma tṛtīyā te saṃproktā kāmavāsanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: peśalākārayā śobhanayāparāvarajño hyaniśaṃ pūjito munināyakaiḥparāvarajño brahmajñaḥvidyutprabhākhyā vidyādhrī sā sarvāṅgamanoharātadhā tatrājagāmārthāt suṣeṇo vaṅgabhūpatiḥklinnāṃśukāntaratyantavyaktapīnakucadvayīmsaundaryamohitā tasya taduktiṃ samamaṃsataatha sāpītyanvayaḥ | samamaṃsata aṅgīcakāradadhāra sāpi vidyādhrī garbhaṃ rājarṣivīryataḥamoghavīryād rājarṣerjātāhaṃ kanyakā tataḥbhāvaḥdayayā māmupādāyā'pālayajjananī yathāahaṃ tasya dharmaputrī pitṛsevāparāyaṇānāyaṃ surāsurairvāpi kadācid duṣṭabuddhibhiḥkathamekalā nivasasītyasyottaramāha - tasyetietanme'bhihitaṃ vṛttaṃ tiṣṭha kiñcinnṛpātmajapraṇamya taṃ prāpya ceṣṭaṃ tataḥ kalye prayāsyasidāsyatyevetyāśayaḥ | kalye uṣasibhitaḥ kiñcit pravaktuṃ tāṃ vimanā iva cābhavatmunimāhātmyādbhītaḥ | kiñcit svābhiprāyamprāha sā viduṣī bhūyo rājaputra dhṛtiṃ bhajaevaṃ vadantyāṃ tasyāṃ sa vyāghapādo mahāmuniḥmuniṃ samāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā rājaputraḥ samutthitaḥatha dṛṣṭvā rājaputraṃ kāmena vikṛtākṛtimdeśita ājñaptaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekasyāpi puruṣasyaāśāpiśācī prokteyaṃ rāma [g: rāmeyaṃ] yā kāmavāsanāyena dandahyamāno'yaṃ loka ākrandate sadā [k, kh: tadā]vinirmuktāstayā bhānti narāḥ sarvāṅgaśītalāḥke'pīti | lokottamā ityarthaḥ | mahāmantraḥ paravairāgyamsamākrāntamato nūnaṃ tattattvaṃ nāvabhāsatetatrādyā hyaparādhatvaniścayād vinivartatejñānānutpattiretadaparādhamūlikaiveti niścayātaiśvareṇa prasādena nānyathā koṭiyuktibhiḥanalpāyā anekajanmabhirnivṛttiḥ | nānyathā īśvaraprasādaṃ vinādoṣadṛṣṭyaiva vairāgyaṃ bhavennaivānyathā kvacitīśvarārādhanaṃ kramāt kāraṇaṃ jñeyamtasyāścālpānalpabhāvāpekṣā bhavati bhārgava| vāsanālpatve doṣadṛṣṭyalpasattvādyapekṣetimumukṣāmantarā yattu śravaṇaṃ mananādikamphalaparyantamityāha - mumukṣeti | ādinā nididhyāsanamna śilpajñānamātreṇa prāpyate paramaṃ padam- na śilpetiśavālaṅkāravat sarvaṃ teṣāṃ vyarthaṃ bhavet khaluamumukṣoḥ sādhanasampattirvyarthetyāha - mumukṣāmitiyathā phalaśrutericchā sāmānyā na phalāvahātattatphalāvahā evaṃ prakṛte'pītyāha - yathetiphalaśrutyā kasya nāma na syāt sā jīvadharmiṇaḥ[k: vahavattve] sarveṣāṃ sarvaṃ phalaṃ śayo bhavediti bhāvaḥsandhirārṣaṇ] phalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathotkaṭā tathā tasyā aciraṃ phalaṃ bhavedityāha - yathetipravṛttimutpādayed vai sā hi tatparatocyatealam atyantam | sā sādhaneṣvatyantapravṛttiḥtathā yadā vimuktyanyannāpekṣeta hi sarvathātīvramumukṣāyāṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ - yatheti | śītajalāderanyannāpekṣateeṣā vimukteranyatra doṣadṛṣṭyaiva jāyatetīvramumukṣāyāṃ kāraṇamāha - eṣeti | tīvramumukṣetyarthaḥdoṣadṛṣṭyā hi vairāgyaṃ viṣayaprītināśanamtatkramamāha - doṣadṛṣṭyeti | vairāgyaṃ viṣayavaimukhyamtatparatvaṃ sādhaneṣu pravṛttiratitīvrataḥ [k: tīvratā]tatparatāyā udayo jananaṃ yasmātiti dattātreyavaco niśamya bhārgavaḥ punaḥtīvramumukṣutvaṃ tīvrapravṛttidvāreṇaiva phalasādhakamityāha atitīvretibhagavan bhavatā proktaṃ satsaṅgo mūlakāraṇammūlakāraṇam ādikāraṇamkimādikāraṇaṃ mukhyaṃ tatprāptirvā kathaṃ bhavettat kathaṃ syādvinā hetoretanme vada vistarātnahītibhārgava śṛṇu te vakṣye śreyasaḥ paramodbhavamādikāraṇamiti yāvatsvātmanyeva jagaccitraṃ darpaṇapratibimbavatmāyāśaktervaibhavānmāhātmyād jagaccitram unmeṣayaditi yojayetanādyajñānasaṃcchannajīvānāṃ hitakāmyayāsaiva parā citirevatatra jīvāḥ svabhāvena vicitrakāmavāsanāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadanubhavād vāsanotpattiriti bhāvaḥasṛjat kāmyakarmāṇi phalacitrāṇi sarvaśaḥtathā ca kenāpi karmaparipākavaśena tukarmavāsanayākāmanāvaśataḥ kāmye karmaṇyabhimukho bhavetupasaṅgataḥ prāptaḥ | karmaṇyabhimukhaḥ pravṛttaḥtadaiśvarāṇi śāstrāṇi prasaṅgādavalokayetśaraṇīkuryād ityanvayaḥtatprasaṅgavaśāt kvāpi māhātymaṃ śṛṇuyāt kvacittasya prasādane bhūyat pravṛttirapi bhārgavapravṛttirbhūyātprāpnoti śreyaḥsopānapaṅktimatyantadurlabhāmśreyaḥprāptirityupasaṃharati - tasmāditikvacidutkṛṣṭapuṇyena cotkṛṣṭatapasāpi vāutkṛṣṭapuṇyena utkṛṣṭatapasā parameśvaraprītaye kṛtenatasmāt kāraṇavaicitryācchreyaḥprāptivicitratājñānavaicitryamiti bhāvaḥsādhanānāṃ tāratamyād vicitrā jñānināṃ sthitiḥsādhanasāmyaṃ nāstītyāha - sādhanānāmititasyālpasādhanenaiva jñānasiddhirbhavedalamalpā | alamatyantamapratibaddhā jñānasiddhiḥtasya svalpanimittena bhavejjñānaṃ mahattaramcirābhyāsaparipakvajñānasadṛśamtasya jñānaṃ jātamapi samācchāditakalpakamajñānanāśanāsamartham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ata eva jñānināṃ tu dṛśyate vividhā sthitiḥ| ata eva karmasaṃskārabhedena buddhisthiti bhedādevatasmād buddhau vāsanābhistvāvṛttestāratamyataḥrāma paśya sthiterbhedaṃ jñānināṃ tu parasparamjñānisthitibhedaḥ | etadeva udāharati - rāmetiteṣāṃ paśya sthiterbhedaṃ svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥsthitibhedaṃ sṛṣṭyāditatparatvaṃ sattvādiprākṛtaguṇaiḥsvabhāvaguṇamāhātmyaṃ bhinnameva tathāpi hiprasiddhatvāt | tathāpi viśuddhajñānitve'pievaṃ cittasvabhāvo'pi nānyabhāvaṃ prapadyatejñānasya svabhāvānabhibhāvakatvamāha - yathetidurvāsasaṃ candramasaṃ māṃ ca bhinnasthitiṃ gatamsvātmānaṃ codāharati - asmānitivasiṣṭhaṃ paśya karmiṣṭhaṃ sanakādīṃśca nyāsinaḥstrīdhanādiḥ | nyāsinaḥ saṃnyāsinaḥdaityapakṣasaṃśrayiṇaṃ guruṃ devasamāśrayambhārgavaṃ śukraṃ | kavayantaṃ kāvyaṃ racayantamjanakaṃ paśya rājānaṃ bharataṃ tyāginaṃ tathāvāgminaṃ vādakuśalam | bharato jaḍabharataḥrahasyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu bhārgavanandanakarmajā mūḍhatārūpā sā sarvebhyo mahattarātrividhā aparādhakarmakāmarūpā | sarvebhyaḥ aparādhakāmavāsanābhyaḥaparādhavihīnānāṃ teṣāṃ kāmādivāsanāḥkāmādivāsanā avilīnā [k: vilīnā] iti sambandhaḥtato vairāgyādikaṃ tu na teṣāmupayujyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: | ādinā doṣadarśanamsakṛcchravaṇamātreṇa mananaṃ dhyānameva cateṣāṃ jñānotpattikramamāha - sakṛditibhavanti jīvanmuktāste janakapramukhā ivatatkāle śravaṇakāle | tatpadaṃ pūrṇātmapadamkāmādivāsanāḥ samyak sūkṣmā nirmalabuddhibhiḥjñānāpratibandha(ka)tvādeva kāmakrodhādivāsanā na kṣapitāḥkāmādivāsanāḥ prāgvat pravartante nirantaramataḥ abhyāsena akṣapitatvātvidvadbhiste hi saṃproktā muktāśca bahumānasāḥbahumānasā uttamā bhavantīti śeṣaḥtasya jñānaṃ naiva bhavet śivoditamapi kvacityasyāparādharūpāpi karmarūpāpi vāsanājñānaṃ na syāt vāsanā svalpetyanvayaḥbahulaśravaṇaiśtadvad mananaiśca samādhibhiḥkāmātmakāḥ vāsanāḥ | bahuleti | bhūyaḥ kṛtaśravaṇādibhirityarthaḥtasya vyavahṛtiḥ svalpā tatrābhyāsaprakarṣataḥśārīranirvāhamātropayoginī [k: śarīra]jñāninastvīdṛśāḥ proktā madhyamā naṣṭamānasāḥīdṛśajñānino ye te madhyamā naṣṭamānasāḥvāsanāviralaṃ yasmādanaṣṭaṃ mānasaṃ bhavetvāsanāviralaṃ mano'naṣṭaṃ bhavetkevalajñāninastvete jīvanmuktāstathetarejñāninaḥprārabdhatantrāste proktā dehānte muktibhāginaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prārabdhatantrāḥ prārabdhā dhīnāḥmanobhūmau tu prārabdhabījaṃ bhogāṅkuraṃ bhavetprārabdhaṃ kiṃ bhavediti cet svata eva naśyatītyāha - mana itikusūlasthaṃ bījamiva vinaśyed naṣṭaśaktikamsadāśrayaliṅgadehanāśād videhamuktikāle naśyatīti bhāvaḥkāryāṇi kurute kvāpi bhavedaskhalito'pi cayugapadekakāleyathā gacchan vadan kurvan yugapallakṣyate janaḥadhyetṛṇāṃ bahūnāṃ ca yugapallakṣayed guruḥproktapuruṣeṣvityarthaḥ | udāharaṇāntaram - adhyetṝṇāmitirāma yaste hataḥ śatrurarjuno haihayādhipaḥayudhyadaskhalan kvāpi medhāvī dṛṣṭa eva te[k, kh: te nāsti] tvayāyathā kāryaṃ bahuvidhaṃ sādhayettadvadeva hitattatkarmasādhanānukūlavyāpārakramayuktamaviruddhā sarvadā syādyeṣāṃ te bahumānasāḥmanaso'nekatvād aviruddhetibhaved jñānāgninā dagdhaṃ bhūtaṃ bhūtaṃ punaḥ punaḥtadvilakṣaṇa] tu dvikṣaṇāvasthāyi bhavediti tātparyamtadvimarśaḥ phalaṃ proktaṃ kuto dagdhāṅkure phalamyathā prauḍho hi bālena saha khelan hi dṛśyatetannimittaharṣādirnāntarabhyudetīti sadṛṣtāntamāha - yathetievaṃ hṛṣyanti sīdanti kāryeṣu bahumānasāḥevaṃ teṣāṃ vyavahṛtau samā sarvatra saṃsthitiḥcetyarthaḥ | teṣām uttamajñāninām | samā anyakāryavat svakārye'pi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viruddhavāsanābhyāsanirodhāderabhāvataḥataḥ kecit karmaniṣṭhāḥ kāminaḥ krodhino'paretattadvāsanānuvṛtteḥsamanaskastatra yo vai mandajñānī nirūpitaḥsvarūpavittau no kiñcidbhāsate hi samādhiṣuharṣaviṣādādīti bhāvaḥnirvikalpasvarūpaṃ tu sarvāśrayatayā sadānirvikalpeti | sadā sphuratyeveti sambandhaḥtathā vikalpavikalaṃ sphuret proktadaśāsu caproktadaśāsu paricchinnajñānāntarālādidaśāsuye tadvimarśasaṃyuktāḥ sa teṣāmeva saṃsmṛtaḥkiñcidapūrvamiti dhyeyamviditaṃ nābhasaṃ nailyaṃ yathā bhūyo'valokanevedyasambandhavarjitaiva vittirityarthaḥ | etadevopapādayati - viditamitianyathā naiva bhedaḥ syāttattvātattvavibhāsayoḥpratibandhakatvakalpanāyā anyāyyatvātsambandhaḥ kutracidvā syājjñānināmata eva hivedyahīnā vittirbhavediti sambandhaḥamanaskasya sutarāṃ yataḥ sā conmanī daśāsthitirunmanī daśetyyucyatemanasaścalanaṃ tat syāt satyavedyasya saṅgatiḥsa sarvadā vyutthataśca samādhisthaśca bhārgavayugapat sambhavediti bhāvaḥ | ata evāha - sarvadetievametaddhi saṃproktaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ yadyat purā tvayāpurā brahmasabhāmadhye satyaloke'tipāvane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sanakādyā vasiṣṭhaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥsūkṣmeti | atisūkṣmavicārarūpaḥ | sanakādyāḥ samuditā ityanvayaḥcyavano vāmadevaśca viśvāmitro'tha gautamaḥdakṣaḥ sumantuḥ śaṅkhaśca likhito devalo'pi casarve samuditāstatra brahmasatre mahattarebrahmasatre jñānayajñaprasaṅgebrahmāṇaṃ tatra papracchur-ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva teteṣāṃ no vividhā bhāti sthitiḥ prakṛtibhedataḥprakṛtibhedataḥ prākṛtasaṃskārabhedātapare bhaktinirmagnāścānye karmasamāśrayāḥtadevāha - kecidititeṣu śreyān hi katama etanno vaktumarhasiteṣu samādhisthādiṣu | śreyān śreṣṭhaḥiti pṛṣṭo'vadad brahmā matvā'nāśvastamānasāngrahīṣyantīti mattveti bhāvaḥjānīyādimamarthaṃ tu sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥsaṅgamya devadeveśaṃ viṣṇunābhisamāgatam [k: viṣṇu nā]mahādevaṃ saṅgamya prāpyapraśnaṃ niśamya ca śivo jñātvā vidhimanogatamvidhimanogatam anāśvastā [k: śvāsā] ete madvaco na grahīṣyantītiprakṛtapraśnaviṣaye | nanviti sambhāvanādyotakaḥiti matvā pratyuvāca devadevo maheśvaraḥbhavediti matvāato vidyāṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyāyāmaḥ parameśvarīmpūrṇasvātantryayuktatvenāsmatsaṃśayacchedane samarthaiveti bhāvaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityuktā munayaḥ sarve vidhiviṣṇuśivaiḥ sahaśivenoktāḥevaṃ sarvairabhidhyātā tripurā ciccharīriṇīcintāmaṇistvaṃ samupaiṣi deva itiabhavad meghagambhīraniḥsvano gaganāṅgaṇeśabdaḥ | gaganāṅgaṇe ākāśapradeśematparāṇāṃ hi keṣāñcinna hīyetābhivāñchitamyeṣāṃ teṣām madbhaktānāmityarthaḥ | na hīyeta kālādyantaritaṃ na bhavetbrahmādayo'pi tadanu tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stavaiḥpraṇāmānantaramnamastubhyaṃ maheśāni śrīvidye tripureśvariśuddhacidadvayarūpā tathāsvarūpāpyanantasvātantryaśaktimattvādīśvarīvilāpayitrī sarvasya parameśvari te namaḥyogyatayotpādayitrītyādāvapi yojanīyamnavātmikā sadā tvaṃ vai yato nāsti jarā tavaetaccāśeṣavikārābhāvopalakṣakaṃ jñeyamasarvā'sarvagā'sārā'sarvajñā'sarvaharṣiṇīsāratvābhāva ityāha - asarvagā'sāretiadhastādūrdhvataḥ pārśve sarvataste namo namaḥnamaskurvanti ṛṣayaḥ - devīti | bhūyaḥ aparimitakṛtvaḥphalaṃ sādhanaṃ sādhakaṃ ca jñāne [k: jñānaṃ] siddhamdevyetat kramato brūhi bhūyastubhyaṃ namo namaḥprāptavyasiddhyantaramiti tātparyam | jñānasiddheṣu [k: jñānā]dayamānā ṛṣigaṇe spaṣṭārthaṃ paramaṃ vacaḥspaṣṭārtham asandigdham | paramamatisundaraṃ śravaṇānandanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amṛtaṃ hyāgamāmbhodheḥ samuddhṛtya dadāmi vaḥdadāmiutpannaṃ ca sthitaṃ līnaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhāsate sadāutpattyādibhāsanamitiyadyogināṃ nirvikalpaṃ vibhātyātmani kevalamdraṣṭṛmātrarūpeṇa bhāsata ityarthaḥyat subhaktairatiśayaprītyā kaitavavarjanātdvaitināmīdṛśyeva bhaktiriti sudhībhirvimarśanīyamvibhedabhāvamāhṛtya [k: māruhya] sevyate'tyantatatparaiḥtatparatvayutairityarthaḥyadabhāne na kiñcit syādyacchāstrairabhilakṣitamjagatkrīḍāparāyā mama paraṃ vāstavaṃ rūpamiti yojayetbrahmāṇḍānāmanekānāṃ bahirūrdhve sudhāmbudhaupañcabrahmamaye mañce rūpaṃ traipurasundaramtatsambandhi bhaktānugrahāya svasvātantryamātranimittāvabhāsitaṃ rūpamtathā sadāśiveśānau vidhiviṣṇutrilocanāḥanugrahatirodhānasṛṣṭisthitilayātmakapañcakṛtyādhikāriṇaḥyātudhānāḥ surā nāgā yakṣakimpuruṣādayaḥgaṇarūpāḥ | yātudhānādikiṃpuruṣāntāḥ pūjyā ityanvayaḥmama māyāvimūḍhāstu māṃ na jānanti sarvataḥ- mameti | tāḥ sarvā mūrtayo matsambandhinya eveti na jānantīti bhāvaḥna matto'nyā kācidasti pūjyā vā phaladāyinīsaṃvidatirikte durghaṭatvamityāha - na matta itimamaiśvaryamṛṣigaṇā aparicchinnamīritamsphurāmyanantajagadākāreṇa ṛṣipuṅgavāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dārakriyārthaṃ tasmai tāṃ hemalekhāṃ dadau muniḥsarvaṃ tayorabhiprāyam | tat tasmai kanyādānammuktācūḍo'tisantuṣṭo mahotsavavidhānataḥatha rājakumāro'pi tayā krīḍāparaḥ sadāhemalekhāṃ rājaputro bhogeṣvanatikāminīmkiṃ priye nānuraktāsi priye mayyanurāgiṇikiṃ bhogāste manoyogyā na santyatra kutastvidamkutaḥ kasmāddhetoḥ | bhogāḥ bhogasādhanāni | kuta idamaudāsīnyamtvayyāsaktivihīnāyāṃ kathaṃ me sukhadā ratiḥparasparāsaktyatiśayenaiva ratiḥ sukhadetyāśayaḥbhāṣitāpi mayā bhūyo na śṛṇoṣyeva kiñcanaanyagatamānasatvaṃ vā kathaṃ tvayā'vagatamiti cedāha - bhāṣitetikadā nāthāgataṃ ceti pṛcchasyaviditā yathācirāt kaṇṭhasaṃlagnamapi kadā āgatamiti pṛcchasimana āsajjate kasmānna kiñcidanumodasinā(a)numodasiyadā yadopagacchāmi paśyāmi ca tadā tadākathaṃ bhaveddāruyoṣāsaṅgatasyeva tadvadasarvathā tvāmanugato jyotsnāṃ kumudavat kilana ca tvāmananugato'smītyāha - na tavetiyena śuddhyettu maccittaṃ śāpitāsi mayā priyeevaṃ viṣayavimukhamīṣatsmitānanā prāha rājaputramaninditāaninditeti | na tasyā viditavedyāyā viṣayavaimukhyaṃ mauḍhyādineti bhāvaḥrājaputra śṛṇu vaco nāhaṃ tvayi virāgiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tātparyametanme mukhyamaiśvaryaṃ durghaṭārthavibhāvanamdurghaṭārthasya vibhāvanaṃ sampādanamsarvāśrayā sarvagatā cāpyahaṃ kevalā sthitā [k: citiḥ]bhūyo viditvā svātmānaṃ guroḥ śiṣyapadaṃ gatāsambandhaḥnirupādānasambhāraṃ sṛjāmi jagadīdṛśamsṛjāmina tad gaṇayituṃ śakyaṃ sahasravadanena vābhāvaḥjagadyātrā [k: dhātrā] vicitreyaṃ sarvataḥ saṃprasāritāparāparavibhedācca bahudhā cāpi tatphalamdhyānameva tu tatproktaṃ svapnarājyādisammitamsvapnarājyabhramatulyatvamiti dhyeyamaparaṃ cāpi vividhaṃ tatra mukhyaṃ tadeva hiuta yatkiñcinmukhyamiti cedāha - aparaṃ ceti | dvaitaṃ cetyarthaḥadvaitavijñānameva paravijñānamīritamparavijñānaṃ śreṣṭhavijñānamkathaṃ prāpyeta paramāṃ vidyāmadvaitasaṃjñikāmprāpyeta ? naiva prāpyeteti bhāvaḥ | vidyāṃ jñānamtasyāḥ śuddhadaśāmarśo dvaitāmarśābhibhāvakaḥtātparyamtadevānuvibhātaṃ syād vijñānamṛṣisattamāḥdehādyātmāvabhāsasya nāśanaṃ jñānamucyatevāmadevakarkaṭikādayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāsamānamapi kvāpi na vibhāyāt kathañcanajñānaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥavijñātaṃ naiva bhavet kadācilleśato'pi cadṛśyamavijñātaṃ na bhavet tadevādvaitavijñānamtadevādvaitavijñānaṃ paramaṃ tāpasottamāḥtathāvyavahārasambhavātvāyunevābhrajālāni vilīyante paraṃ hi tatjñānamsyurbhagnadaṃṣṭrāhiriva tadvijñānaṃ paraṃ smṛtamtatkāmādivāsanayā kṛtakarmaphalāsaṃśleṣātatyantābhayasaṃprāptirmokṣa ityucyate phalamkutaḥ syād dvaitasaṅkalpastamaḥ sūryodaye yathāpunastatpratibimbeṣu na dvitīyatvaniścaya evaṃ prakṛte'pīti bhāvaḥato yatphalamanyat syāttadbhayaṃ sarvathā bhavetbhayamevetyarthaḥsānte bhayaṃ sarvathaivābhayaṃ tasmāt kuto bhavetataḥ sānte naśvare sarvathaiva bhayaṃ bhavet | tato'bhayaṃ sāntāt kuto bhavetphalayogo'pi tasmāddhi vinaśyediti niścayaḥsambandho'pi naśyedevatadevābhayarūpaṃ tu phalaṃ sarve pracakṣatejñātā jñānaṃ jñeyamapi phalaṃ caikaṃ yadā bhavetbhavet tadetyanvayaḥjñānaṃ vikalpasaṅkalpahānaṃ mauḍhyavivarjitamśuddhasvarūpasphuraṇaṃ jñānamiti bhāvaḥupalakṣaka [k: upadeśaka] evāto guruḥ śāstraṃ ca netarat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tayorvyāpārāntaramastītyarthaḥjñātṛjñānajñeyagato yāvad bhedo'vabhāsaterūpamityāha - jñātreti | saṅkalpāvarjanena yāvadbhedo'vabhāsateyadā bhedo vigalito jñātrādīnāṃ mithaḥ sthitaḥvigalito bhavet tadā jñātrādīnāṃ satyasvarūpasampattirityanvayaḥjñātrādiphalaparyantaṃ na bhedo vastuto bhavettasmānna jñātrādiphalāntānāṃ vastuto bheda ityāha - jñātrādītiato'pūrvaṃ labhyamatra phalaṃ nāstyeva kiñcanayāvadbhāti bhavettāvat saṃsāro hyacalopamaḥsaṃsāro vilayaṃ yāyācchinnābhramiva vāyunāmahāsamudāyādvicchinnamabhrakhaṇḍamityarthaḥtatparatve tu saṃpūrṇe nānyat sādhanamiṣyatephalasādhanāyopayujyatetasmāttātparyameva syānmukhyaṃ mokṣasya sādhanamyastātparyeṇa saṃyuktaḥ sarvathā mukta eva saḥtatsādhanasyāvaśyaphalaparyantatvād muktaprāya evetyarthaḥbuddhinairmalyabhedena ciraśīghravyavasthitiḥyairjanāḥ satataṃ tvevaṃ pacyante ghorasaṃsṛtaupacyanta iti | duḥkhamanubhavantīti tātparyamtṛtīyo jāḍyatā proktā tridhaivaṃ dos'saṃgrahaḥśākhāsvābhu] iti bhāvaḥmokṣo'sti nāsti vetyādyaḥ saṃśayaḥ samudāhṛtaḥetaccopalakṣaṇaṃ muktasya punarāvṛttirasti nāsti vetyādeḥetaddvayaṃ tu tātparye mukhyaṃ syāt pratibandhakamatropāyo mukhyatamo mūlacchedo na cāparaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kathaṃ niścayodaya iti cet sādhanamāha - atreti | niścaye ityarthaḥtatparityajya sattarkāvartanasya prasādhanetataḥ śraddhāsamudayādanāśvāsaḥ praṇaśyatiśradhetyucyate | praṇaśyati nivartatekāmādivāsanāviṣṭā buddhirnaiva pravartatetamarthaṃ naiva gṛhṇātipuraḥsthitaṃ na paśyecca śrotroktaṃ śṛṇuyānna castrīdhanādeḥ | śrotroktaṃ karṇe uccaritamapi śabdaṃ na śṛṇuyātkāmādivāsanā tasmājjayed vairāgyasampadāsampattyā jayettatra kāmo mūlabhūtastannāśe nahi kiñcanakiñcana krodhādikaṃ bhavediti śeṣaḥāśā hi kāmaḥ saṃprokta etanme syāditi sthitātataḥ kāmasya mukhyatvāt | kāmasvarūpamāha - āśeti | iti sthitā āśādṛḍhavairāgyayogena sarvāṃ tāṃ pravināśayetsūkṣmāṃ ca | tāṃ vāsanāmvaimukhyaṃ viṣayebhyaśca vāsanā nāśayeditiviṣayasvarūpasyānusandhānābhāvo dehayātrānupayuktādhikāsevanaṃ caasādhyaḥ so'bhyāsamukhaiḥ sarvathā ṛṣisattamāḥabhyāsādyairnivartayitumasādhyaḥtajjāḍyaṃ hi mahān doṣaḥ puruṣārthavināśanaḥpuruṣārthasyājñānanivṛttermokṣasya vā | vināśanaḥ pratibandhakaḥsevāyāstāratamyena jāḍyaṃ tasya harāmyahamṛte vinābhavettasya phalaprāptirjāḍyasaṃyuktacetasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti vivekaḥupayāti ca yo bhaktyā sarvadā māmakaitavātanavacchinnānurāgeṇa | akaitavādakāpaṭyāt niṣkāmanayeti bhāvaḥyastu māmīśvarīṃ sarvabuddhiprasarakāriṇīmsarveṣāṃ buddheḥ prasaraḥ pravṛttiḥ tatkaraṇaśīlāmpade pade vihanyeta phalaṃ prāpyeta vā na vāvighnairhato bhavet | phalaprāptāvapi saṃśaya evetyāha - phalamitievaṃ tātparyavāneva sādhakaḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥmukhyasādhaka ityarthaḥsiddhirātmavyavasitirdehānātmatvabhāvanātātparyamtadabhāvanamātraṃ tu siddhirmauḍhyavivarjitamprakṛtilayarūpasāṃkhyādimokṣavyāvṛttyarthamiti jñeyamata eva tu samprāptā mahānarthaparamparādehādyavivekādeva sarvairajñaiḥ prāptātanmātrātmavyavasitiḥ sarvasaṃśayanāśinītadvivekena tadabhāvanameva siddhiritisiddhayaḥ khecaratvādyā aṇimādyāstathaiva cakhecaratvaparakāyapraveśādyā aṇimalaghimādyāḥtāḥ sarvāstu paricchinnāḥ siddhayo deśakālataḥbrahmāṇḍāntarbrahmakalpaparyantameva sattvamiti deśakālaparicchinnāḥsvātmavidyāsādhaneṣu tāḥ sarvāḥ supratiṣṭhitāḥsiddhayaḥ | supratiṣṭhitāḥ jñānasādhanaikadeśasādhyā evetyarthaḥkiṃ tābhirindrajālātmasiddhitulyābhirīhitamityarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kiyantyetāḥ siddhayo vai kālakṣapaṇahetavaḥsiddhayaḥ kiyanti jñānāntarāyatvena kālakṣapaṇahetavaḥyayā'tyantaśokanāśo bhavedānandasāndratāānandasāndratā ānandaikarasatāiyamātmajñānasiddhirvividhābhyāsabhedataḥvaktumupakramate - iyamiti | abhyāsasya bhedatastāratamyātsaṃkṣepastu trividhā cottamā madhyamā'dhamātasyābhyāsaḥ tadekākāravimarśadhārānurūpaḥ paripākabheda iti bhāvaḥmedhayā ca mahābhyāsād vyāpāraśatasaṃkulābuddhyetyarthaḥ | abhyāsa āvartanādirūpaḥsamāhitasya vyāpāre'samāhitasya cānyadāmadhyamāyā sadā hyanusandhānayogādeva bhavettathātathā askhalitāevamevātmavijñānasiddhiruktā tridharṣayaḥadhamā | dṛṣṭāntamupapādya dārṣṭāntike yojayati - evamevetianyadā tadvarjane vā sarvadā pratisandhitaḥsyādityanvayaḥatrottamaiva saṃsiddheḥ parā kāṣṭhā nirūpitāuttamaiva jñānasiddheḥ parā kāṣṭhāvicārakṣaṇatulyeva siddhiḥ sā paramottamāśarīrādyahaṃbhāvavarjanena śuddhacinmātrāhaṃbhāvarūpāyadā pravṛttiḥ siddheḥ sā parā kāṣṭhā samīritāsaṃskārodbodhena yadā pravṛttiḥavyāhatā yadā siddhistadā kāṣṭhāṃ samāgatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃvedanātmani parame dehādyanavacchinne avyāhatā'vicchinna sthitiḥdvaitaṃ tadā hi sā siddhiḥ pūrṇatāmabhisaṅgatāsthitistadā hi sā siddhiḥ pūrṇatāmabhisaṅgatājāgarādāviti | pūrvottarānusandhānasya vicchedānnidritavat sthitiḥvyavahāraparo nityaṃ na samādhiṃ vimuñcatisamādhiviccheda iti bhāvaḥjñānināṃ vividhānāṃ ca sthitiṃ jānāti sarvadāvividhānām uttamamadhyamādīnāṃ sarvadā vidyamānāṃ sthitiṃ jānātisaṃśayo vāpi kāmo vā yasya nāstyeva leśataḥsaṃśaya iti | tanmūlāvidyāyā naṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥsarvaṃ sukhañca duḥkhañca vyavahārañca jāgatamdarśanasparśanādirūpaṃ jagatsambandhiatyantaṃ baddhamātmānaṃ muktaṃ cāpi prapaśyatiyaḥ paśyan bandhajālāni sarvadā svātmani sphuṭamtdasatyatvaniścayānmikṣaṃ nāpekṣatesiddhottamo'hameveha na bhedastvāvayoḥ kvacitkvāpi kadācidapi | siddhottamaṃ stauti - siddhottama iti | iha jagatietanmayoktaṃ vijñāya na kvacit parimuhyatiśrutvaitadṛṣayaḥ sarvaṃ sandehamapahāya cavidyāgītāmupasaṃharati - ityuktveti | apahāya tyaktvāvidyāgītā mayaiṣā te proktā pāpaughanāśinīpāpaughānāśinīvidyāgītā'tyuttameyaṃ sākṣādvidyānirūpitāsamāyatvasambhavāditi dhyeyamsaṃsāratimirāmbhodhau majjatāṃ taraṇirbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: - saṃsāreti | taraṇirnaukā sūryo vāavidyājālavibhrāntermuktaprāyo babhūva havidyamānatvādāha - muktaprāya itibhagavan brūhi vijñānasādhanaṃ [kh: vijñānaṃ] suviniścitamkiñcit papracchajñānināṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cāpi yena jñāsyāmi tān drutamvyavahāraṃ kurvatāṃ cāpyanāsaktaṃ manaḥ kathamanāsaktaṃ vāsanārahitamevamatrisutaḥ pṛṣṭo jamadagnisutena vaietatsarvaṃ sādhanādikamśṛṇu rāma pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ jñānasādhanamsamyakpraśnena bhaktiyuktena santuṣṭaḥ | rahasyaṃ śāstreṣvaprasiddhamyaḥ sarvabhāvataḥ svātmadevatāmupasaṅgataḥsvātmadevatāṃ svāntaryāmitayā sthitāmetat sarvottamaṃ rāma proktaṃ jñānasya sādhanamtasya proktadevatātatparasya | etat devatātatparatvam | rahasyaśāstreṣu proktametadvihāyānyadatra na samyak phaladaṃ bhavetjñānaṃ na bhavediti bhāvaḥvijñānaṃ kevalacitiryā sarvasyāvabhāsikāphalabhūtaṃ vijñānam | sarvāvabhāsikā kevalā sāmānyā citiḥvicārāt tadapohena tatsvarūpopalakṣaṇamsvarūpasyopalakṣaṇaṃ so'hamiti pratyabhijñānaṃ syātbhaktānāmanyaparatāhānena tatparatvataḥdevatāparāṇāṃ kathaṃ sulabhamiti cedāha - bhaktānāmitidevatātatparastvevaṃ bhūtvā svalpānyasādhanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vairāgyādyanyasādhanāni yasyanirūpayan sadā rāma samāveśaṃ samāpnuyāttadākāracittatāmśivatāmāpya taccittaṃ harṣodvegavivarjitamśuddhacidātmaikarūpatām | ata eva harṣodvegavivarjitamkarotyuttamavijñānī jīvanmuktapadasthitaḥcidātmākāratāṃ na parityajatīti bhāvaḥśreṣṭhaṃ sādhanametattu nānyadetatsamaṃ bhavetbhaktiyogapūrvakadevatātatparatayā saha svātmatattvanirūpaṇasamamjñānināṃ lakṣaṇaṃ rāma durvijñeyaṃ bhavet khaludvitīyapraśnottaraṃ vaktumāha - jñānināmitina nirūpayituṃ śakyaṃ lakṣituṃ vā'paraiḥ kvacitlakṣituṃ lakṣaṇayuktatvena jñātumdehavastrabhūṣaṇādyairevamanyairna vedyateatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - yatheti | jñānitvaṃ na vedyateyathā saṃsvāditarasarasajñatvaṃ hi bhārgavavidvatteti | rasasambandhi rasajñatvamvedyate hi yathā svasya mārgaḥ sūkṣmapipīlakaiḥjñānilakṣaṇaṃ jñānimātravedyamiti bhāvaḥsūkṣmalakṣmāṇi cānyāni durvijñeyāni vai paraiḥparaiḥ ajñānibhiḥjñānināmiva cānyaistu kartuṃ śakyo hi lakṣyateanyairajñānibhirdāmbhikaiḥsthirībhavati yatteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tat prakīrtitamsthirībhavati aprayatnena sthitaṃ bhavati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: neṣadviśeṣituṃ śaktau vidyāt taṃ jñāniṣūttamambhavediti tātparyamasandigdhaḥ prativaded jhaṭiti jñāniṣūttamaḥnirūpaṇe hi na sandeho nāpi kālavilamba iti prasiddhamevanirūpaṇe hyavaimukhyaṃ jñānino lakṣaṇaṃ hi tatjñānaprakriyānirūpaṇe avimukhatā sonmukhatāmahāpatsvapi śāntātmā sa bhavejjñāniṣūttamaḥśucicittatā kāmādirahitatā | śāntātmā udvegahīnaḥsvātmanastu parīkṣāyāṃ susthirāṇi na saṃśayaḥparajñānitvalakṣaṇānīti bhāvaḥyathā parīkṣaṇe'nyasya nipuṇaḥ saṃpravartatesūkṣmārthavicāracaturaḥyadā'nyaguṇadoṣāṇāmavicāraṇatatparaḥparaguṇadoṣavicāraparasya svaguṇādyanusandhānaṃ na bhavediti bhāvaḥtadā sarvasādhānānāṃ prāptyā siddhimupaiṣyatiguṇānāmupādānena jñānasādhanasampattyā siddhimeṣyatisvātmanastu parīkṣāyāmupayuktāni sarvathāproktārthamupasaṃharati - evamitiyato ye jñānino'tyantaśuddhasvāntā bhṛgūdvahaataḥ pūrvavāsanānurodhavyāpāratatparāḥparīkṣaṇīyā iti bhāvaḥjñāninastu tatparīkṣāṃ kuryurabhyāsavaibhavātmandajñānavatāṃ dehasaṃsthā mūḍhasamaiva hidehābhimānastannimittavyāpārastatphalaṃ ca | mūḍhasamā ajñānitulyāyāvad vimarśanaparāstāvatte pūrṇarūpiṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kevalasvavacasi tasyānāśvāsasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | idaṃ vakṣyamāṇamvicāraparamā nityaṃ nāntametyatra me matiḥmukhyadhyeyo yasyāḥ | antaṃ niścayamnaitajjānāmi tattvaṃ me vaktumarhasi tattvataḥpriyāpriyasvarūpasya tattvaṃ yāthārthyamnūnaṃ striyo mūḍhadhiya iti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥyatasteṣāṃ dṛśyate hi priyeṣvapriyakeṣu caiti bhāvaḥsukhaṃ yasmāt tat priyaṃ syāt duḥkhaṃ yasmāttadapriyamśrutvā priyavacaḥ prāha hemalekhā punaḥ priyamtathāpyahaṃ bodhanīyā tvayā samyagvimarśināsadvimarśanaṃ samyagvicāraḥtvayā bhogeṣu satataṃ bhavāmyanudinaṃ tataḥbhogeṣvāsaktā bhavāmi | tataḥ bodhanānantarampriyāpriye vinirdiṣṭe tvayā sūkṣmavimarśinātallakṣaṇaṃ dūṣayitumanuvadati - rājannityādijanayedatra tat kasmāt pratiṣṭhā'dhyavasāyinīadhyavasāyinī niścayavatītathā deśavibhedenāpyākārasya vibhedataḥtadeva nirūpayati - yata iti | pṛthakphalasya sukhādeḥ prada evahimoṣṇadeśabhedena priyaścāpriya eva caetadeva vivicyāha - śītetiathāpyadhikabhāvenālpabhāvenaivamīritaḥsādhakatvena priyo'priyaścaathāpyevaṃ mahārājo dāraputradhanairvṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrṇacinmātrarūpiṇaḥsukhaduḥkhajuṣo'tyantaṃ paśutulyatayā sthitāḥvicāravimukhāstyaktānusandhānāḥteṣāṃ yā sā paśudaśā sadvimarśāntarālagāpūrṇadaśāntarālagā paśusthitirna bandhāyetyāha - teṣāmitilākṣārasairyadā vastraprāntayugmaṃ surañjitam- lākṣetievaṃ tasya vyavahṛtiścidāmarśanamadhyagābandhanāyeti bhāvaḥmadhyavijñānināṃ dehasaṃyogo nāsti sarvathāmadhyajñānināṃ sthitimāha - madhyetisa nāsti madhyavijñānavato rāma kadācanasadā samāhitasvānto vyavahāro na tasya hiniruddham | tasya madhyajñāninaḥyathā kaścit suṣuptistho vāsanāmātrataḥ kvacitcettasyābhāsatvāditi sadṛṣṭāntamāha - yatheti | vāsanā saṃskāraḥyathā ca madirāmatto vadan kurvanna veda vaidṛṣṭāntāntaram - yathetikiñcit kadācit kurvaṃśca na vijānāti tatpunaḥnānusandhatteyastūttamaḥ suvijñānī [k: ttamaḥ sa vi] dehastasyāpi nāsti histanyapāne pravṛttirevamiti bhāvaḥ | uttamasya sthitimāha - yastvitiyathā rathena vyāpāraṃ kurvan na rathadehakaḥcedāha - ratheti | etadevopapādayati - yathetina dehī nāpi vyāpārī śuddhasaṃvedanātmakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na dehīti | dehatadvyāpārayostyaktābhimāna iti tātparyamyathā strīveṣito nāṭye [kh: nāndye] dvairūpyamupasaṅgataḥasau uttamajñānī | atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - yatheti | strīveṣitaḥ puruṣaḥevameṣa jagatkrīḍātatparo nirmalāśayaḥacalasthitiretasya vicārasya prakarṣataḥniṣprakampaniścayarūpaphalaparyavasāyitāatra te śṛṇu vakṣyāmi saṃvādaṃ jñāninormithaḥvijñānaprakriyāprasaṅge | sarvasandehanāśanaṃ saṃvādamsa vipāśāmanu purīmadhyāsīdamṛtābhidhāmvipāśāmanu vipāśānadītīre sthitāṃ purīmrukmāṅgadahemāṅgadau janakasyātivallabhaumanīṣiṇau nirmalaprajñau | vallabhau priyauhemāṅgado'tivijñāno jñānināmuttamo'bhavatmṛgayārthaṃ vasanteṣu yayaturgahanaṃ vanamvasanteṣviti | bahuvacanaṃ bahudinabodhakam | gahanaṃ vanaṃ mahāraṇyamhatvā'tyantapariśrāntāvāsādya hradamāsthitaukañcana hradamsamastaśāstrasārajño [k: pārajño] vidvadbhirvivadatyalamnyagrodhe vaṭavṛkṣe sthita iti śeṣaḥ | alam atyantamrukmāṅgadaścāramukhād niśamya vādakautukīnirjitastena vādeṣu gṛhīto brahmarakṣasātatra nyagrodhapradeśe | tena brahmarākṣasenabho brahmarākṣasainaṃ tvaṃ na bhakṣayitumarhasirukmāṅgado gṛhītaḥ | taṃ brahmarākṣasam | enaṃ madbhrātaramhemāṅgadavacaḥ śrutvā provāca brahmarākṣasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: astya tvayā gṛhītasyāvarajaṃ mām | nau bhrātarauetena pāraṇāṃ kṛtvā vivadāmi tvayā sahaetena tvadbhrātrā | pāraṇām upavāsasamāptimatyantaṃ tarpito bhūyāmiti me nṛpa niścayaḥkadācidāgataḥ śiṣyo vasiṣṭhasya tu bhakṣitaḥbhakṣitaḥitaḥ paraḥ bhakṣayitvā manuṣyaṃ brahmarākṣasabhūyaḥ samprārthito mahyaṃ prāyacchad varamuttamamiti śapta ityanvayaḥ | śāpaprāpteḥ paścāt | bhūyaḥ bahukṛtvaḥiti tadvādavijitān bhakṣayāmi tatastvahamtadanantaram prāpta ityanvayaḥbhakṣayitvā tato vāde tvāṃ vijeṣyāmi bhūmipatataḥ tasmātcitaḥ]datvā tubhyaṃ tadenaṃ tu mocayāmi sahodaramkiñcidapi yatprāpya | enaṃ mad bhrātaraṃ taddattvāśṛṇu rājannāsti tadvai kiñcid yenainamutsṛjeito'dhikaṃ priyaṃ kiñcinnāstītyāha - śṛṇvitikintvekaḥ samayo me'sti praśnā me hṛdi saṃsthitāḥsamayaḥ pratijñā | tamevāha - praśna ityāditato hemāṅgadaḥ prāha pṛccha tān saṃvadāmi tetān praśnān | tat praśnottaraprāptyā | tān praśnāngūḍhapraśnān krameṇaiva tadvakṣye śṛṇu bhārgavagūḍhapraśnān guptottaravatpraśnānsā kiṃrūpā sthitā kutra vadaitannṛpaputraka
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāneva praśnānāha - ākāśādityādi | sā pṛṣṭarūpāsphuradrūpā svātmasaṃsthā śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasasarvāntaratvādagocaratvācca sūkṣmatvam | svātmasaṃsthā svarūpa eva sthitāsphurattvaṃ kiṃ kimātmā ca vadaitannṛpanandanavitatā sūkṣmāpyekā ca [g: ca nāsti] kathaṃ bhavetsphurattvamātmā ca citiḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasacinmātrameva | na tato'dhikamiti tātparyamupalabdhyā ca kiṃ vā syād vadaitannṛpanandanaupalabdhyā janirna syācchṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasasvātmacinmātrākāratāsampattiḥ | etena mūḍhasamādhirvyāvṛttaḥjanirvā'pi bhavet kā sā vadaitannṛpanandanajanirdehātmatābuddhiḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasadṛśyānunmukhatvamjaniḥ kathaṃ vā samprāptā vadaitannṛpanandanakasmānnimittāt | kena karaṇena [k: kāra]janiḥ kartṛtvābhimānācchṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasaātmanā svenaiva karaṇāntaranairapekṣyeṇeti [k: kāra] yāvatko vā kartṛtvābhimāno vadaitannṛpanandanatadvāsanābhimānaḥ syācchṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasasaṃskāraḥtasyā'pi kiṃ kāraṇaṃ syād vadaitannṛpanandanatasya avivekanāśakasya | tasyāpi tatkāraṇasyāpitatkāraṇaṃ doṣadṛṣṭiḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasaviṣayadoṣadṛṣṭiḥdoṣadṛṣṭiśca kā proktā vadaitannṛpanandana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: duḥkhabuddhiḥ sā hi dṛśye śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasados'dṛṣṭiḥtatra vā kiṃ nidānaṃ syād vadaitannṛpanandanaetatsarvaṃ vicārādikam | kena sādhanena | nidānaṃ mūlakāraṇamnidānaṃ satsaṅga eva śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasasaḥ anugrahaḥsantaśca kīdṛśāḥ proktā vadaitannṛpanandanasantaḥ śāntā dayāvantaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasajagaddhātrī jaganniyantrī | tatparatvaṃ tatpravaṇatvamsadā dainyayutaḥ ko vā vadaitannṛpanandanaāśāgrastaḥ sadā dīnaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasaadīnaḥ [k: ahīnaḥ] sarvadā kaḥ syād vadaitannṛpanandanajñātajñeyastvadīnātmā śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasajñātajñeyo jñānīniṣkriyasya kriyā kā syād vadaitannṛpanandanavideho deharahitaḥtatkriyā niṣkriyasyoktā śṛṇu tvaṃ brahmarākṣasacābhimānābhāvādvideho niṣkiryaśca jīvanmuktaḥetāvaduktvā nṛpate mocaya drutamagrajametāvat caramaṃ praśnatrayamuktametad brahmarakṣo muñca madbhrātaraṃ drutamtadviṣayakavyavahārasyāsambhavitvamrukmāṅgadaṃ tataḥ paścādabhavad brāhmaṇo hi saḥetat praśnottaram | saḥ brahmarākṣasaḥpapracchatū rājasutau ko bhavāniti śaṅkitau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmarakṣaso brāhmaṇarūpatāṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkitau saṃśayaṃ prāptaupāṇḍityādiguṇairviśrutaḥsabhāsu nirjitā bhūyo mayā vidyābhimāninātato vidvajjayātśuṣkatarkaikanipuṇa ātmavidyāvicāraṇesamādhānavacastasya vahvāgamasubṛṃhitamsaḥ aṣṭakaḥadhikṣipto'pi bahudhā mayā rājasabhāgataḥsamādhānavacanamapi dūṣayitvā | adhikṣepaḥ tiraskāraḥkāśyapo māṃ krodhavaśāccchaśāpa nṛpasaṃsadiaṣṭakaḥ śāntaḥyatastasmācciraṃ kālaṃ brahmarakṣo bhaviṣyasiasthāne adhikṣepanimittābhāve'pivepamānaḥ praṇamyāśu cāṣṭakaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥvepamānaḥ śāpabhītyā kampitaḥśāpasyāntaṃ dadau mahyaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇuantaṃ śāpamokṣāvadhi | tat śāpāntamsthāpitān kevalaistarkairyadaikaḥ prativakṣyatividvāntacchāpādadya [k: datha] te muktaścirāya nṛpanandanatacchāpāt tādṛśāṣṭakaśiṣyaśāpāt | te tvattaḥityuktastena vipreṇa vismito'bhūnnṛpātmajaḥtat tasmāddhetoḥvasumantaṃ bodhayitvā samyak prāgāt puraṃ svakamanuyuktaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ | tena brāhmaṇena samyak pṛṣṭārthān bodhayitvā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhārgava tvayāupasaṃharati - etaditipunaḥ papracchāvadhūtakuleśaṃ praśrayāśrayaḥbhārgavapraśnamavatārayati - śrutveti | praśrayo vinayaḥhemāṅgadena kiṃ proktametanme kṛpayā vadaiti pṛṣṭaḥ punaḥ prāha dattātreyo dayāparaḥbhavedityarthaḥtataḥ papraccha vasumān hemāṅgadamupasthitamtena rājakumāreṇa pratibhāṣitam upa samīpe sthitamahamaṣṭakayogīśāt tadajñāsiṣamāditaḥtat parātmatattvam | ajñāsiṣaṃ jñātavān | āditaḥ ādaukintu te jñātatattvasya kathaṃ sthitiriyaṃ bhavette tava | iyaṃ mṛgayādivyavahārarūpādhvāntaprakāśayoryadvat sthitirekatra sambhavetsambhavedevametadapītyarthaḥityāpṛṣṭaḥ prāha hemāṅgadastaṃ brāhmaṇottamametad jñānini viruddhaṃ vyavaharaṇamvyavahāreṇa kiṃ jñānaṃ bādhyate svātmasambhavamkṣepaḥ] | na bādhyata ityarthaḥpuruṣārthasya lābhaḥ syāt svāpnajñānasamena vaibhāvaḥtajjñānaṃ bādhyate tena kathaṃ tanme samīrayavyavahārasya jñānabādhakatvamsaṅkalpād vyavahāro hi jñāne sarvaḥ [k: sarvaṃ] prakāśatedvitīyaṃ nirasitumāha - saṅkalpāditi | svarūpabhūte jñāne
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtārtho bandhanirmukto bhavatīti suniścayaḥpunarabādhitavikalpānudayenāprāmāṇyagrahānudayāditi bhāvaḥtasmād vyavahāreṇa bādhābhāvasya spaṣṭatvāt | iti śrutvā punaḥ prāhasvarūpaṃ nirvikalpaṃ hi saṃvedanamihocyate- svarūpamitivikalpa eva hi bhrāntiryathā rajjau bhujaṅgamaḥvikalpābhāso'narthāvaha iti bhāvaḥgaganaṃ na nīlamiti jānatāmapitāvataiva tu tajjñānaṃ na bhrāntirabhidhīyate[k: gaganatva] nīlaṃ nabha iti jñānamhataprāmāṇyajīvaṃ tajjñānaṃ mṛtamahāhivatabhijñasyānabhijñasya cāpyato'sti bhidā tayoḥjñānayorbhedo'stijñānināṃ jñānameva syāt sarvo'pi vyavahārakaḥnārthāvahaḥ] sarvo'pi vyavahāra iti bhāvaḥabhijñānāmato bhūyo nahi bhrānteḥ samudbhavaḥjñānamātrarūpatvena na tasya bhrāntitvamiti bhāvaḥdoṣe'na janitaṃ kasmādvilīyed jñānamātrataḥtadvilayakāraṇatvābhāva iti tātparyamjagadābhāsa eṣastu karmados'samudbhavaḥsamāpte karmaṇi tataḥ śiṣyedadvayacinmayamtātparyamiti śrutvā punarvipraḥ papraccha nṛpanandanambhrāntisambhavaḥ | karmaśeṣādvaitābhāsa iti śrutvājñānāgnisaṃsparśane'pi karmatūlaḥ kathaṃ sthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānināṃ kathaṃ karmaśeṣa ityākṣipati - aho itibrahman śṛṇu pravakṣyāmi trividhaṃ karma jñānināmsambandhaḥhatoditaṃ ceti tatra naśyed jñānādamadhyamamdvayaṃ naśyetkālena pācitaprāyaṃ pakvaṃ karma samīritamphalapradonmukhameva bhavediti tātparyamkṛtaṃ hatoditaṃ viddhi jñānāddhatasamudbhavātsamudbhavādityarthaḥāvegaṃ muktaśaravattiṣṭhatyeva phalapradamtiṣṭhatyeveti | na jñānena naśyatīti bhāvaḥsthito'pi bhrāntitulyo'pi na bhrāntiḥ phalabhedataḥcedāha - phalabhedata iti | arthakriyābhedādityarthaḥjñānināṃ phalabhāsanambhāvaḥśaśaśṛṅgasamaṃ brahman nahi tatphalamucyatetaiḥrāgādyutpādakatenāntaḥ sthitaṃ bhavatiato na puṣṭaṃ mandānāmārabdhajanitaṃ phalamātmānusandhitaśchinnaṃ bhavati | ato'jñānināmiva na tatpuṣṭaṃ bhavatimaśakādikṛtaṃ duḥkhamiva tat sūkṣmatāṃ gatammaśakamandamārutakṛtaduḥkhasukhavat sūkṣmatāṃ prāptaṃ bhavatidagdharajjuriva bhavet sthitātmajñānavaibhavātbhāvaḥhṛṣyan viṣīdaṃśca bhūyo nāntarvikṛtimāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: strīveṣam | putrodbhavabhartṛviyogādyabhinayaiḥ hṛṣyan viṣīdanna phalaiḥ spṛśyate tasmāttatphalaṃ śaśaśṛṅgavattātparyamato dehātmabhūtāste dṛśyasatyavimarśanāḥdehādimayaṃ manyamānāḥ dṛśye satyatvavimarśanaṃ yeṣāṃ tejagaccāsatyato dṛṣṭaṃ tathāpyabhyāsamāndyataḥvismṛtau nimittamāha - abhyāsamāndyata itijagataḥ satyatābhāsaṃ madhye madhye samāyayuḥmadhye prāgvad jñānotpatteḥ pūrvamiva samāyayuḥvāsanaivaṃ satyamithyājñānayośca parasparamparasparaṃ militeti sambandhaḥsame'pi vāsane caite nahi tulye mahīsuracennetyāha - same'pīti | samānānuvṛttike apītyarthaḥna ca mithayavāsanayā bādhyate satyavāsanābādha ityāha - na cetitato mithyāvāsanāṃ tu viniścitya bhramātmikāmtato na bādhitā satyavāsanā bhavati kvacitvāsanāmupaiti samprāpnoti | tato mithyāvāsanāyā bhrāntitvaniścayātavismṛtasyecchayaiva mithyājñānaṃ kvacidbhavetyathā yathā tatparaḥ syāttathā'vismṛtirucchritāsamādhyabhyāsaparaḥ | ucchritā dṛḍhā'vismṛtiḥuttamasya punarbrahman samādhivyavahārayoḥuttamajñānisthitimāha - uttamasyetiyaḥ samādhiparo madhyastasya yā'vismṛtiḥ sthitā- ya iti | avismṛtiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvasukhasādhane satyapītyarthaḥ | mahārājo muktācūḍaḥato'khilaviṣayāṇāṃ sambhūya sukhasādhanatvamiti cedāha - yo'yamiti- tatrāpīti | tatsukhaviṣaye'pītyarthaḥduḥkhaṃ tu dividhaṃ proktaṃ bāhyamāntaramityapivibhajati - duḥkhaṃ tvitiāntaraṃ mānasaṃ proktaṃ tacca vāñchāsamudbhavamdhātavo vātapittādayaḥ | ādinā sphoṭābhighātādiḥvāñchaiva duḥkhaviṭapibījaṃ sudṛḍhaśaktikamindrādayo'pi vibudhāḥ svarnivāsāḥ sadoditāḥpratīkartumasamarthā eva devā ityāśayaḥtad duḥkhameva jānīhi yat kṛmiṣvapi sambhavetsvalpavāñchāsammilitaṃ nṛṇāṃ kiṃ syāt sukhaṃ vadakāryākṣamatvāt tanna sukhābhāsamapīti bhāvaḥsukhī bhavediha tadā ko hi na syāt sukhī vadakiñcit srakcandanādiyadi śītaladehaḥ syāttadā so'pi sukhī bhavetpāṭīrabinduścandanabinduḥtatraivāṅgasya vis'mabandhād duḥkhaṃ bhavennanuanantaraṃ bhāravāhapaśoriva pariśramaḥbhāravāhapaśupariśrāntivatyāvat sukhaṃ priyāsaṅge nāḍīsaṃghaṭṭasambhavamevamasya duḥkhayuktatvāttatsaukhyaṃ kathaṃ paśyasiyattato hyatiriktaṃ te dṛṣṭasaundaryasambhavamadhikam | dṛṣṭasaundaryasambhavaṃ saundaryadarśanajampurā kaścidrājasuto manmathādhikasundaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yastūttamo'pi svācchandyāt prārabdhavaśato'pi vātāapyavismṛtiramlānaivetyarthaḥvastutaḥ śṛṇu bhūdeva madhyamottamajñānināmtayorna prārabhdmapītyāha [k, kh: mityāha] vastuta itisaṃvidātmātiriktaṃ yanna te paśyanti kiñcanaca] || (śi0 dṛ0 7|5-6) itibhasmīṛtamatasteṣāṃ na kiñcit pariśiṣyateśiṣyatītyāha - karmeti | sarvaṃ dvaitam | na kiñcit karmaśṛṇu brahman rahasyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥśivatulyatvānna karmetyāha - śṛṇvitināsti bhedo leśato'pi satyametanna saṃśayaḥprārabdhaśeṣa iti bhāvaḥiti śrutvā sa vasumān hemāṅgadanirūpitamkiñcit | jñānināṃ madhyamottamānām | iti rājakumāroktaṃ sarvampūjito rājaputrādyaiḥ svaṃ sthānaṃ pratyapadyataevaṃ śrutvā punā rāmaḥ papracchātrisutaṃ munimvinaṣṭo mama sandeho viditaṃ tanmahatpadamtanmahatpadaṃ śuddhacidadvayātmarūpamtathāpi bhavatā proktamāditaḥ sarvameva tuproktākhilārthaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa brūhīti pṛcchati - tathāpītiyāvaddhārayitavyaṃ me guro sarvātmanā mayāme sarvātmanā yāvaddhārayitavyaṃ tāvad brūhiśṛṇu rāma pravakṣyāmi sarvasāratamaṃ punaḥsarvasya proktasya sāratamamsā svātantryābhidhamāyāśaktimāhātmyataḥ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratibimbavadādarśe tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu kramātsvātantryavaśataḥ svātmarūpaṃ dvedhā'vabhāsayatsvātmarūpaṃ citsphūrtighanamtadā dvitīyabhāgastadahaṃbhāvavinirgataḥiti bhāvaḥapūrṇāhaṃbhāvayuta eṣa proktaḥ sadāśivaḥīśvaraṃ prāhuḥsvāmitvamevamasyāvyakta iti jñeyamavyaktamātmano dehametadevāhamāsthitaḥiti sambandhaḥavyaktamabhimānenāviṣṭa īśvara eva tuavyaktamahamityabhimānenāviṣṭa īśvara eva tridhā'bhavaditi sambandhaḥutpattyavabhāsakāḥbahavo harayo'pyāsaṃstatsaṃhāraparāyaṇāḥsaṃhāraparāyaṇā rudrā āsanniti sambandhaḥevaṃvidhaṃ jagattattvaṃ darpaṇapratibimbavatparaciteravyatiriktamevetyāha [k: parā] - darpaṇetiparā citiḥ prapūrṇāhaṃbhāvarūpaiva sarvadāparā] svarūpādapracyutimāha - parā citiritiyathā tvaṃ rāma sarvasmin dehe'haṃbhāvabṛṃhitaḥevameva parā saṃvit pūrṇāhantāsamāśrayāvastutaḥ saiva paramā citirevaṃ hi bhāsinīpūrṇāhantāparicchinnāhantāsadāśivādirūpe'navabhāsinītyarthaḥgrahītumasamartho'pi cākṣatādātmyametya tugṛhṇāsīti sambandhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svataḥ sarvābhedamayo brahmādistambarāśiṣudārṣṭāntike yojayati - evamiti | sarvāntaryāmitvena sarvābhedamayaḥyathā te nirvikalpaṃ tu rūpaṃ sarvāśrayaṃ hi satśuddhacidrūpaṃ pratibimbasthānīyaṃ dehendriyādyakhilāśrayaṃ sadapievameva parā saṃvit sarvalokasamāśrayādārṣṭāntike saṅgamayati - evamitietāvajjāgataṃ sarvaṃ tasyāmevāvabhāsateetāvaditijagato bhāsanaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā evāvabhāsanamatra tvamahamanye ca draṣṭāro dṛṅmayāḥ khaludṛśyavaddraṣṭṛṇāmapi tanmātratāmāha - atreti | jagatītyarthaḥghaṭādidarpaṇo yadvad ghaṭādīnāmasaṅgameghaṭādipratibimbaparicchinnadarpaṇāṃśaḥevaṃ vikalpasambhūtadṛśyābhāsapramārjanemahānandaghanā caiṣā duḥkhaleśavivarjanāttadabhāvādakhaṇḍānandarūpatāsukhamātmasvarūpaṃ syāt sarvairyasmādabhīpsitamyathā duḥkhamiti prayogaḥyasyaiva leśo viṣayānanda ityabhidhīyateparicchedanimittamaupādhikaṃ bhogyatvamiti bhāvaḥcidev spṛhaṇīyatvādānanda iti procyatesarvaspṛhaṇīyatvāccidātmaivānanda iti procyata ityāha - cidevetivibhinnamabhijānanti vyañjakānāṃ vibhedataḥjānantīti bhāvaḥyāvaddarpṇavijñānaṃ bhinnā eva vibhānti vai

sanskrit: bhāvaḥna darpaṇād bhinnamasti tvādarśaḥ śuddha eva hibhāsamānamapi svātmamātrameva na cetaratdārṣṭāntike yojayati - evamiti | na cetaradbhāsata iti śeṣaḥpratimāśca yathā śaile jagadevaṃ cidātmani[k: bhāsata nāsti] iti śeṣaḥnāstīti viparīto hi niścayo naiva siddhyatipramāṇatvena yato na siddhyatināstīti śāpamātreṇa kathaṃ syājjagato layaḥsarvaniṣedhe samādhyādau bhāsamānatvātevaṃ jagaccidātmaikarūpaṃ satyamudīritamnāsti] sarvamasti vetyākṣepo'pyanupapanna eveti dhyeyamdṛgeva dṛśyatāṃ prāptaṃ svamāhātmyaprakarṣataḥdṛśyamityupasaṃharati - dṛgeveti | svamāhātmyaṃ svasvātantryamna bandho'sti na mokṣo'sti sādhakaḥ sādhanaṃ ca nasādhakaḥ sādhanaṃ ca nasarvamityāha - saivetietatte'bhihitaṃ rāma vijñānakramamāditaḥ- etattu iti | āditaḥ sādhanaprāptimāabhyetyarthaḥnāradaiṣa jñānakhaṇḍaḥ sūpapattyupalabdhikaḥupalabdhiranubhavaḥ | suṣṭhurūpam ubhayaṃ yasminśrutvāpyetad yasya moho na śāntiṃ prāpnuyāt kvacitnāśayedevetyarthaḥ | śāntiṃ nāśamdṛḍhamsakṛdeveti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
