sanskrit: saundaryadarśanādijasukhasyābhimānotthatve ākhyāyikāmāha - puretiatyantamanuraktaḥ sa tasyāṃ rājakumārakaḥsa bhṛtyo rājaputraṃ taṃ vañcayāmāsa yuktitaḥtato madāndhāya ceṭīṃ kāñcit preṣya kurūpiṇīmyuktimevāha - madirāmiti | atimātraṃ puṣkalamevameva ciraṃ tatra madāndho nṛpateḥ sutaḥrājakumārasya patnīm | sa bhṛtyo bubhuja iti tātparyamdhanyo'hamīdṛśīṃ lokasundarīṃ prāṇapreyasīmrājakumāro dhanyo'hamityādyātmānamabhimanuteevaṃ vṛtte cire kāle kadācid daivayogataḥatha rājakumārastatpānaṃ nātyantikaṃ papausa bhṛtyaḥ | ātyantike āvaśyake kārye sati | ātyantikaṃ puṣkalamśayanīyaṃ manaḥkāntaṃ sarvabhogarddhisaṃyutamnimittataḥ kenacinnimittena | na papauparārddhyaparyaṅkagatāṃ tāṃ ceṭīmupasaṅgataḥparārddhyamuttamam | tāṃ bhṛtyapreṣitāmupalabhyātha ratyante ceṭīṃ tāṃ vikṛtākṛtimkāmavegena tāmaparīkṣyaivakva sā mama priyatametyevaṃ tāmanvapṛcchatasumarthā ataḥ kimetaditi cintayan kva setyādyanvapṛcchatbhītā na kiñcittaṃ prāha vepamānā tadā tataḥtaṃ kumāram | tataḥ ceṭīvṛttāt | ālakṣyeti sambandhaḥvāmena jagrāha kace ceṭīṃ krodhāruṇekṣaṇaḥvaiṣamyamanarhaṃ vacanamtarjayaṃstāṃ pratyuvāca vada vṛttaṃ yathātatham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛpāṇiṃ khaḍgamsaivaṃ niśamya tadvākyaṃ bhītā prāṇaparīpsayāato drutaṃ vadeti yojanāprādarśayaccāpi tasmai tāṃ bhṛtyena susaṅgatāmtat priyāvṛttam | vṛttam atītam | samāsthitaṃ tayā samācaritamprāṃśuṃ malinasarvāṅgaṃ rūkṣavaktraṃ jugupsitamprāṃśum uccammṛdubāhulatāvṛttagrīvasya vadane svakamsarvāṅgaiḥ samāśliṣya | latayā vṛtā veṣṭitā grīvā yasyatasyoruyugmaṃ taddhastasaṃsaktagurusustanīmrohiṇīṃ rāhuṇopetāmivāpaśyannṛpātmajaḥmomuhyamānaścātyantaṃ kṣaṇaṃ paścād dhṛtiṃ bhajankṣaṇamatyantaṃ mohaṃ prāptaḥdhiṅmāmanāryamatyantaṃ mūḍhaṃ madavimohitamna kāminyaḥ kasyacit syurvṛkṣasyeva ca śārikāḥyatrepsitaṃ phalaṃ tatra gacchantīti bhāvaḥjānantamenāṃ prāṇebhyaḥ preṣṭhāṃ sucirakālataḥtātparyamyaḥ strīṣu viśrabdhamanāḥ sa eva vanagardabhaḥjanasaṅgāt kiñcidanyabhāvajñaḥ kadācit syāditi tātparyamtato'pi pelavā strīṇāṃ sthitiratyantacañcalāpelavā laghutarāyanmāṃ sarvātmanāsaktaṃ tyaktvā bhṛtyamanuvratāpradarśayantī bhaktiṃ svāṃ naṭīva viṭamaṇḍalechadmānurāge dṛṣṭāntaḥ - naṭīveti

sanskrit: chāyeva māṃ saṅgateti matvā viśrabdhamānasaḥnūnaṃ matto mūḍhatamaḥ ko bhavejjagatītaleanayā vañcito'haṃ ceṭīṃ saṅgataḥaho'yaṃ bhṛtyahatakaḥ sarvāṅgavikṛtākṛtiḥtatra hetuḥ - ya evamiti | hatakaḥ atininditaḥyato māṃ nijasaundaryāhṛtalokāvalokanamsaundaryeṇa āhṛtaṃ lokānāmavalokanaṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ yenaevaṃ pralapya bahudhā nirviṇṇo'titarāṃ tadāsarvathā'nuraktam | nirviṇṇo viraktaḥtasmād rājakumāraitatsaundaryaṃ manasotthitamsukhaṃ ciraṃ prāptaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ | manasotthitaṃ manasā parikalpitamratiṃ vindasyatitarāṃ tathā vā tadviśeṣataḥatra te pratyayaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu priya samāhitaḥatra saundaryasya mānasatve | pratyayaṃ niścayānukūlāṃ prakriyāmyā ca tatpratibimbātmarūpiṇī cittasaṃśrayābahiḥ cittādanyatrapaunaḥpunyena tadanu vāñchāmupasamāgataḥsamyagullekhānantaram | tadviṣayavāñchāmakṣubdhe tvindriye na syāt sundaryāmapi vai ratiḥataḥ kṣobho naiva dṛṣṭo bālānāṃ yogināmapitatra kṣobhe | etadvyatirekamukhena draḍhayati - ata itisundaryāṃ vāpi cānyasyāṃ tatra sauṣṭhavamullikhetsthitamasthitaṃ vātaruṇaiḥ saṅgatāstāśca dṛśyante'patyahetutaḥcedāha - apatyahetuta iti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadi syāttat kathaṃ nṝṇāṃ ratistāsu hi sambhavetsauṣṭhave'nullekhaḥ sauṣṭhavaviṣayakānullekhaḥ | tāsu virūpāsujaghanyāṅge'pi saundaryaṃ bhāsate sarvato'dhikamyonyādyaṅge'pi | sarvato mukhādibhyo'dhikampaśyeccet kutra no paśyet saundaryaṃ tanmamerayaabhimānamṛte naiṣa sukhaheturbhavet kvacittasmāt saundaryasya manaḥkalpitamātratvāttadbālānāṃ kumārāṇāṃ kuto no bhāti tadvadamānasatvaṃ sādhayati - kṣaudretiekapādaikanayanā lambakarṇā hayānanāḥvinasā dīrghanāsāśca lomacchannā vilomakāḥśvitravarṇāḥ kākavarṇāḥ piṅgalā lohitāṅgakāḥratiṃ vindanti tvamiva rājaputra niśāmayaniśāmaya paśyasarvapriyaṃ yatra sarve muhyanti vibudhā apiśarīraprakṛtiṃ varṇayitumāha - sukhetivimarśaya subuddhyā tvaṃ rājaputra yathāsthitamasthipañjarakaṃ lomacchannaṃ pittakaphāhitampittakaphābhyām āhitaṃ yuktammūtradvārasamudbhūtamaho priyamiheṣyateviṭkṛmibhyaḥ kutasteṣāṃ bhavedantaramīrayavibhāvaya vivekena dhātūnāṃ ca pṛthaksthitimdṛśā] | vibhāvaya | evaṃ vibhāvane kva saundaryādikamiti bhāvaḥpariṇāmasvabhāvaṃ tu sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā vibhāvayaevamiti | śarīrādanyatra | upayojye bhojye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvathā nātra sandehaḥ sarvaireva vibhāvitaḥpariṇāmasvabhāvamevāha - bhakṣitetiityukto hemacūḍo'tha vairasyaṃ viṣaye vidanvicārya bhūyastatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ hemalekhayāapūrvaṃ kadāpyaśrutamatha krameṇa pṛṣṭvā tāṃ priyāṃ jñātvā ca tatpadamjāto nirvedaḥ alaṃbuddhiryasya | paraṃ tīvram | tatpadam ātmapadambudhvā'bhavad vimuktātmā svātmabhūtākhilekṣaṇaḥsvātmabhūtamakhilekṣaṇaṃ yasyamaṇicūḍo'vidad bhrāturmuktācūḍo'pi putrataḥmantriṇaścāpi paurāśca babhūvurjñānaśālinaḥparasparopadeśena jñānaśālinaḥāsīd brahmapuraprakhyaṃ śāntasaṃsṛtivāsanambrahmapuraprakhyaṃ satyalokatulyam | saṃsṛtervāsanā kāmakrodhādiyatra kīrāḥ śārikāśca pañjarasthāḥ paṭhanti vaiatyuttamatve hetuḥ - yatretināsti cetyaṃ citeranyad darpaṇapratibimbavattasmāt [gh: tasmāttat] pratibimbavidhayaiva dṛśyāvabhāsanamitiyataḥ sarvaṃ citimanu bhāti sā tu svatantrataḥsvatantraprakāśattvameva cittvamiti bhāvaḥbhajadhvaṃ bhrāntimutsṛjya citimātrasudṛṣṭayaḥsudṛṣṭiḥ satyadṛṣṭiḥ | sarvaṃ jñānaṃ dharmiṇyabhrāntamiti nyāyātbrāhmaṇā vāmadevādyā nāmācakhyuḥ purasya tumahato mokṣasyodayo yasmātprasiddhavidyānagaramiti nāmnā prasiddhyatu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rāma tasmāttu satsaṅgo mūlaṃ sarvaśubhodayetat tasmānnāmakaraṇāddhetoḥtasmāt saṅgaḥ paraṃ mūlaṃ rāma jānīhi śreyasaḥupasaṃharati - tasmāditiprahṛṣṭamānaso bhūyaḥ praṣṭumevopacakramerāmaḥ śrutvāsatsaṅgarūpametacca pratyakṣeṇaiva bhāvitambhāvitamanubhūtaṃ saṃvartasaṅgātstriyo'pi hemalekhāyāḥ saṅgāt sarve mahāphalāḥsarve viśālanagaravāsinaḥbodhitastanmamācakṣva vistareṇa dayānidheśṛṇu bhārgava vakṣyāmi kathāṃ paramapāvanīmanuyuktaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ | saṃsṛtidoṣaśāmakatvāt paramapāvanīmteṣu sañjātanirvedo vimanā iva saṃbabhauevaṃ san | vimanā iva khinna ivatyaktuṃ vā saṃgrahītuṃvā nāśakat sahasā hi saḥvaimanasye hetumāha - cireti | viṣayān tyaktuṃ saṃgrahītuṃ bhoktuṃ vākāṃścicca divasānevamanayaccintayākulaḥtyāgabhogayoraśaktaḥ sanvigarhanneva svātmānaṃ bubhuje vāsanāvaśaḥkuto na pariharati ? tadāha - vāsanāvaśa itidṛṣṭvaiva viṣayān doṣān priyāproktān vicintayananugacchati viṣayasamīpaṃ prāpnoti | priyāproktān viṣayadoṣānevaṃ tasyābhavaccittaṃ caladdolāsthitaṃ yathātaddoṣasmṛtyā tata uccalati

sanskrit: [naiṣat iti sārvatrikaḥ pāṭhaḥ] sukhayantītyāha - bhojyamitivāsanāvivaśaḥ sarvaṃ tyaktuṃ nāśakadañjasāevaṃ taṃ śokavaśato vivarṇavadanekṣaṇamparasparapratibandhāditi bhāvaḥkiṃ nātha pūrvavattvaṃ no lakṣyase'tyantaharṣitaḥrahaḥ vivikte | taṃ parīkṣituṃ pṛcchati - kiṃ nāthetināmayairbādhyate sadābhāvaḥtridoṣasambhave dehe doṣavaiṣamyasambhavāḥvātapittakaphadoṣāṇāṃ samyag bhavaḥ sthitiryatrasarvathā hyapratīkāryaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ doṣajaṃ nanurogaprāgavasthāsthakevaladoṣavaiṣamyasya prāyo durlakṣyatvāditi bhāvaḥkālād deśāt karmataśca doṣā vaiṣamyamāpnuyuḥ[kh, g, gh: karmaṇo] dos'vaiṣamyamityataḥ sati vaiṣamye cikitsā samprakīrtitāvaiṣamyodbhava ādāvalakṣyaḥ ato hetoḥ cikitsā śāstre saṃprakīrtitātadvada priya kasmāddhi śokasya tava sambhavaḥvaiṣamyaviṣayānutpattau cikitsā noktāpriye śṛṇu pravakṣyāmi yanme śokasya kāraṇamtataḥ praśnānantaramna paśyāmyadhunā kiñcidapi me sukhavarddhanamtat samprati tvaduktyā hatam | kuta iti cedāha - netivadhyaṃ na sukhayed yadvattathā tasmānna me sukhamsādhanaṃ sadapi na tasmānme sukhamtat pṛcchāmi priye brūhi kiṃ kṛtvā sukhamemyaham

sanskrit: iti śeṣaḥnūnameṣa sunirvedamāgato madvacaḥśruteḥsvamanasyabravīt | śruteḥ śravaṇātyeṣu śreyo hyasambhāvyaṃ ta evaṃ vākyagumphanaiḥgumphanairnibiḍasamudāyaiḥciraṃ saṃrādhitā hṛtsthā prasannā svātmadevatācenmūlakāraṇābhāvādityāha - ciramitiityālocyātividuṣī bubodhayiṣatī priyamsarveṣāmiyaṃ sthitiriti bhāvaḥśṛṇu rājakumāredaṃ yanme vṛttaṃ purātanambahubrīhigarbhitaṃ vākyam | bandhasyānādikālikatvādityarthaḥ]sā svabhāvasatī kāñcidasatīmanusaṅgatāsā0 28) iti | pakṣadvaye'pyasatītyasatyātmakatvājjñeyamalakṣitā me jananyā sakhyā me saṅgatā'bhavatśuddhacidaviṣayakatvādalakṣiteti jñeyamprāṇebhyo'pi priyatamā sadā tadvaśagā hyahamatastadvaśagā'hamabhavam parasparatādātmyādhyāsātsā nirmalasvabhāvena māṃ vaśīkṛtya saṃsthitāyuktameveti bhāvaḥsā tayā duṣṭayā yuktā naṭyā citrasvabhāvayāsvarūpaṃ yasyāḥ | svalīlāpradarśanenārthaharatvānnaṭyetitasyāḥ putro'timūḍhātmā madirāghūrṇitekṣaṇaḥsā tenākrāntasarvāṅgī bhujyamānānuvāsaramtātparyam | sā buddhiḥ | tena mohenatataḥ putraḥ samutpanno mūḍhasya sadṛśākṛtiḥ

sanskrit: asattvarūpatvena sadṛśākṛtirjñeyāpiturmauḍhyena saṃyuktaḥ pitāmahyā guṇena caguṇena ca samāvṛtaḥpitāmahyā śūnyanāmnyā pitrā mūḍhābhidhena casambandhaḥgatimapratibaddhāṃ vai śīghrācchighrāṃ samāsadatvaśiṣṭa]asatīsaṅgato'tyantaṃ mālinyaṃ samupāgatācirasaṅgātteṣu dṛḍhānurāgeṇa samāyutāmanaḥkalpitavastusaundaryādivyavasāyātmanā ca sadā sthiteti bhāvaḥahaṃ svabhāvasaralā hātuṃ tatsaṅgamañjasāsaralānāmanyaprītyādyanimittaiva prītiriti tātparyamatha tasyāḥ priyo mūḍho bhuñjānastāṃ tu sarvadāevaṃ buddhyanukāraprāptyanantaramnāhaṃ svabhāvasaṃśuddhā vastutastadvaśaṃ gatābhāvaḥmūḍhena sarvatheyaṃ ca bhujyate iti sarvataḥavivekino buddhidharmānātmanyāropayantīti tātparyampriyeṇa saṃpariṣvaktā sarvathā tatparā'bhavat[k: niśceṣṭu] buddhirmohaikarūpā'bhavaditi bhāvaḥprauḍhastriyaṃ pitāmahyā anumatyopasaṅgataḥkalpane'vidyānukūleti tadanumatirjñaṃyāpriyasya sammataṃ rūpaṃ bhinnaṃ bhinnaṃ manoharamkalpanāyāścapaleti nāma | priyasya manasaḥcakre sā'tyantanipuṇā svanaipuṇyavaśāt khalu

sanskrit: pratikṣaṇamabhavadityāśayaḥprayātyāyāti ca sadā na śrāntimupagacchatiasthiro manaḥtasyeṣṭaṃ ca svarūpaṃ tu kṛtvā sā capalāpi hibhāvaḥevaṃ sā capalā samyagasthireṇa yutā satīte samarthāḥ pañcavidhā mayi sakhyā niveśitāḥsakhyā mayi niveśitā iti cittādātmyāpattiruktāatha te pañcatanayāścapalāyāḥ pṛthak pṛthakpitaraṃ svavaśe cakrurmātrā samyag vibhāvitāḥbahirmukhamabhavditi tātparyamtatrāsthiro jyeṣṭhasutāyatanaṃ viniviśya tuśrotrendriyamsumaṅgalam]itarān visvarān | etadevāha - kvaciditiśāstrāgametihāsāṃśca bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca siñjitamevaṃ manoharān śabdān śṛṇvan putranideśataḥbhāvaḥviruddhān karṇakaṭukānaśṛṇod bhairavān ravānbāhyaviṣayagrahaṇasyendriyādhīnatvādindriyādeśenā'śṛṇoditibrahmāṇḍabhedanaṃ garbhasrāvaṇaṃ subhayaṅkaramaśaninirghoṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ brahmāṇḍetyādiruditaṃ vipralapitaṃ śocitādivicitritamtatrāpaśyad mṛdusparśānyāsanāni śubhāni cadvitīyasutastvagindriyam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śītasparśāni vastūni tathoṣṇasparśakāni cahitān dṛṣṭvā pramudito viṣaṇṇastvahitānapiapaśyadrucirākārān bhāvān vividhavarṇakāntṛtīyaścakṣuḥdhūmrān kaḍārān kapiśān mecakān karburāṃstathāarddhavṛttān dīrghavṛttān sundarāṃśca vibhīṣaṇānnetrasya rūpānyaparimāṇādiviṣayatvādāha - sthūlānityādikvaciddhitaṃ tato'nyacca paśyantaṃ pitaraṃ punaḥanālokānandhakārān | kīdṛśān ? dṛṅmuṣaḥkramātturyo rāsanaṃ rasānumitaṃ puṣpādi jñeyamsudhāsvādūni madhurāṇyanyānyamlarasāni cakṣārāṇi madhurāmlāni kaṭvamlalavaṇāni camadhurāmlānītyādi miśrarasaḥāsvādayannātmajena sameto'thāntimaḥ sutaḥantimo ghrāṇamtatropālabhatānekapuṣpāṇi ca phalāni casugandhān pūtigandhāṃśca mṛdugandhogragandhakānbhāvān arthān | tānevāha - sugandhānityādiputrāṇāṃ bhavane caivaṃ praviśan niviśannapimohajanako mohagandhaḥ | evamagre'pisadā gamāgamaparaḥ putrāṇāṃ bhavane babhauspṛśanti viṣayāṃścitrān svalpaṃ vāpi kadācanabhāvaḥmuṣitvānyāṃśca viṣayān guptyā nayati svaṃ padam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatsukhamanubhavatītyāha - asthira itibhunaktyatitarāṃ nityamathānyā capalā svasārahaḥ svapnādau | anyā āśātasyāmatitarāṃ sakto yadā'bhūdasthiro'pi vaitenānītaṃ bahvapi ca bhakṣitvā kṣaṇamātrataḥbhogāharaṇatatparo'bhavatsadā priyaṃ sandiśati so'pyāhartuṃ sadekṣateduṣpūrāśāviṣṭaṃ manaḥ sarvadā viṣayasādhanaparamabhavaditi tātparyambhuktvā kṣaṇena bhūyo'pi sā bubhukṣāprapīḍitāsapatnyāḥ putrairindriyaiḥtataḥ sā svalpakālena suṣuve putrayoryugambhogānām āhṛtau āharaṇaviṣayesadā mātuḥ priyatamau tau putrau saṃbabhūvatuḥmāturāśāyāḥ | āśādhikyāt krodhalobhayoḥ prābalyamabhavadityāśayaḥtadā jvālāmukhajvālālīḍhasarvakalevaraḥtātparyamkadācinnindyavṛttena saṅgataḥ priyasūnunāevaṃ yadā'sthiro jāto duḥkhabhogaikatatparaḥlobhena nindyatā tato mṛtatulyatā ca spaṣṭāativātsalyatastena saṅgatā tasya duḥkhataḥduḥkhaprāptirityāha - tadeti | sakhī buddhiḥ | putre manasijvālāmukhena ca tathā pautreṇāśleṣitā satītāṃ sadānugatā cāhaṃ luptaprāyā'bhavaṃ priyasvarūpasyānavabhāsālluptaprāyatvaṃ jñeyamasthiro'bhūdasvatantro mahāśanāparigrahāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: duḥkhitā'bhavamiti sambandhaḥtasmin mahāśanāyukto putrairmātrādibhiryutaḥbāhyapakṣe tu yuddhādikarmaṇā | kvacit pralyānantaraṃ sṛṣṭikāleputrābhyāṃ dagdhasarvāṅgo ninditaścānuvāsaramsukhaprepsuriti | sukhasyecchāmātram duḥkhameva prāpyata iti bhāvaḥputrāṇāṃ pañcabhavanaṃ praviśan niviśannapipriyābhyāṃ vikalpāśābhyām | putrāṇām indriyāṇāmevaṃ putrasya duḥkhena sakhī me'tyantaduḥkhitāputrasya manasaḥ | sakhī buddhiḥjvālāmukhanindyavṛttayutā yā sā mahāśanāsāttvikāṃśāpagamānmūrcchitakalpā | tatpure dehe | mahāśanā āśātathā sapatnyā capalākhyayā'tyantaṃ samedhitāśūnyākhyayā bhartuḥ pitāmahyā avidyayāsakhīprītyā tatra cāhamavasaṃ tatparā satībhāvaḥyadyahaṃ tatra na syāṃ vai kṣaṇamātramapi priyabhavediti bhāvaḥśūnyayā śunyatāṃ prāptā mūḍhena mūḍhatāmapiśūnyayā yutājvālāmukhājjvalattāṃ ca nindyavṛttāttadātmatāmsakhīṃ yadi vimuñcāmi sā naśyet kṣaṇamātrataḥbhavedityāśayaḥjanā mūḍhāḥ sarva eva kuśalā nirmalāṃ viduḥkāladeśādiparicchedamalanirgatāṃ māṃ viduḥākāśādapi vistīrṇā sūkṣmā ca paramāṇutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: durjñeyatvācca paramāṇutaḥ sūkṣmāsarvāśrayāpyanādhārā sarvādhārāpyanāśritāsarvatra bhāsamānatvāt sarvādhārāsarvatra bhāsamānāpi na jñeyā kenacit kvacitmādṛśyastanayāstasyāḥ santi saṃkhyāvivarjitāḥnityatvānmātāpitṛvivarjitā | saṃkhyāvivarjitā asaṃkhyāḥsarvāstā matsamācārā rājaputra bhavanti vaisakhīkuṭumbaparāyaṇāḥsaṅgatā tatparā cāpi mātṛtulyā svarūpataḥsaṃsārāvabhāsanaṃ sampādayāmīti tātparyamtadā mātuḥ samutsaṅge'sthiraḥ śete sunirbharammāturbuddherutsaṅga manaḥ śete layaṃ prāpnotisvāpaṃ samadhigacchanti nānyo jāgarti kaścanaḥvilīne indriyādi sarvaṃ vilīnamiti tāparyampracārākhyaḥ praticaran pūrvadvārayuge muhuḥtasyāḥ sakhī ca yā śvaśrūrasatī yā svabhāvataḥavidyāevaṃ sarveṣu supteṣu prāpya svāṃ mātaraṃ tadāāntarapakṣe mohātmikayā avidyayā sarvamāvṛtaṃ bhavatīti tātparyampunastānutthitān śīghramanusaṃyāmi cānvahamsa sarvānasthiramukhān poṣayatyanuvāsaramāmiti bhāvaḥvyāpya rakṣatyanudinaṃ sarvān saṃśleṣayatyapisaṃyojayatisūtreṇa hīnā maṇayo mālābaddhā yathā pṛthak
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pṛthagbhūtānāṃ mālākāratā yathā naśyatīti bhāvaḥmayā saṃjīvito'tyantaṃ sūtradhāro hi tatpuremanaḥprabhṛtivyāpārapravartakaḥevaṃ pracāraṃ saṃśritya purāṇāmadhipo'bhavatlayāt prāṇo nayatīti bhāvaḥ | adhipaḥ asthirābhidhaṃ mano'bhavatsatīputro'pyasthiraḥ sa saṃśrito'pi mahābalambahūnāṃ purāṇāmiti pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ | mahābalaṃ prāṇampatnyādyasatsamāgamādityāha - capaletyādianyaiḥ putraiḥ pañcabhiḥ sa sarvatrābhivikarṣitaḥkrodhalobhodayaḥ tena duḥkhabhāgabhūdityāśayaḥitastataḥ kvacit putraiḥ pañcabhiḥ sa vikarṣitaḥmahākleśaprāptiprakāramāha - ita ityādikvacinmahāśanāhetoraśanārthaṃ pradhāvatikhedamīyivān [g, gh: meyivān] duḥkhaṃ prāptavānmahāmūrcchāṃ samāyāti cāvidaṃstatpratikriyāmtatpratikriyāṃ krodhapratikriyāṃ śāntimmṛtatulyaṃ svamātmānaṃ manyate śokasantataḥpatnīputraiḥ samākrānto nīyamānastu taiḥ sadāmūḍhaputratvād duṣkulodbhavatvamkvacit kāntārakīrṇeṣu kravyādakulabhūmiṣumahāraṇyasthaṃ kākādivyāptaṃ ca svadehaṃ paśyatīti tātparyamkvacit pūtivahāstheṣu kvacid gāḍhatamaḥsu cauvāsetyanvayaḥsakhī ca me duḥkhamūḍhā'bhavad duḥsaṅgataḥ sadāmūḍhevātyantamabhavaṃ tatkuṭumbaparāyaṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirnimittenetyarthaḥ[k, kh: yayau] naraḥmohitā'tyantakhedena mayā rahasi saṅgatājitvā svatanayaṃ hatvā badhvā tattanayādikān| tanayaṃ manaḥ | krodhalobhau hatvā | indriyāṇi badhvāmanmātaraṃ pariṣvajya muhurmuhurakalmaṣāhatvāpi sa imān lokān na hanti na nivadhyate (bha0 gī0 18|17) itievaṃ tvamapi durvṛttaṃ nigṛhya sakhisambhavammametyuktaṃ bhavati | sakhisambhavaṃ manaḥetatte kathitaṃ nātha svānubhūtaṃ sukhāspadamprāpyetyarthaḥhasan papraccha tāṃ kāntāmavidvān viduṣīṃ tadākhacitramiva | asambhāvitamivetyarthaḥ | nirālambaṃ nirviṣayamkuta iti cedāha - nūnamiti | alam atyantambhūtagrastoktisadṛśavacasā te'timātrataḥatimātrato'timātreṇa bahulena vacasāvada te sā sakhī kvāste baddhaśca sakhiputrakaḥ[k, g: castha] cedāha - vadetiastu kiṃ tena vṛttena vada me kva ca sā sakhīāryāsti me'varodhe sve piturme'nyā nahi priyāyathā] sakhī dattā [k: dattāsthā] syādityāha pituritimanye'haṃ te vaco loke vandhyāputrasamāśrayamloke prasiddhaṃ vandhyāputrasamāśrayaṃ vaca iva te vacaḥvandhyāputraḥ samārūḍhaḥ pratibimbamahārathamtadevāha - yatheti | naṭiko naṭaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyudhairnaraśṛṅgotthairyudhvā gaganakānanemarīcisrotasi svāpnakāminībhirhi khelatiśrutvaivaṃ priyavākyaṃ sā caturā prāha taṃ punaḥtathā proktavidūṣakavākyavat | asaṅgatamna mādṛśānāṃ vacanaṃ nirālambaṃ kvacidbhavetityarthaḥ] saundaryavadbhavettasya norddhvaṃ na cādhastālloko'sti [k: loke] sukhasādhanamapārthavacasā asatyāt | na lokaḥsamadṛṣṭiṃ naiti śīghramañjanānāṃ vacogaṇaiḥjñātumaśakyamityāśayenāha - śṛṇvitijijñāsuḥ] asatyairyojayāmi kim | na yojayāmyevetyarthaḥloke hi kuśalo martyaḥ sarvavyavahṛtau nanukuśalo'pyatītārthaṃ tvadvacanaṃ kathaṃ parīkṣiṣyāmīti cedāha - loka itinidarśanaṃ pradāsyāmi tubhyamatra samīkṣaya [k: samīkṣayā]nidarśanaṃ pradāsyāmi anubhūtaṃ smārayāmi | atra madvacanaparīkṣāyāmcirānmadvacanāt so'dya kuto na sukhasādhanambhavedeveti jānīhīti bhāvaḥetannidarśanenaiva svamataṃ vettumarhasipramāṇamapramāṇaṃ veti vettumripurloke [k: ripuloko] bhavedāptoktiṣu sthiraḥanāśvāsaḥ aśraddhārakṣati prauḍhabhītibhyaḥ sarvathā nahi saṃśayaḥsa bhavet sarvato hīno yaḥ śraddhārahito naraḥata eva sarvato hīno bhavetaśraddho mātṛviṣaye bālo jīvet kathaṃ vada
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taddattāhārādestyājyatvena bālo na jīviṣyatīti bhāvaḥtathā'patyeṣu sthaviraḥ kathamīyāt satīṃ gatimna pravṛttirbhavet kvāpi tyāge vā saṃgrahe'pi vā- aśraddha itiekāntagrahaṇāllokapravṛttiriti cecchṛṇupravartata iti bhāvaḥ | atrāha - śṛṇvititatrāpyekāntaśaraṇaḥ śraddhāśaraṇa eva hitasmācchraddhāṃ dṛḍhāṃ prāpya sukhamātyantikaṃ vrajaśraddhāṃ prāpyaiyaṃ ca śraddhayaivāste pravṛttirnṛpateḥ sutakartavyetyabhyupagamarūpā pravṛttirapi śraddhayaiva bhavediti bhāvaḥhemacūḍaḥ prāha punaḥ priyāṃ kuśalabhāṣiṇīmsamāpnuyātmīnānāmiva nāśamāpnuyāditi vyavahitena sambandhaḥanyathāntaḥ suniśite kuṭile baḍiśe yathātasmāttasmāt satsveva kartavyā śraddhā nāsatsu kutracitsatsu śreyoyujaḥ śraddhāvaśataste nidarśanammaduktau nidarśanam udāharaṇamtat kathaṃ te pravṛttiḥ syāditi praśnaḥ kathaṃ tavamahājanānāṃ vākyādevamahaṃ pravṛtta iti bhāvaḥśṛṇu rājakumāredaṃ procyamānaṃ mayā vacaḥayaṃ [k: atha] san vā hyasan vāyamiti te niścayaḥ kutaḥniścayaḥso'pi lakṣaṇataḥ syāccecchraddhā lakṣaṇasaṅgatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cedanavasthā tadavasthaiveti bhāvaḥaśraddhasya pramāṇaṃ kiṃ bhavettat sunirūpyatāmvyabhicāradarśanānna kevalatarkeṇa kiñcijjñātuṃ śakyata ititasmācchraddhāṃ samāśritya lokaḥ sarvaḥ pravartatepravṛttirupapadyata iti bhāvaḥanavasthitatarko vā hyatarko vāpi sarvathāatarko mūḍhaḥtatrātarkasya kālena bhavecchreyaḥ kadācanaśreyaḥ kadācit sambhāvyata ityāha - tatreti | tayormadhye ityarthaḥpurā sahyagirau godāvarītīre hi kauśikaḥanavasthitatarkasya śreyo na kathañcidityatretihāsamāha - puretitasya śiṣyāstu śataśaḥ [g: bahuśaḥ] sthitā gurusamāśrayātityāgamarītyā adhiṣṭhānaprakāśamātraṃ satattvaṃ svarūpaṃ jñātaṃ yenanirṇetuṃ buddhyanuguṇaṃ tadā procuḥ parasparamparasparaṃ procuḥsa sarveṣāṃ mataṃ proktaṃ dūṣayadbuddhikauśalātkevalaṃ buddhikauśalāt | śuṣkatarkairiti bhāvaḥpramāṇāt pramitaṃ satyamityukteṣu dvijeṣvathateṣūkteṣu | athāhetyanvayaḥśuṅgākhya ākṣipan sarvān tatra vādakathāntarejalpavitaṇḍābhinnakathāmadhyepramitaṃ yat pramāṇena tat satyamiti hīritambhavadbhirīritamniścetavyā tatastvādau pramāṇānāmaduṣṭatāpramāṇāduṣṭatvaniścayādhīna eva bhāvasatyatvaniścaya iti bhāvaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityevamanavasthānād na kiñcit pramitaṃ bhavetna kvacit satyatvaṃ sidhyatītyāha - sā pramāṇetitasmācchūnyāśrayo hyeṣa vikalpo vividhaḥ sthitaḥitarāsiddhimātrātmakatvāt tasyetipravinirṇayaḥsanna sidhyatīti śūnyameveti pravinirṇayaḥtaṃ śritā niścayābhāsaṃ babhūvuḥ śūnyavādinaḥśuṅgasiddhāntamye dvijāḥ sārahṛdayāste śuṅgasya prabhāṣitammano yeṣāmtasmāt sarvātmanā tyaktvā tarkaṃ tamanavasthitamyato'navasthitatarkasyānarthasampattiḥ tasmātiti prokto hemacūḍaḥ priyayā'tyantadhīrayāsadāgamasyāyatto'nukūlastarko yasya | dhīrayā paṇḍitayāaho priye te vaiduṣyamīdṛśaṃ nāvidaṃ purāasambhāvyamānāṃ yoṣiti vidvattāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitaḥbravīṣi śraddhayā sarvaśreyaḥsiddhiṃ hi tat kathamupāgataḥ saṅgataḥānantyādāgamānāṃ vai viruddhārthasamāśrayātkvacicchraddhāṃ kurviti cedāha - viruddhetisvabuddheranavasthānāt kimādeyaṃ na vāpi kimvividhatarkasambhavādanavasthānamiti bhāvaḥanyaccāpyavyavasitaṃ hānipradamapi priyeanabhimatam | avyavasitaṃ sādhanatvenāniścitamyaḥ śūnyamāha tattvaṃ so'pyaśūnyaṃ dūṣayet param

sanskrit: tatra āgameṣu | evaṃ sati virodhe sati | antaṃ niścayam | atrāpi vicāre kṛte'pietad brūhi priye samyag nahyetatte'styacintitamsarvajñakalpatvādityāśayenāha - nahyetaditiṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥprovāca viduṣī samyag vijñātalokasaṃsthitiḥyayāmano hi markaṭaprāyamasthiraṃ sarvadaiva tatsthairyamiti bhāvaḥ | yata evaṃ tat tasmāt sthirasvanta iti yojanācalanmanaḥ sarvaduḥkhānidānaṃ dṛṣṭameva hitadasthairyaṇa kiṃ me bhavediti cedāha - yata iti | manasaścalanādityarthaḥtasmānmanaḥ sthirīkṛtya śṛṇu yatte bravīmyahamaphalaṃ syāttadatyantaṃ yathā citrataruśrayaḥśrāṇaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | tat śravaṇamsattarkamāśritya janaḥ prāpnuyāt suphalaṃ drutamsattarkajanitāṃ śraddhāṃ prāpyeha phalabhāg naraḥbhavatītyāśayaḥpravṛttimetāṃ jagataḥ śraddhayā phalaśālinīmbhāvaḥśraddhayaiva tathā rūpyasvarṇaratnauṣadhādikamtvamiva tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhatīti bhāvaḥtasmāt sutarkaśraddhābhyāṃ vyavasya śreya ātmanaḥniścitya tatsādhanāya yetediti sambandhaḥviramet pauruṣād yatnācchuṅgānuganarā ivapauruṣayatnavimukho na bhavedityāha - nahītidṛḍhaṃ pauruṣamāśritya na prāpyeta kathaṃ phalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hyadṛḍhapauruṣādityāha [gh: hyadṛṣṭa] dṛḍhamitirājyalakṣmīṃ nṛpā viprā vidyāṃ sarvasukhāśrayāmphalaṃ kathamiti] sapratyayamāha - pauruṣāditiprāpuranye'pyabhimataṃ pauruṣeṇaiva karmaṇākadā kiñcit kathaṃ prāptaṃ phalaṃ vada vimṛśya tatkiñcidapi kiṃ phalaṃ kadā kāle sādhanaṃ vinā kathaṃ prāptamvijānīyād daivahataṃ taṃ svātmaripurūpiṇamśreyasāṃ yanmukhyatamaṃ sādhanaṃ tat samāśrayetsamāśrayediti cedāha - śreyasāmititeṣu yat sarvathā sādhyaṃ sādhayettaddhi mukhyakamcetyarthaḥdṛśyatedhanaṃ putrāstathā dārā rājyaṃ kośo balaṃ yaśaḥtadevāha - yaditi | anusaṃbhinnaṃ yutamsarvametadasthiratvāt kālasarpamukhasthitamyuta nāsti] sarvamitikuta ātyantikaśreyaḥsādhanatvaṃ samarhatinaivātyantikaśreyaḥsādhanatvamityāha - kuta itievaṃ dhanādiviṣaye yadādeyatvavibhramaḥvibhrama ityarthaḥyo hi sarvajagatkartā tasmāt sarve hi mohitāḥcejjagatkartṛtvena siddho nāpahnavanīya ityāha - yo hītikāṃścideva na sarvān sa yasmādvidyā hi sā mitāaindrajālikaḥ | asya vidyā miteti na sarvamohakatvammahādevaṃ mahāmāyaṃ kaḥ samutkrāntumarhati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māyinamaprasādya tanmohataraṇamaśakyamityāha - alpavidyamitisa mohānnirgataḥ svasthaḥ sukhamāpnotyanaśvaramanaśvaraṃ tanmāyayā'vināśyamna labhyā sarvathā yāvadaprasādya tu sarvathāna labhyā | sarvathā tamaprasādyetyagrimeṇa sambandhaḥmahāmohasya taraṇaṃ tasmāttaṃ sarvathā śrayettasmāt aprasādane mohataraṇābhāvātmahāvidyāṃ sa tanmohād dhruvamutkrāntimeṣyatimahāmāyāsvarūpaṃ vedeti śeṣaḥ | tanmohāt mahāmāyākṛtamohātmaheśvaraprasādātte vinā na syuḥ phalāptayebhaktyā sa sādhayedāśu yogānmohavināśanānkiñcit setsyatīti bhāvaḥsāṃśamevaṃ pṛthivyādyamadṛṣṭārambhamapyalamadṛṣṭotpattikamapi pṛthivyādivyavasyettatra kartāraṃ sarvakartṛvilakṣaṇamsarvakartṛvilakṣaṇa eṣa kartā sādhita iti bhāvaḥtadanekairāgamaistu tarkarūḍhaiḥ subādhitamanugatatarkairbādhitam atastyājyameveti sambandhaḥtadāgamābhāsameva na taddhi mahadāśrayamnāsti [k: tannāsti] me jihveti kathanatulyamityādi jñeyamanyairapyucyate kaiścid jagadetat sanātanam| te hi pariṇāmavādino jagat kāraṇāntarbhāvena sadevetyāhuḥkriyāyā buddhipūrvatvādabuddhau tadadarśanātbhāvaḥ | abuddhāviti | citralikhitakulālādau ghaṭādikriyādarśanātbuddhimatkartṛkaṃ kāryaṃ sarvatraiva hi darśanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prakṛtitattvasya kartṛtvasādhane dṛṣṭāntadaurlabhyavannātreti bhāvaḥsa kartā laukikebhyastu kartṛbhyaḥ syādvilakṣaṇaḥaparicchinnasāmarthyaḥ kāryasyānuguṇatvataḥityaparicchinnajagato'paricchinnasāmarthya eva karteti bhāvaḥatastaṃ sarvabhāvena śaraṇīkuru sarvadābhāvaḥprasāditaḥviśvāsaḥ | akāpaṭyāt sarvabhāvenaeṣa lokeśvaro devaḥ samyag yena prasāditaḥsarvātmanā kāyavāṅmanobhiḥ prasādita iti sambandhaḥ | śreyase sukhāyapuruṣā hīśvarā loke cānavasthā avatsalāḥniyatetyāha - puruṣā itiphalaprāptirbhavedeveti śeṣaḥanavasthaścet tatkṛtā lokayātrā vyavasthitā na bhavediti bhāvaḥtasmādeṣa [k: tasmādeva] dayāsindhuḥ suvyavasthaśca kīrtitaḥbhāvaḥśreyasi tvāṃ yojayet sa tvaṃ na tatparatāṃ vrajaśaṅkā prakṣiptā jñeyānirhetukaṃ tu kvācitkaṃ tat satyopāsanaṃ bhavetniṣkāmopāsanaṃ satyopāsanam satyaphalasahitatvātkadācid dayayāviṣṭa vārtti tasya vimocayetetadeva laukikadṛṣṭāntenopapādayati - dṛṣṭametaditievamevārthārthino'pi mitaṃ cāniyataṃ phalamphalāprāpteśceti bhāvaḥmiteśvaro'pyavyavasthastadadhīno bhavatbalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadadhīnaḥ upāsakādhīnaḥeṣa sarveśvaro devo hṛdayeśo'khilasya tuantaryāmitvenākhilahṛdayasthitatvād hṛdayeśaḥārtamarthārthinaṃ devastadarthenābhiyojitumtadarthena kāmitārthenanirhetukopāsakaṃ svamananyaśaraṇaṃ vibhuḥevaṃvidhakarmapākaṃ pratīkṣyetyarthaḥ | svaṃ svīyamityarthaḥetadeva maheśatvaṃ svātantryamahataṃ tu yatniyatyāderullaṅghanamevetyarthaḥsṛṣṭikhaṇḍe trayastriṃśe'dhyāye draṣṭavyā |]naitadāgamaikasiddham kintvaitihyasiddhamapītyāha - etaditiatropapattiṃ te vakṣye śṛṇu prāṇapriyeritām [k: ritam]upapattiṃ yuktimtathāpyapauruṣāṇāṃ tat prārabdhamanapohanamapauruṣāṇāṃ puruṣayatnarahitānāmna tān dṛṣṭeṣu duḥkheṣu prārabdhaṃ yojayatyalamkathametajjñātamiti cet pratyakṣeṇetyāha - na tānitietanniyatisaṃkḷptaṃ tathaivānubhavānnanu [kh: na tu]niyateḥ kalpanīyatvāditi bhāvaḥsatyasaṅkalpa eveśo'nullaṅghyā hyata eva sāata eva satyasaṅkalpatvādevaakuṇṭhitāpi bhavati yataḥ sā tādṛśī bhavetsarvatrākuṇṭhitaivetiahetukatayā sa tvāṃ niyojayati śreyasiniṣkāmatvena | saḥ maheśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etadvihāya [k: etadvidhāya] cānyatra nāstīṣatphalasambhavaḥetāvadeva ahetukatvenopāsanameva | anyatra sādhanepapraccha bhūyastāṃ kāntāmatihṛṣṭamanāstadāsarvakartā svatantrātmā yacchaktyā niyataṃ jagattathā sūryaṃ nṛsiṃhādīn buddhaṃ sugatameva cabuddha] | buddhaṃ sugataṃ ca bauddhaikadeśinaḥkarma pradhānamaṇava ityādi bahudhā jaguḥtatra kveśvarabuddhistu kartavyā tat samīrayamatabhe] ata āha - tatretiyataḥ sa bhagavān vyāghrapādo dṛṣṭaparāvaraḥvyāghrapādaḥ te pitāpriyāmṛtaprabhāṣiṇī]ataḥ tatsambandhātnātha te sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇvīśvaravinirṇayamsa viṣṇuḥ sa śivo dhātā sa sūryaḥ soma eva cana śivo nāpi viṣṇurvā na dhātā nānya eva cavāstavaṃ rūpamiti niṣedhati - na śiva ityādikartāraṃ śivamāhuste pañcavaktraṃ trilocanametat śivo na śivaścetyetat | te śaivāḥloke'pi cetanaḥ kartā saśarīro hi dṛśyatekulālādiḥtatra mukhyaṃ hi kartṛtvaṃ cetanasyaiva sambhavetśarīracetanayormadhyecaitanyamayadehena sarvānabhimatān sṛjet| svāpno deho naivaṃvidha ityāha - caitanyeti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jīvānāṃ karaṇāpekṣā yato'pūrṇā svatantratācinmayaṃ vā śarīramīśvarasyāpekṣitamiti cennetyāha - jīvānāmitianapekṣyaiva yatkiñcit sṛjatyavikalaṃ jagatsampūrṇamanyathā lokavatkarturupādānāśrayo bhavetkartuḥ īśvarasya upādānasyāpyāśrayaḥ apekṣā bhavetjagat sṛjanmaheśāno jīva eva bhavettathābhāvaḥ | tathā kulālādivatsiddhyettatsarvakartṛtvaṃ vihataṃ syānna saṃśayaḥtattanmṛdādisaṃskārakrameṇa janayed ghaṭam || (1|41) itināsti tasmāt sthūladeho vastutaḥ prāṇavallabhaataḥ śarīrādyapekṣāyāmaiśvaryavihateḥbhaktuyuktāśca tairdhyāto yatra yatra yathā yathāyathā pañcavaktraikavaktrādirūpeṇaataścetana eveśastaddehaḥ [k: etena] syāccitiḥ parāevaṃvidhadehānāmicchāmātraparikalpitatvāt | parā aparicchinnā citiḥtripurā bhāsate yasyāmavibhinnaṃ [k: bhinnā] vibhinnavataviśeṣāt sarvatra sarvadetyarthaḥtadrūpaikatvatastatra nottamādhamabhāvanānottamādhamabhāvanā kartavyātasmāt prājña upāsīta paraṃ rūpaṃ hi niṣkalamyataḥ sā mukhyatā kalpitā na vāstavī | niṣkalamaśarīramnānyathāsya gatiḥ kvāpi bhavedvai koṭijanmabhiḥparaśreyaḥsādhanaprāptiḥ | ṣaṭcaraṇaḥ ślokaḥtraipuraṃ cinmayaṃ hemalekhāvākyena niścitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñātvā gurubhyaḥ paramāṃ māhaiśvaryavibhāvitaḥevaṃ paropāsanena vyatīyuḥ ke'pi māsakāḥanugatirupāsanamviṣayādvimukhaṃ cittaṃ vicāraparamaṃ babhausvarūpavicāratatparamvicārapravaṇaṃ cittaṃ yanmukhyaṃ mokṣakāraṇamtadāha - yaditina tāvacchreyasā yoga upāyānāṃ śataiḥ kvacitsaṅgataḥ priyayā'tyantavicāraparamānasaḥatha vicāraparatāsampattyanantaramutthāya taṃ samānīya svāsane viniveśya caniketaṃ gṛhamprovācāmṛtaniṣyandasundaraṃ paramaṃ vacaḥnīrujaṃ kaccidāsīdvai yato rogāspadaṃ vapuḥpreṣṭha atipriyatamananu māmasamālokya cāprabhāṣya kadāpi temanye'haṃ te'nabhimate vartanaṃ nahi vartmanitat kutaḥ | svapne'pi na manyekathaṃ rātristvayā nītā caikāpi yugasammitāityuktvā sā samāśliṣya khinnevābhūtkṣaṇaṃ tataḥmāṃ vinā kṣaṇo'pi [k: kṣaṇamapi suduḥsahamiti]prāha priye na māmevaṃ vimohayitumarhasiprāptavān | māmiyaṃ mohayituṃ pravṛtteti jñātvā āha - priye itiparāvarajñā tvaṃ dhīrā mohastvāṃ vai kathaṃ spṛśetkutastvadviyoge śoko na bhavettadāha - parāvareti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yat prāk svavṛttaṃ kathitaṃ tat sphuṭaṃ me samīraya(5|108) ityādi prāguktaṃ svavṛttamtatputrādyā api ca ke mama vā te kva saṃvadate jananyādayaḥkintu tvayā nigaditaṃ vyapadeśena sarvathātat tvaduktam | na tanmṛṣoditam kintvanyavyapadeśenoktamsaṃśayammatvā sunirmaladhiyaṃ parānugrahasaṃyutamparāyāstripurāyā anugrahayutamgh: mahaiśvaryā] phalitaḥ puṇyasañcayaḥanugrahaśaktyānātha te'ho mahābhāgyaṃ prāptamīśakṛpāvaśātyato'yaṃ bodhane kālastata iti matvā prāheti śeṣaḥ | te tvayāetallakṣaṇamīśasyānugrahe jñeyamāditaḥbhāvaḥhanta te sampravakṣyāmi vṛttiṃ proktāṃ sadātmanaḥaparaṃ dvitīyam | vṛttiṃ sthitim sadā sthitāmiti śeṣaḥavidyā tvasatī soktā yayā buddhiḥ susaṅgatāyadrajjau sarpamābhāsya mahābhītiṃ prayacchatitasya patnī kalpanā syāttatsutāḥ pañca ye'bhavanviṣayāṇāṃ pramoṣastu saṃskāro manaso bhavetmahāśanā bhavedāśā tasyā yau tanujāvubhautadbhogaḥ pramuṣitaviṣayabhogaḥmama yastu mahāmantraḥ svarūpasphuraṇaṃ hi tatkāntārādyāstu narakā [k: navakā] evaṃ sarvaṃ prakīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: manmātṛlokasaṃprāptirmokṣaḥ priya udāhṛtaḥtadyuktyaitat suvijñāya paraṃ śreyaḥ samāpnuhietat svavṛttāntamharṣagadgadayā vācā punarvaktuṃ pracakramepunaḥ hemalekhāṃ vaktumkiṃ varṇayāmi yat proktamākhyārūpatayā'khilamtvaduktyā'haṃ samprati tat karāmalakavat sphuṭamkvacit kāle | tat svātmavṛttaṃ krodhalobhādinā duḥkhānubhavarūpamkā sā parā citirmātā kathaṃ tasyāstu no janiḥvyavahāraḥiti pṛṣṭā hemalekhā rāmovāca priyaṃ pratiityātmanaḥ saṃjñāviṣayo'yaṃ praśno jñeyaḥvicārayātmano rūpaṃ buddhyā'tyantaviśuddhayāśakyamiti bhāvaḥmātaramcitiryā mātā tāṃ vadeti cedāha - jñāta itiśuddhabuddhisamāśrayamsvarūpaṃ jñeyamiti bhāvaḥbhāntaṃ sarvatra sarvasya sarvadā mānavarjitambhāvaḥmannetraṃ darśayetyevamuktametat priyādhunāātmānaṃ nirūpayeti [kh, g: yati]nipuṇo'pi mahācāryaḥ kathaṃ netraṃ pradarśayettapomāhātmyādiyuktaḥtatte vakṣyāmyupāyaṃ tacchṛṇu saṃyatamānasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurorupāyapradarśakatvāt | upāyamahaṃ vakṣyāmitataḥ paraṃ nijaṃ rūpaṃ yanmameti na bhāti tebhāti tannijaṃ rūpaṃ vivicyeti sambandhaḥtattat parityajya paraṃ svātmānamabhilakṣayayanmamatvā'nākrāntaṃ tat svātmatvenābhilakṣayasambandhamātrādātmīyā na svarūpagatā [kh: tāsmya] hyahametadeva vivicyopapādayati - yatheti | na svarūpagatā na svarūpāntarbhūtātamātmānaṃ samālakṣya paraṃ śreyaḥ samāpnuhiyayāvaśvaṃ samāruhya tatkṣaṇe nagarād bahiḥvanāntaḥ saudhamunnamraṃ sphāṭikaṃ praviveśa haudyānaṃ krīḍāvanam | unnamramuccamna ko'pyatra praviśatu mayyekāntavicāraṇevicāraṇaṃ vivecanam | tatpare mayi satīti yāvatapraveśyā eva yāvadahamājñāṃ diśāmi vaḥtatra vātāyane citre sarvalokāvalokaneatyuccāmiti yāvatmanaḥ samādhāya dṛḍhaṃ vicāramakarottadākecit paṭhanti śāstrāṇi sāmnāyāṅgāni [k: yāni ca] nityaśaḥsvatmanaḥ sukhahetoḥ | āmnāyo vedaḥnainaṃ jānāti ko'pyatra kuta evamayaṃ bhramaḥvyarthaṃ svapne kṛtamiva tadadya vimṛśāmi tammayā kṛtam | yasmādajñānāt kṛtaṃ vyarthaṃ tat tasmātna me svarūpaṃ bhavati tvanahantāśrayatvataḥahamityabhāsanenāhantāśrayatvābhāvātnūnaṃ kṣatriyadāyādo gaurāṅgo'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: draḍhayati - nūnamitiiti niścitya dadhyau taṃ dehaṃ rājakumārakaḥahanteti | tathaite dehātmāna eva | dehamātmatvena dadhyau cintayāmāsaaho kathaṃ deha eṣa mamatāyāḥ samāśrayaḥhemalekhoktaṃ smṛtvāha - aho itimama rūpaṃ bhavennūnaṃ chinnametattu lakṣyatekathaṃ mama rūpaṃ bhavet | hetvantaramapyāha - chinnamitināhaṃ deho'nya eva syāṃ prāṇo'pyeṣa tathāvidhaḥ| ādipadena suṣuptirjanmāntaraṃ vā | tathāvidho mamatvādyāśrayaḥato dehādibuddhyantādanya [k: ddhyantasta] eva na saṃśayaḥmameritaṃ mamatvenoktam | ato dehādermamatvāśrayatvātsarvadā'haṃ bhāsamānaḥ sthita eva na saṃśayaḥnahi jānāmi tat kasmādetanna viditaṃ mayākasmānnimittānna viditamprāṇastvacā vibhātyeṣa mano jñānena cohitamjñānena jñānātmakakāryahetunā | ūhitaṃ kāryakāraṇatvenānumitamathaiṣāṃ bhāsanādeva nātmā bhāseta me yadieṣāmitiiti niścitya manasā jahau mānasagocarammānasollekham [k: llekhaḥ]idaṃ mamātmano rūpamiti niścitamānasaḥmānasaṃ manovikārātmaka tamo yenanūnaṃ punaḥ prapaśyāmītyevaṃ cittaṃ rurodha vaipraharṣam ātmā dṛṣṭa iti bhramajanitam [k: śrama]tejaḥpuñjamanādyantaṃ bhāsvaraṃ kṣaṇamātrataḥ

sanskrit: prāṇāyāmanirodhādyabhyāsena | bhāsvaraṃ prakāśaikanibiḍamaho paśyāmi vividhaṃ kimātmānaṃ kathaṃ tvidamvismitaḥvilīnaṃ nidrayā cittaṃ babhau cirataraṃ dṛḍhamnidrāhetunā cittaṃ vilīnamatha prabuddho'tyantaṃ vai cintāṃ prāpa mahattarāmtamastejaścāpi dṛṣṭamaho svapnātmakaṃ [k: tmako] bhavetbhūyo nigṛhya paśyāmītyevaṃ niścitya vai dṛḍhamcintayati - svapna iti | etaṃ svapnamtadānandasamudrāntarnimagna iva so'bhavatsthiramabhavat | tadā niruddhacittadaśāyāmkimeṣa me'bhavat svapnaścā'thavā cittavibhramaḥ[k: danniva kalpa] vikalpayati - kimeṣa itinā'nvabhūvaṃ kiñcidapi sukhamāptaṃ kathaṃ mayānirodhakāle sukhānubhava iti śaṅkate - nānvabhūvamitiahaṃ suṣuptavanmūḍhaḥ kathametat sukhaṃ sthitamkathameṣa sukhānubhavaḥātmāvagamanāyāhaṃ pravṛtto'pyadya nāvidamatra sukhopalabdhau tat sukhaṃ hetuṃ vinā kathaṃ bhavetprakāśo vāndhakāro vā sukhaṃ vānyadathāpi vā| atha prakāśādibhyo'nyadeva vetyarthaḥnāntamemyatra bhūyastāṃ pṛcchāmi viduṣīṃ priyāmbhavet | atrāntaṃ niścayaṃ naimi na prāpnomisvasannidhānamānetuṃ hemalekhāṃ nṛpātmajaḥāruroha mahāsaudhaṃ meruminduprabheva sā

sanskrit: niścalaṃ nirvikāraṃ ca saṃhṛtendriyamaṇḍalam[kh, g, gh: calaḥ] prāṇacāraḥ | vikāraḥ kāmādiḥekāsanopaviṣṭāyāṃ tasyāṃ sa nimiṣārddhataḥbhartṛsamīpam | tasyāṃ hemalekhāyāṃ sa hemacūḍaḥālokitā priyaṃ śīghraṃ praṇayāt pariṣasvajepriyāṃ samālokayat | ālokitā sānātha kiṃ bhavatāhūtā kaccitte nīrujaṃ tanauevaṃ priyānuyuktaḥ sa babhāṣe svātmanaḥ priyāmvicāraparamaḥ svātmarūpalakṣaṇahetavevijñānam taddheturyaya mokṣasya tadarthaṃ vicāraparama iti sambandhaḥātmanaḥ sarvadā prāpterbhāsamānatvato'pi caātmatvādeva prāptatvam prakāśarūpatvādbhāsamānatvamiti matvā nirudhyānyabhāsanaṃ suvyavasthitaḥbhāsanakaraṇamindriyādi [k: diniruktam] niruddhyakvacit sukhaṃ mahat prāptaṃ kimetadvada me priyesamyag vivicya kathaya yathā tamabhilakṣayesamādheranyatraśṛṇu priya pravakṣyāmi samāhitadhiyā'khilamsa śubhaḥ sammataḥ sarvaiḥ sumukhyaścātmavedibhiḥsumukhyaḥna tat kāraṇatāmeti tatprāptau prāptabhāvataḥvivakṣitam na tvātmano vijñānam | atastasya prāptatvamiti bhāvaḥaprāpyaḥ sarvathaivātmā prāptistasya na vidyateetadeva sādhayati - aprāptāvititannirodho'pi nāptyarthastvatra paśya nidarśanam

sanskrit: tannirodhaḥ manonirodhaḥ | nidarśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntamdīpādyairāpyate prāptamiva loke yathā tathāsvarūpaprāpakatvamiti bhāvaḥanyacintānirodhena samāhitatayā punaḥdṛṣṭāntāntaramāha - yatheti | niṣkaṃ suvarṇamna nirodho'tra hetuḥ syānniṣkāptau tu yathā tathāyathā'nyacintānirodho na niṣkaprāptau hetustathā prakṛte'pi nirodho na hetuḥtvayā na lakṣitaḥ svātmā tatra vyutpattivarjanāt- tatreti | vyutpattiḥ vastuparicayaḥpaśyan sabhyāṃśca dīpāṃśca na jānāti prakāśakamparicayahīnaḥ | evaṃ tvayā na lakṣita iti yojyamandhakārāvalokādau śeṣabhāvastava sthitaḥkālaṃ kiñcidavidannāsamityanusandhānāccetiatra sarve mahāmohagrahagrastāḥ parāgdṛśaḥyaduktam - paśyāmīti parāgdṛṣṭeralabhyaṃ tat paraṃ padam itisanti loke śāstravidaḥ kuśalāśca sutārkikāḥśocantyeveti bhāvaḥśabdārthaśilpamātreṇa nahi tatpadamāpyateśabdārthe śrutārthe śilpo mananaṃ tanmātreṇatāvanna prāpyate tadvai yato na grāhyameva tatcittārūḍhateti bhāvaḥna tadvicārya vijñeyamavicārād vibhāsatepratyagrūpatvenendriyamanonirodhamantarā durvijñeyatvamiti bhāvaḥyathā hi nirmalādarśe pratibimbasahasrakamnirūpayati - yatheti

sanskrit: paśyan svātmamahādarśe pratibimbaṃ hi jāgatamyathā paricitākāśaḥ paśyannākāśasaṃśritamnātmānaṃ paśyatīti bhāvaḥnātha sūkṣmadṛśā paśya jñānajñeyātmakaṃ jagatpramāṇānāṃ pramāṇaṃ tadapramāṇaṃ svato bhavetsvasattāyāmananyāpekṣamiti bhāvaḥsiddhisādhakabhāvena [g: siddha] na tatsiddhiḥ kadācanasūtre] vitānitamanapahnavanīyaṃ tanmahādarśatalaṃ bhavettanmahādarśetideśena vāpi kālena paricchittirna vidyatedeśenetiparicchedasya bhānaṃ tu gagane vastubhiryathāevetyāha - paricchedasyeti | vastubhiḥ ghaṭādyaiḥyatra sāmānyacaitanye jagadetad virājatetasyopalabdhiṃ vakṣyāmi yataḥ prāpnoṣi [k: prāpnoti] tatpadamyasmād madvacanāt | tatpadaṃ sāmānyacaitanyasthānammadhye saṃvidvedyayośca sūkṣmabuddhyā'bhilakṣayatasyoapalabdhisthānānyetānīti bhāvaḥetadajñānamātreṇa pravṛttaṃ jagadīdṛśamdṛśyābhāsasyāpīti bhāvaḥna duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ vā tu na grāhyaṃ grāhakaṃ ca nasāmānyarūpeṇa niṣedhaḥ | grāhakamindriyādieṣa sarveśvaro dhātā viṣṇurīśaḥ sadāśivaḥsarveśvarādiriti bhāvaḥ

sanskrit: tyaktvā bahiḥprasaratāmantaḥprasaraṇodyataḥ[k, kh: svarūpaṃ] vyāpārānupapatteḥdarśanādarśane tyaktvā yo'si so'si drutaṃ bhajakālavilambamapahāya drutaṃ bhajeti bhāvaḥciraṃ viśrāntimālabhya bahirvismaraṇaṃ yayaunirvikalpasamādhiḥna cālayat parapadāttataḥ so'pi muhūrtataḥprāptā parasmin sāmānyacidrūpe sthitiryena | na cālayat nodvodhayatbhūyastatpadaviśrāntimīhamāno'tivegataḥsapriyaṃ priyāsahitam | tatpadaviśrāntiḥ samādhiḥpriyaṃ haste samādāya sudhāsundarabhāṣiṇīsā hemalekhāunmīlanādvā kiṃ syātte lābhālābhau samīrayavyavasitaṃ niścitam | nimīlanādinā yadbhaved lābho'lābho vā tau samīrayatanme brūhi priyatama śrotumicchāmi te sthitimetasyaiva vivecanam - unmīlyeti | sthitim abhyupagamamanicchannapi vaktuṃ tāmālasyabharamantharaḥmantharaḥ mandavyavahāraḥna bāhye duḥkhabhūyiṣṭhe viśramo'sti kvacinmamaviśrāntiṃ viśramaṇaṃ duḥkhāsambhinnasukhamityetat | bāhye vyavahārevaiṣayikasukhavadasat kṣaṇikamiti bhāvaḥtathā'haṃ svasukhāmbhodhmaviditvā punaḥ punaḥsvātmasambandhisukhāmbhodhimvidyudvilayanaṃ matvā sthiraṃ tatparatāvaśātvilayanaṃ nāśo yasya | tatparatā tadāśrayaṇam

sanskrit: aho janā duḥkhasukhavivekajñānavarjitāḥduḥkhamevānubhavantītyāha - aho ititadalaṃ duḥkhabhogena svayatnāsāditena vaiduḥkhasaṅghaṃ duḥkhasādhanajālaṃ dhanagṛhādikamviśrāntimabhivāñchāmi ciraṃ svasmin sukhātmaniviśrāntiṃ proktasukhātmakasvasvarūpāvasthānātmakaṃ samādhimceṣṭasi]ceṣṭase [kh, g, gh: ceṣṭasi] vyavahāraparāsinātha te tanna viditaṃ padaṃ paramapāvanamahamasmīti na pratyabhijñātam | paramapāvanaṃ dvaitamalaleśarahitamtatpadaṃ dūrataste'sti bhūsthasyeva nabhastalamnimīlyonmīlya vā netre tatpadaṃ na samīkṣyatecedāha - nimīlyetiagatvā cāpi vā gatvā na tadāsādayet padamtatsvarūpe nimīlanakaraṇagamanādibhirna viśeṣa iti bhāvaḥyavāṣṭakamitenaiva pakṣmaṇonmīlitena tusopahāsamāha - yavāṣṭaketiaho te mohamāhātmyamāścaryaṃ kimahaṃ bruvepakṣmaṇo'ṅgulimānasyonmīlanāttattirohitamyasmin sāmānyacidrūpe ātmani | tirohitamityāścaryamiti sambandhaḥyāvat granthivibhedo na na tāvat sukhamṛcchatitatra svarūpāsaṃvittirmoharajjurudīritāmoharajjuriti cedāha - tatretitatrādyā dehamukhyeṣu bhavedātmatvaniścayaḥduṣparihara ityasya granthitvaṃ jñeyam

sanskrit: tathā jagatyanātmatvabuddhirbhānasamāśrayedvitīyagranthitvaṃ jñeyametaccirāt samudbhūtaṃ bhūyaḥ saṃvartitaṃ ca vaigranthirityucyata iti tātparyamtadgranthivisraṃsanato bandhānmuktiḥ samīritāpuruṣā apīti bhāvaḥtatpadaṃ nijarūpaṃ te śuddhasaṃvidanuttaramsarvaniṣedhāvadhibhūtamkadā kva kena rūpeṇa nāsti tanme nirūpayakāladeśākāraparicchedanirāsaḥtarhi tatkāladeśādervandhyāputratvameva hidvitīye'prakāśamānānāṃ tucchatvaṃ durapohamityabhisandhiḥtasmāttatpadasaṃtyāgānnāsti kutrāpi kiñcana- pratibimba iti | tatpadaṃ sāmānyacaitanyamyāvadevaṃ vijānāmītyevaṃ granthirdṛḍhā bhavetvijānāmi ityevamabhimānarūpā granthiḥnimīlyonmīlya vā netre yatprāptaṃ manyase padametadeva viśadayati - nimīlyetikutra nātha mahāsaṃvinnāsti kālānalaprabhāpariccheda iti bhāvaḥna te kartavyasaṃśeṣo vijñāya paramaṃ padamna ta iti | śeṣo bhavediti śeṣaḥidaṃ nāhamiti granthimunmūlaya parāṃ dṛḍhāmdṛśyasya pratibimbatulyatvāditi bhāvaḥpaśyātmanyakhilaṃ lokaṃ darpaṇapratibimbavat

sanskrit: śeṣamabhyupagamyāntaḥ svastho bhava nijātmanājñātvā nānuśocati || (yo0 vā0 3|7|9) itividitvā pūrṇamātmānaṃ sarvatra bhrāntivarjitaḥbhrāntivivarjitaḥviharan sarvadā hemalekhādiyuvatīgaṇaiḥsthiratatsaṃskāra ityarthaḥ | viharan bhuvi sthita iti dūrasthena saṃbandhaḥśāstrāṇi śrāvayan śṛṇvannarjayan dhanasaṃcayamvarṣāṇāmayute dve vai jīvanmukto bhuvi sthitaḥmuktācūḍaśca tadbhrātā maṇicūḍo'pyacintayathemacūḍapitā muktācūḍo nṛpaḥsukhe na hṛṣyatyatyantaṃ duḥkhe nodvijate tathātaccintanaprakāramāha - kimayamiti | ayaṃ hemacūḍaḥkaroti rājakāryāṇi naṭavad raṅgamaṇḍalenaṭavacchannāntarabhiprāyaḥsadānyatra gatasvānta iva kṛtyaṃ karotyalamkāpiśāyanaṃ madyamapṛcchatāṃ hemacūḍaṃ kuta evaṃ bhavānititaṃ hemacūḍam | muktācūḍamaṇicūḍāvapṛcchatāmtāvubhau bhrātṛpitarau hemadūḍena bodhitautayoḥ pitṛbhrātroḥatha mantrigaṇo'pyevaṃ rājñaḥ śrutvā jagadgatimjagadgatiṃ jagata ātmā'vyatiriktarūpatvena sthitimevaṃ viśālanagare krameṇaiva parasparamsaṃbandhaḥnarā nāryo bālavṛddhā dāsā dāsīgaṇā api

sanskrit: tattvaṃ vastuyāthātmyamna tatra kasyacit kāmaḥ krodho vā lobha eva vāanāhṛto nāstīti saṃbandhaḥāhṛtaiḥ krodhakāmādyairvyavahāraparāyaṇāḥevaṃ tatra sarveṣāmiti bhāvaḥdāsā dāsyaḥ svāminaṃ svaṃ sadā paricaranti vaiduḥkhamityādirūpayā | evamagre'pi jñeyamnaṭā nāṭyaṃ vitanvanti pātraistattvaprasaṅgajaiḥtattvaprasaṅgajaiḥ pātraiḥ vivekamohādiveṣaiḥvidūṣakā dūṣayanti lokavyavahṛtiṃ sadāparatattvavicārārhairudāharaṇamaṇḍalaiḥbhṛtyā bhaṭā mantriṇaśca śilpino vārayoṣitaḥprāksaṃskārabalenaiva vyavahāraparāyaṇāḥprāksaṃskāramātreṇa śastravartmasvaskhalan yudhyati tatheti bhāvaḥbhaviṣyad nānusandhatte harṣaśokādisādhanambhaviṣyaśokādi nānusaṃdhattemadhukṣība ivātyantaṃ vyavahāraparo janaḥvartamāne harṣasukhādauprasiddhavidyānagaramityākhyamūcurāgatāḥsanakādayaḥ sanakavāmadevādyāḥ | nagaramāgatā iti saṃbandhaḥcitirūpaṃ svamātmānaṃ bhajadhvaṃ cetyavarjitamyatretyādiślokacatuṣṭayaṃ caturthādhyāyāntagataṃ prāg vyākhyātamcitiścetyaṃ citirahaṃ citiḥ sarvaṃ carācaramataścitiṃ janāḥ sarvabhāsinīṃ sarvasaṃśrayāmtiryañco'pyevamatyantaṃ yatra vāco vadanti vai

sanskrit: evaṃ tatra purā hemalekhayā khalu bodhitaḥstrībālapramukhāḥ sarve jātā jñātaparāvarāḥtasmācchreyovāñchane tu satsaṃśrayaparo bhavetyasmāddhemalekhāsaṅgāt sarve muktā jātāstasmāt sajjanasaṃśrayaparaḥbhārgavaḥ sandigdhamanāḥ praṣṭuṃ samupacakramesarvataḥ sādhanairasādhyaṃ cabhāti me viṣamaṃ hyetadasādhyaṃ cāpi sarvataḥadṛṣṭaṃ kevalaṃ hyetacchraddhopeyaṃ na cānyathānopalabdhyupapattibhyāmiti tātparyamnopapannaṃ sarvathaitat kathaṃ cittaṃ samāruhetityāpṛṣṭo dattagururavadad bhārgavaṃ pratiatra śuddhacitiviṣayeetad dṛśyamaśeṣaṃ tu dṛśimātraṃ na cetarattadevāha - etaditietad dṛśyaṃ kāryabhūtamutpatterupalambhataḥetaditi | kāryaṃ kartṛvyāpāraviṣayamnūtanatvenaiva bhāti tatkṣaṇotpattimajjagatjagannūtanatvenaiva pratikṣaṇaṃ bhāti tasmādityarthaḥ | etaccāgre bhaviṣyatianye padārthasaṃghātamayaṃ sthiracarātmakamprathamamupapādanamiti dhyeyamtatra svabhāvavādastu nocito'tiprasaṅgataḥpaṭakāraṇaṃ kuto na bhavediti cet svakāraṇavaicityāditi gṛhāṇasaṃvādataḥ pravṛttīnāṃ kathamākasmikaṃ bhavetkāryamākasmikaṃ niṣkāraṇaṃ kathaṃ bhavetbahūnāmanurodho hi nyāyyaḥ sarvairudāhṛtaḥ

sanskrit: dṛṣṭavat parikalpyaṃ syādanyathā sārvalaukikīākasmikatvābhyupagama ityarthaḥ | sārvalaukikī saṃpravṛttirityanvayaḥata eva kāryahetoḥ kiñcitkāraṇatatparaḥtatparā] dṛśyata iti sambandhaḥkecidāhurasatkalpairaṇubhiḥ kāryamudyatambhavedeveti tātparyam] na kuto bhavetsattvāsattvayorvirodhātekaṃ bhaved viruddhatvāt sāṅkaryādiprasaktitaḥguṇasāmyaprakṛtikaṃ jagadityapyasaṃbhavicetanenānadhiṣṭhānād dṛṣṭāntānupalambhataḥsaṅgamaḥ[k, kh: kṣādirna] na pravṛttirityarthaḥkāryakartraviyogasya [k, kh: kartṛ] bhūyodarśanahetutaḥkartravinābhūtamiti bhūyodarśanājjagat sakartṛkamityarthaḥkāryasyācintyarūpasya kartā sādhāraṇaḥ kathamjaḍe'sambhavādityāha - sambhavāditipūrṇasya tvapratihataṃ pramāṇaṃ sarvato'dhikampramāṇebhyo'dhikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prablamityetatsvatantro hyanupādānaḥ svātantryabharavaibhavātbhara utkarṣaḥ tasya vaibhavānmāhātmyādavabhāsayadityanvayaḥyathā svapnamanorājye kalpitaṃ svena kevalamkevalamupādānādyanapekṣya parikalpitaṃ dehamna te rūpaṃ yathā dehaḥ svapnavyāvṛttihetutaḥyathā hi manorājyaparikalpitadeho na te svarūpam svapnādau vyāvṛtteḥdehādivyatiriktastvaṃ yathā kevalacinmayaḥ

sanskrit: dehādītitenedaṃ svātmani jagaccitramunmīlitaṃ nanuīśvareṇaṛte citiṃ kadācidvā kva kiṃ bhavitumarhatikadā kva mimiti kāladeśākārapratiṣedhaḥabhāvaśca citeḥ kena sidhyettasmāccitiḥ parāniṣedhāvadhibhūtatvātbhā]jagaditi sadṛṣṭāntamāha - samudramititasmādeṣa mahādevaḥ śudhacaitanyavigrahaḥtasmācchuddhacaitanyavigraho dṛśyaleśarahita āsīditi sambandhaḥtasmin vilīyate cānte jagadetaccarācaramsamudrādimātrādyātmatvam evaṃ jagataścinmātrātmatvamiti bhāvaḥadṛṣṭārtheṣu saṃvādāt pramāṇaṃ hyāgamo bhavetāgamaḥ pramāṇameva bhavediti bhāvaḥnālpaprajño vijānīyād maṇimantramahāphalamdātuṃ] na samartha ityāha - netitatrokto deva evādau sṛṣṭerjagata āsthitaḥdevaścinmātramūrtirīśvaraḥ evakāreṇa pradhānādivyāvṛttiḥsvātantryam tena yutaḥna tajjagat sambhavati bahiḥ kvacidavasthitamanyasthānasthitaṃ tacca kathañcinnaiva sidhyatijagatsiddhyati citprakāśabahirgatasyāprakāśādityāha - anyasthānetijagadunmīlitaṃ deve caivaṃ sarvaṃ samañjasamsamañjasamiti bhāvaḥ

sanskrit: saṅkalpanagaraprakhyā sṛṣṭirdevasya sammatābhāvaḥanekamātṛmeyādipracurā hyavabhāsatesṛṣṭiḥ saṅkalpanagarapracurā yā'vabhāsate sā manomayīti sambandhaḥutpanā manasastatra sthitā tatraiva līyatesambandhaḥcidatirikto vigraho deho yasyāḥsā citiḥ sarvataḥ pūrṇā paricchedavivarjanātsamyak sādhayitumupakramate - sā citirititatrākāramayo deśaḥ kālastu syāt kriyāmayaḥtasyāḥ paricchedakatvamanayoḥ syāt kathaṃ vadakathañcidātmaparicchedakatvamityarthaḥyatra na syāccitiḥ so'pi kathaṃ syāditi vai bhavetbhāvaḥprakāśastu citiḥ proktā nāciteḥ syāt [k: nācitaḥ] prakāśatāevāstitvamiti bhāvaḥjaḍā na svaprakāśā hi citiyogaprakāśanātjaḍānāṃ svatantraḥ prakāśa iti bhāvaḥjaḍāścitiṃ samāśritya prakāśante na cānyathāasti nāstīti loke'smin vyavasthā nahi setsyatidṛśyaḥ pratyakṣatvādityādivanneya itiyathā hi pratibibimbānāṃ sattvaṃ darpaṇa eva hidarpaṇasattvameva pratibimbānāṃ sattvamityarthaḥadhikaṃ bhāsate yattu tannairmalyamahittvataḥ [k: mahattvataḥ]mahattvataḥ] māhātmyādityarthaḥ

sanskrit: tayostu tāratamyena pratibimbaḥ sphuṭo'sphuṭaḥkāṭhinyanirmalatvayoḥ | tāratamyena nyūnādhikabhāvenajaḍatvād darpaṇādestu svātantryaparivarjanātbimbāpekṣeti sambandhaḥnirmalatvaṃ svataḥsiddhaṃ citermālinyavarjanātnirmalatvamiti | ākāśavadasaṅgatvena mālinyavarjanātaikātmyarūpyāccicchakterakhaṇḍatvācca sarvathāniravayavatvenākhaṇḍatvādariktātmatvamiti bhāvaḥasvato bhāsamānasya bhānamanyānuṣaṅgataḥjagadetādṛśaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaiḥ samabhilakṣitampratibimbamiti | pratibimbatvamityarthaḥ | etādṛśaṃ pratibimalakṣaṇavatato jagat syādādarśapratibimbasusaṃmitamlakṣaṇaṃ jagati yojayati - svata iti | susaṃmitaṃ samamsvarūpādapracyutaivādarśavalleśato'pi hieva leśato'pyapracyutetyanvayaḥcidātmapratibimbānāṃ cidātmānanyatā tathācitiḥ(ti) svātantryahetuḥ syāt pratibimbo hi jāgataḥpratibimbaḥbhāvān bimbavinābhūtānnirnimitāvabhāsanānparaciti jagatpratibimbanamiti bhāvaḥasaṅkalpadaśāyāṃ sā citiḥ svacchaikarūpiṇīsvacchaikacinmātrarūpiṇībṛhat svātantryamabhavat saṅkalpātmakameva tatjagadrūpatāpattireva saṅkalpatvamiti bhāvaḥbṛhatsaṅkalpasusthairyāccirametad vibhāsate

sanskrit: saṅkalpānyūnakālatvaniyamāditi bhāvaḥanyeṣāṃ tadapūrṇatvād bhātyasādhāraṇātmanāiti bhāvaḥtyajet saṅkocamātmasthaṃ tathā tatra hi bhāsanamprasiddhau | ādinauṣadhiḥ | etaiḥ sādhitaiḥ | tatra tatsvātantryakalpitebhāsayantaṃ jagaccitraṃ saṅkalpādeva sarvataḥsvātmanyupasaṃharecca jagadevaṃ vibhasateevamīśvarasṛṣṭamapi jagadvibhāsateyoginastu mitatvena sṛṣṭirbāhyā vibhāvitāevā'khilaviśvavaicitryamavabhāsayituṃ samartha iti dhyeyamata eva cidātmatvavyatirekādasatyatā- [k, kh: cidātmavya] cidātmatvetiata eva vicāreṇāsatyatāṃ yāti nānyathāpratibimbātmakametajjagaditi vicāre kṛte na satyatāṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥjagat paśya bhārgavaitat svabhāvādaticañcalamaticañcalaṃ kṣaṇikampratibimbādarśabhānamiva tatpravicārayajagaccidātmanorbhānaṃ bhavediti pravicārayeti bhāvaḥtathā jagaccalaṃ saṃvidacalā sarvabhāvitājagatsaṃvidoścalācalatvaṃ sarvairjñātamityāha - sarvetitathā hi sūryāloko hi vastūnāmavabhāsakaḥbhāvaḥ | vicārāsahatvamevopapādayati bhāveṣu tathā hītisandhirārṣaḥ] sphuṭebhāvaḥmanuṣyādeḥ pratighātakarī bhītirhi lakṣyate

sanskrit: pratīghāto gamanapratibandhaḥkālo deśaśca dīrgho yo manuṣyādiprabhāvitaḥkāla itidarpaṇe bhāsamānasya dūrāderdūratā yathāata āśrayarūpeṇa vinā nāsti hi kiñcanapratibimbātmakatvājjagata āśrayarūpeṇa cidātmanā vinā nāstītyarthaḥevaṃ jagaccidekātmarūpaṃ te samyagīritamkh: tadīyatā] granthenopapādyopasaṃharati - evamitipapraccha bhārgavo bhūyaḥ saṃdehakalilāntaraḥyathā bravīṣi bhagavaṃstattathaiva na cā'nyathājāgatam svarūpamiti śeṣaḥ | tathaiva citimātrarūpamevakuto vā'nyairbuddhimadbhiḥ satyatvena viniścitambuddhimadbhistarkanipuṇaiḥbrūhyetat kṛpayā nātha yathā naśyedayaṃ bhramaḥme jagat satyatvena bhāti etad brūhijagatsatyabhrāntimūlaṃ pravaktumupacakramesatyamiti yā bhrāntiḥ tanmūlaṃ tannimittamhṛdā] tatkva māṃsarudhirāsthīni kva cidātmātinirmalaḥbuddhim | śarīraṃ kuto nātmeti cedāha - kveti | atinirmalaḥ cidekarasaḥjñāte'pyātmani cidrūpe bhūyo bhrāntiḥ śarīrakepunarbhrāntiḥviparītaṃ bhāvayan vai dṛḍhabhrāntiṃ nivartayetyogināṃ dhāraṇādhyānaiḥ paśya tadrūpasaṅgatimtadrūpasaṅgatiṃ jagato bhāvanānurūpatāprāptim

sanskrit: asti vaṅge sundarākhyaṃ puraṃ paramapāvanamparamapāvanaṃ tīrthabhūtamtasya bhrātā mahāseno yavīyān priyakṛt sadāyavīyān kaniṣṭhaḥ | bhrātuḥ [k: bhrātā] priyakṛtkadācidaśvamedhaiḥ so'yajad devaṃ maheśvarammahatyā senayā yajñā'śvaṃ sarve hyanusaṃyayuḥtatra yajñe | aśvacaryāyāmaśvamanugatāḥyayurairāvatītīramanvaśvaṃ nṛpateḥ sutāḥrodhakān śatrūn | airāvatī nadī | anvaśvam aśvapṛṣṭhataḥbaloddhatā avajñāya tamasaṅgamya te yayuḥpraṇāmādipūrvakaṃ samīpamagatvetyarthaḥ | te rājakumārāḥjagrāhāśvaṃ yajñiyaṃ taṃ rājaputran hi bhartsayantāvattaṅgaṇaputro'pi gaṇḍaśailaṃ puraḥ sthitamtaṃ muniputramsāśvaṃ śilāvilīnaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājakumārakāḥtaṃ muniputramcūrṇitād gaṇḍaśailāt sa mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥuccāvacairuttamairadhamaiśca | cūrṇitāt cūrṇitaikadeśātnihatya senāṃ sauṣeṇīṃ baddhvā rājakumārakāntān rājakumārānatha senābhaṭāḥ śiṣṭā gatvā rājñe nyavedayansundarapuraṃ gatvāsuṣeṇo vismito'tyantamuvācāvarajaṃ svakamtacchrutvā vismitaḥtapasvino'cintyavīryā ajeyā devamānuṣaiḥ

sanskrit: yato'jeyāḥ ataḥ prasādya | aśvamedhasya kālaḥna kālo'tivrajedeṣa vasanto yajñasammataḥkruddhāstapasvino lokān bhasmīkuryuḥ kṣaṇena vaiityādiṣṭo mahāsenastaṃ deśaṃ śīghramāyayausvārtham aśvādimocanam | taṃ deśaṃ taṅgaṇenāstitamkāṣṭhakuḍyātmatāṃ prāptaṃ śāntendriyamanodhiyambāhyāntaḥkaraṇayoścāñcalyābhāva ukto jñeyaḥpraṇamya daṇḍavad bhūyaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭastadādhyeyam | evaṃvidhaṃ taṅgaṇaṃ praṇamyatathā tasya saṃstuvato hyatyagādvai dinatrayamprovāca taṃ mahāsenaṃ rājaṃstuṣṭo'smi saṃstavātahaṃ putro'smyasya vibhostaṅgaṇasya mahāmuneḥsamāhitasvānta eṣa dvādaśābdādanantaramanantaraṃ samuttiṣṭhedityanvayaḥsaptāvaśeṣā evaṃ hi samayo'sya purātanaḥsamayaḥ saṅketaḥ saṅkalpa iti yāvat | asya me pituḥna māṃ bālaṃ vijānīhi pitṛtulyaṃ tapasvinamna vijānīhiśrutvā munikumāroktaṃ mahāseno'tibuddhimānatibuddhimāniti | bālānāmanavasthitatvajña iti bhāvaḥmuniputra ! priyaṃ me'dya karoṣi yadi satyataḥsaha sambhāṣaṇaṃ kiñcidetadatyantavāñchitamsahaśabdena yogādityarthaḥ |]śrutvaitadvacanaṃ rājñaḥ prāha tāpasajaḥ punaḥtathāpi te karomīti pratiśrutyānyathā katham

sanskrit: kathaṃ bravīmīti sambandhaḥmuhūrtamātraṃ me paśya sāmarthyaṃ yogasambhavamsaṃsthitastaṃ bāhyayatnairapi ko vai prabodhayetśāntapade nirvikalparūpeityuktvātha samāviśya samāhṛtyendriyāṇyalamalamatyantamindriyāṇi samāhṛtya saṃruddhyadehaṃ pituḥ praviśyāśu pralīnaṃ tasya mānasamnirgacchatīti jñeyamdehaṃ svamāviśad yāvattāvat sa bubudhe muniḥpitṛdehādvinirgataḥ | saḥ taṅgaṇaḥkimetaditi sañcintya sarvaṃ yogadṛśā'vidatsarvaṃ putrādiceṣṭitamvatsa ! naivaṃ puaḥ kāryaṃ krodhastu tapaso ripuḥkrodhenāśvaharaṇādikamyajñavighnakriyā daityasvabhāvo na muneḥ kvacitrājñeti | anupakāriṇo'pi yajñe vighno'yukta ityāha - yajñetiśīghraṃ yātveṣa yajñasya na kālatikramo bhavetsumanā iti | roṣaṃ [k: śeṣaṃ] tyaktvetyarthaḥ | eṣa rājabhrātāsāśvān rājasutāṃstasmai dadau prītyā gatakrudhaḥsaḥ muniputraḥ | tasmai mahāsenāyamahāsenastaṅgaṇaṃ taṃ praṇamyātyantavismitaḥbhagavan jñātumicchāmi sāśvā me bhrātṛnandanāḥevaṃ rājñā'nuyukto'tha taṅgaṇaḥ prāha bhūpatimkathamiti | gaṇḍaśailasya saghanatvādityarthaḥsamudravalayāṃ pṛthvīmanvaśāsaṃ ciraṃ khalu

sanskrit: tathā]citipratibimbatvena nistattvabhūtatvātprāviśaṃ vanametad vai bhāryā māmanvagāt satīnirviṇṇo jātālaṃbuddhiḥ | lokayātrāyā vyavahṛteḥbhāryāpi matsevanena parāṃ siddhimupāgatāparāṃ siddhiṃ mokṣamsamādhāveva kāmārtamānasā'bhūttatastu sāsamādhāveva niruddhaṃ manaḥ kāmakāreṇa prodbuddhamiti bhāvaḥasahantī kāmavegaṃ bhāvayāmāsa madratimdadhāra garbhaṃ suṣuve putramenaṃ puraḥ sthitamdehaṃ bhūteṣu sātkṛtya paravyomātmatāṃ yayausātkṛtya saṃyojya | paravyoma paraṃ brahmadayākrāntamanā jātastenāyaṃ varddhito mayātasyāḥ patnyāḥ | ayaṃ sutaḥrājyaśāsanakāmo'bhūt prārthayāmāsa māmanuayaṃ putraḥ | mayā kṛtāmnirmāya bhāvanāyogād lokamasmin mahāśmaniyogarddhi yogaiśvaryam | asmin puraḥ sthitetalloke'śvaḥ sutā rājño niruddhāste hi mocitāḥiti śrutvā munivaco bhūyaḥ papraccha bhūpatiḥtaṃ lokaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi kṛpayā me pradarśayavatsāsmai darśaya svīyaṃ lokaṃ sarvaṃ yathepsitamatha taṃ taṅgaṇasutaḥ samāsādya nṛpaṃ yayausamāhitiṃ samādhimpraveṣṭuṃ nāśakad bhūpa āhvayantaṃ muneḥ sutam

sanskrit: bhāvaḥatha bhūyo viniṣkramya prāha bhūpaṃ muneḥ sutaḥayogād gaṇḍaśailo'yaṃ ghanaḥ sapratigho'bhavatpraveśapratibandhakaḥtadatra dehaṃ vinyasya koṭare tṛṇasaṃvṛte [g: saṃkule]śarīropaghātakakākādibhyo rakṣaṇāya tṛṇasaṃvṛta itiityuktaḥ prāha nṛpatiraśakto dehanirgamedehānnirgameutsṛjāmi yadi balānnāśameṣyāmi sarvathābalāt śvāsapratirodhajihvotpāṭanādinā [k: rodhaka]aho yogānabhijño'si cāstu netre nimīlayaākṛṣya talliṅgatanuṃ kṣiptvā śvabhre ca tattanumtaṃ rājadeham | tattanuṃ rājñaḥ sthūlatanumsuṣuptaṃ dehavaikalyāt svasaṅkalpotthadehakesthūladehavaikalyāt | sthūle svasaṅkalpotthānyadehakegṛhītaṃ muninā.paśyat svaṃ mahāgagane tadātadyogasāmarthyamiti pūrvottaragranthārthasiddho'bhiprāyo jñeyaḥbhītaḥ prāha muneḥ putraṃ mune māṃ na parityajaviṣvak paritaḥiti bhītaṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā prahasyāha muneḥ sutaḥenaṃ śailāntarasthānaṃ lokaṃ dhairyeṇa sarvataḥniśāmaya paśya | lokaṃ prāṇisamudāyamadho dūre sanakṣatramabhramandhatamovṛtamnakṣatralokoparyandhakārasya sarvabāhyasya vidyamānatvāditi bhāvaḥcandramaṇḍalamāsphītaṃ tatrāgatya jaḍīkṛtaḥ

sanskrit: candramaṇḍalasamīpe āgatya rājā śītena jaḍīkṛto'bhavatatha prāpya sūryalokaṃ tatkarairabhitāpitaḥapaśyallokamakhilaṃ svarlokapratibimbavatmunipradarśitaṃ sarvamapaśyat pṛthvīpatiḥapaśyadvalyātmānaṃ lokālokākhyaparvatamśubhekṣaṇo'pratihatanetraḥ [k: hṛtanetraḥ]samudrān saptadvīpāṃśca nadīgirisamākulāntadvahiḥ lokālokabahiḥ | antaḥ lokālokāntaḥdaityān manuṣyān rakṣāṃsi yakṣakimpuruṣādikānathā'paśyad bhūvibhāge kṛtvā rūpāntaraṃ tathābhūvibhāge bhūlokeevaṃ munikumārasya dṛṣṭvā yogarddhimuttamāmyogarddhi yogaiśvaryamrājannetallokajātaṃ paśyataḥ kāla atyagāttataḥ svarlokapradarśanānantaramgacchāvo bāhyalokaṃ taṃ yatrāste janako mamabahirloke dvādaśārbudavarṣamito'pyatra loke ekadinātmakaḥpūrvavat tadgaṇḍaśailānnirgatyābhyāyayau bahiḥbhūbhṛtā rājñāvidhāya mūrcchitaṃ liṅgadehaṃ saṃskāramātrakamsthūlendriyādyabhāvāt suṣuptāviva saṃskāramātrakamutthāpyāmāsa tu taṃ jīrṇadehasusaṅgatamśailād vinirgatya | taccharīrake prāk tṛṇakoṭaranyaste | taṃ rājānambhuvaṃ janāṃstarūn srotohradādīṃścāpi nūtanānnūtanān pariṇāmāntaraṃ gatān

sanskrit: katamo vai mahābhāga ! loko'yaṃ me pradarśitaḥityāpṛṣṭo munisuto mahāsenamuvāca hasa eva cirakālena pariṇāmāntaraṃ gataḥtāvataivātra kālena dvādaśārbudavatsarāḥkutaḥ pariṇāmāntaraṃ gata iti cedāha - śailetibhinnāṃ vyavahṛtiṃ paśya bhāṣāṃ cāpi samantataḥataḥ bahukālātyayātevaṃ mayā tu bahudhā dṛṣṭā bhinnā jagatsthitiḥso'yaṃ deśo yatra pūrvaṃ tvayā me saṃstutaḥ pitātvadbhrāturvaśapuruṣā atikrāntāḥ sahasraśaḥtatrābhūt samprati vanaṃ vyāptaṃ śvāpadamaṇḍalaiḥtatra tatpradeśemālaveśo viśālākhye kṣiprātīre pure'sti hivardhane nāma nagare tāmraparṇīsarittaṭealpakālenaivametadbhavad nūtanaṃ jagatparivartate pariṇāmāntaraṃ prāpnotianyathābhāvamāyānti evameva jagadgatiḥito'pi dvādaśārbudasaṃkhyātakālādapi | nagāḥ parvatāḥmarudeśāstvanūpāḥ syuḥ parvatā vālukāmayāḥetadevāha - giraya iti | girayo'tyuccaparvatāḥ | anūpāḥ udakapracurāḥkomalā bhūrapi bhavet pāṣāṇasadṛśī kvaciturvarā sasyavatīkadācinnarabāhulyaṃ kadācit paśusañcayamevametajjagat kālabhedāt pariṇataṃ pṛthakpariṇataṃ bhavatīti śe'ḥ

sanskrit: ityākarṇya munisutavākyaṃ sa ca mahīpatiḥtasmāt pariṇāmāntaraprāpteḥ | īdṛśaḥ apūrvavatmuniputrasamāśvastaḥ prajñāmāsādya bhūpatiḥbhrātaraṃ bhrātṛputrāṃśca dārān svātmana eva casvātmano'pi putrādīniti sambandhaḥatha taṃ mohato bhrātṛmukhān śocantamañjasātaṃ rājānambubodhayiṣayā bodhayitumicchayāavimṛśya phalaṃ yastu karma kuryāt sa bāliśaḥsyādeveti cedāha - avimṛśyetitat tasmātkutastvaṃ pṛcchasi punaḥ sarvanāśe hypasthiterājan brūhi kimetatte kuladharmaḥ sanātanaḥetat svajane naṣṭe śocitavyamiti | sanātanaḥ paramparāgataḥathavā śocite naṣṭaṃ prāpyate bhūya eva tatnaṣṭeṣu bandhuṣu yadi śocitavyaṃ tadā śṛṇutat sarvadā śocitavyaṃ kutaḥ pūrvaṃ [k: sarvaṃ] na śocitambhavediti tātparyammātāpitroḥ svasya vāpi purīṣakṛmayo hi yebhrātrādibandhutvaṃ mameti cedāha - mātetina te syurbandhavaḥ kasmāt kuto vā te na śocitāḥdehastvaṃ dehabhinno vā dehaḥ saṃghātarūpakaḥdeha evāhamiti cedāha - dehaḥ saṃghātarūpaka itipratikṣaṇaṃ tvekadeśanāśo dehasya bhāvitaḥ- pratikṣaṇamiti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvātmanā tu saṃghātanāśo nahi vibhāvyateantato dehagaganamavināśyasti kevalamyathā madvastramityevaṃ sa dehastvaṃ kathaṃ vadadehastvamityarthaḥyathā bhrātrādivāsobhirnāsti sambandhaleśakaḥyathā bhrātrādivāsobhistava sambandho nāstimaccharīraṃ madakṣāṇi matprāṇo manmanastvitimaccharīramiti | akṣāṇi indriyāṇievamukto mahāseno muhūrtaṃ suvicārya tuevaṃ kastvamityādina jāne bhagavan ko'hamiti sarvātmanāpyahamprāhetyanvayaḥ | sarvātmanā vicāraparo'pyahaṃ na jāneprapannastvāmahaṃ dīnaḥ kimidaṃ bhagavan vadasakāraṇamuta niṣkāraṇaṃ veti vadana svātmānaṃ vijānanti nānyaṃ śocanti caiva himṛte sati sarve śocantīti yat tatkuta iti śeṣaḥiti pṛṣṭo munisuto mahāsenamathābravītetat mṛtabandhuśocanādinimittam | tava śiṣyāya me | atha praśnānantaramsvātmānamaviditvaiva vyarthaṃ śocanti sarvadājñeyamjanāḥ śocanti vijñāya bhūyaḥ śocanti na kvacitvijñānānantaraṃ pūrvavanna śocantīti bhāvaḥaindrajālikamantrotthamāyayā mohito naraḥtannirmitasarpāderbhītyā śocatītyanvayaḥtathaiva māyayā mugdhaḥ svamajñātvā praśocati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mugdho mūḍhaḥ | svamātmānamna śocati kvaciccānyān śucāyuktān hasatyapihasatyapi | aindrajālikasyagamo mantraḥ sa mohako mameti jñāto yenaśocatastvādṛśān māyāmūḍhān pravihasanti cadārṣṭāntike yojayati - evamitijahi śokaṃ mahābāho mohotthaṃ sadvimarśanātbhagavan yastvayā prokto dṛṣṭānto viṣamaḥ sa hidṛṣṭāntaḥ svapnendrajālādirūpaḥayaṃ jāgratprapañcastu satyaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥityarthaḥityuktaḥ punarācakhyau muniputro'tibuddhimānsvāpnādiprapañco'satya iti bhāvaḥeṣa moho dvitīyaste svapne svāpnasya yādṛśaḥsvāpnapuruṣasya rajjau sarpabhramasadṛśa ityarthaḥpānthānāṃ kiṃ na harati tāpraṃ chāyāpradānataḥsthiraścetyarthaḥjāgratprapañco'pi sarvaḥ suṣuptau kiṃ na bādhitaḥsvāpnasyāpi paradine nānuvṛttiḥ kva vā vadasvāpnasyāpyetattulyamityāha - svāpnasyetijāgratyapi kvānuvṛttibhāso navyāvabhāsakebhāvaḥtathā svapne'pi bhātyevānuvṛttiḥ sthirabhāsanebhāvaḥsūkṣmabuddhyā vimṛśa tadvastu jāgrati saṃsthitambhāvaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kathaṃ tadanuvṛttirvai bhavedavitathātmikābhavedityarthaḥrūpamasti sarvadaiva nirjharairbheditātmanāmnācalānāmastītyarthaḥsarvatastu vibhidyante parvatāḥ sarvadaiva hivanagajādibhiḥ [k: dayaḥ]atha te sampravakṣyāmi paśya sūkṣmadhiyā nṛpasvāpna] vaktumāha - atheti | paśya vicārayaaparicchinnā'nuvṛttiḥ kāryeṣvatyantadurlabhāsiddhajāgradbhāvasyāparicchinnānuvṛttirdurlabhaivetyarthaḥiti cet [k: tat] kāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ pṛthivyādimayaṃ kilakāraṇe sūkṣmarūpeṇāvasthānāditi bhāvaḥatha svāpnasya bādho hi jāgrati hyanubhūyatesvāpnabhāvānāṃ bādho jāgrati sarvairanubhūyata ityarthaḥiti cecchṛṇu vakṣyāmi bādho hyanavabhāsanambādha ityucyata iti jñeyamatha bādho hyapramāṇadarśanaṃ cettadā śṛṇubhādaḥ | nahyevaṃvidhabādho jāgratyastīti bhāvaḥjñātavijñeyatatvānāmapramāṇadṛśiḥ sphuṭācetarat iti nītyā jñātavijñeyatattvānāṃ jāgrati sphuṭā'pramāṇadṛśiḥdīrghakālo'pi ca svapne bhāsate nirviśeṣataḥnirviśeṣata iti | jāgratkālavadaviśeṣād [k: dasata] bhāsata ityarthaḥsvāpnabhāvastena tulyo jāgrabhāvo'pi sarvaśaḥsattvāt svāpnajāgradbhāvayoḥ sarvāṃśena tulyatvamiti bhāvaḥsvapne'pi jāgaratvaṃ tu gṛhītaṃ tadvadeva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūkṣmavimarśibhirjñeyamtatsvāpnānnijabandhūṃstvaṃ nahi śocasi vai kutaḥśūnyatābhāvanenāpi śūnyaṃ niṣpratighaṃ bhavetniṣpratighamākāśavadapratirodhakaṃ cabhavettadātmabhāvena satyametad mahīpateimaṃ śailaṃ parikramya caihi [k: yau hi] paśyāva sampratibhavedata imaṃ śailaṃ parikramya paśyāvetyāha - imamitiparikramya gaṇḍaśailaṃ rājñā saha sametya tuśailaṃ paricakrame | rājñā saha parikramya tataḥ sametya svasthānamāgatyarājan dṛṣṭa eṣa śailaḥ pādagavyutimātrakaḥmedhāvī śiṣyabodhane'tikuśalaḥ | gavyūtiḥ krośayugameṣa jāgraduta svapnaḥ satyo mithyātmako'pi vāmithyātmaka eva vā vvecayeti śeṣaḥvatsarāstvanubhūtāste satyāsatye vivecayaasmādetadviddhi jagad bhāvanāmātrasārakamsvapnavad bhāvanāmātrasvarūpam na tato'dhikaṃ kiñcidityarthaḥtasmācchokaṃ jahi nṛpāvetya [k: vekṣya] svāpnasamaṃ jagatbhāvanāmātrasāratvājjagataḥdarpaṇapratimaṃ matvā saṃsthito'si yathā tathābhayorya] vā yathā na śocasi na prahṛṣyasi caparamānanditasvānto bhava śīghraṃ mahīpatevāsanāriktasvāntābhivyaktātmānando [k: nātiri] bhaveti bhāvaḥjagatsthitiṃ svāpnasamāṃ jñātvā śokaṃ jahau drutamjagad bhāvanāmātrasāramityākarṇya śubhayā sattarkayutayā dhiyāmuniputra mahābuddhe tvaṃ parāvaradarśanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svapna] | parāvaradarśanaḥ sendriyātīndriyajñaḥpṛcchāmi yadahaṃ tanme kṛpayā vaktumarhasiata evāha - na [k: tata] ta iti | leśato'pyaviditamiti yojanābhavet tat kathamiti yojanāathāpi deśaḥ kālaśca yugapad vividhaḥ kathamvividhaḥ kathamityarthaḥiti pṛṣṭo munisutaḥ pravaktumupacakramesatyavāsanāviṣṭo bhūyaḥ pṛcchati - anyatarat satyaṃ bhaveditivyākyātaṣṭīkāyām]bhavediti bhāvaḥetat sarvaiḥ satyarūpaṃ bhāvitaṃ sudṛḍhatvataḥsatyarūpaṃ bhāvitam ataḥ sarvasādhāraṇaṃ satyatvena bhāsata iti śeṣaḥvikalpasambheda eṣo'siddhā tasmādvibhāvanājanmanā maṇinā tadvadauṣadhena ca yogataḥjanmanā brahmaṇaḥ sā vai maṇinā yakṣarakṣasāmtapasā tāpasānāṃ sā māntrikāṇāṃ tu mantrataḥauṣadhena amṛtenasaṅkalpitaṃ tathā bhāvyaṃ pūrvavismaraṇe satibhāvaḥevameva nirvikalpabhāvanā yadi suthirāsusthirā tadā mahāphalaṃ sādhayediti vyavahitena sambandhaḥtāvat sā bhāvanā siddhā sādhayedvai mahāphalambhāvanāṃ sādhaya kṣipraṃ yadi sraṣṭuṃ samīhasitava tu vikalpasambhedād bhāvanā na siddhetyāha - sambhedāditiavyutpanno'si lokasya vyavahāre [k: hāraihyata] tatastava
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tavaitaccitraṃ bhāsata iti sambandhaḥjagadbhāvasvabhāvo'yaṃ vividhatvena bhāsanambhāvasya viruddhatvena bhāsanaṃ svabhāva evadivāndhānāmandhakāra itareṣāṃ tu bhāsakaḥbhāvānudāharati - eka eveti | dvaividhyamevāha - divāndhānāmitimatsyādīnāṃ bahiḥ śvāsapratirodho jale nahisvasminnimagnamanuṣyapaśvādeḥ | bahiḥ nirjale deśevahnirnaśyati toyena sa jale jvalati kvacittittirirbhakṣayati taṃ na dahati | kvacit vaḍavānalakuṇḍādauevaṃ sendriyavṛttāntāstvanye ke'pi nirindriyāḥnirindriyāḥ parokṣāḥ bhāvānāṃ viruddhasvabhāvāḥatropapattiṃ vakṣyāmi samāhitamanāḥ śṛṇucedupapattipūrvakaṃ vaktumupakramate - atretina cākṣuṣādaṃśato'nyad dṛśyamasti kvacid bahiḥbhāvānāṃ bahirasattvānnāsti virodha iti vadati - eta itiyathā taimiriko'nyastu paśyatyekaṃ dvidhā sthitamatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - yatheti | taimirikaḥ timiradoṣopahatanetraḥasti pūrvasamudrasya madhye kāraṇḍakāhvayaḥevaṃ ramaṇakadvīpe sadā paśyanti vai janāḥsarvabhāvān raktān paśyantievamanyeṣu dvīpeṣu vividhaṃ [k: vividhā] bhāvamaṇḍalamvyatyastam adhomastakamūrdhvapādamityāditatra tesāmanyathā tu dṛśyate yadi kutracitpaśyantītyarthaḥatastu cakṣuṣā yāvad dṛśyate jagatītale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ ghrāṇādīndriyāṇāmaṃśā gandhādayo'pi hievamiti | yenendriyeṇa yat prakāśate tasya tadindriyāṃśatvamiti bhāvaḥnaikasya viruddhobhayarūpatādoṣa iti bhāvaḥtadādyaṃ sarvajagatāṃ jagaccitrasya bhittivatkāraṇatvaccādyamityarthaḥśarīraṃ syādapādānaṃ netarad bhavituṃ kṣamamsambhāvayati - śarīramitiparvatād bahirityukte parvato na bahirbhavetdṛṣṭāntaḥ - parvatāditi | parvato na bahiṣṭho bhavedityarthaḥbhāsakād bahirityevaṃ vaktuṃ vāpi na sambhavetityevaṃ vā vaktumiti yojanāatastu bhāsakasyāntarbhāsyamastīti yujyatebahiṣṭhānāṃ bhāsaka ātmā nāpādānamityāha - dīpetyādina sarvathā yattu bhāsyaṃ taddhi yujyatesvasyaiva bhāsakatvaṃ ca bhāsyatvaṃ nahi yujyatenahi yujyata iti | kartṛkarmatvavirodhāditi śeṣaḥtacca bhārūpameveha pūrṇamekarasātmakampūrṇamekarasātmakaṃ ca | ekarasaḥ vastvantarāsambhinna ātmā yasyaabhārūpasya cābhānād bhārūpaikarasaṃ hi tatdarpaṇaikarasātmakapratibimbavat bhārūpaikarasamiti siddhamatastannāpādānaṃ syāt śṛṅgasyeva hi parvataḥnāpādānaṃ tathetibhāti svatantrataḥ svasmin sarvatrāpi ca sarvadāsvatantrato'nyānapekṣaṃ sadevaṃvidhaṃ [k: sadaivaṃ] bhātiparameśvarītyucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etadrūpādṛte kiñcid yadi brūyustadalpakam| tasmāt tripurādināmnāpyetadeva mukhyamiti vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥtasya bhāsyakṛtaṃ bhāsakatvaṃ ca na svataḥ sthitamsphaṭikasthajapākusumalauhityavat tadapi pratibimbātmakameveti bhāvaḥdarpaṇe nagaraṃ yadvad darpaṇānnātiricyateprapañcasya cidavyatiriktatvamityāha - darpaṇa itidarpaṇātmani sampūrṇe nibiḍe caikarūpiṇitvanaivaṃvidhatvāddarpa'nadibhinnasya tatra bhānaṃ nopapadyata iti bhāvaḥtathā pūrṇe [k: pūrṇe'stu] sunibiḍe caikarūpe cidātmaniapyanugṛhītā bhaveranni(yuri)ti dhyeyamākāśastvavakāśātmā śūnyarūpatvahetutaḥiti tātparyamsatī citiraśūnyātmarūpiṇyekarasā kathamsadrūpatvādevāśūnyātmarūpatvam | ekarasatvaṃ nibiḍasvarūpatātasmādādarśavat saṃvit svātantryabharavaibhavātsvātantryabharavaibhavādātmanyadvitīye'vabhāsayediti sambandhaḥnimittopādānahīnaṃ dvitīyamaticitritamaticitritaṃ parasparavilakṣaṇaṃ bhāsayetekatvaṃ bhāsate spaṣṭamaviśeṣādadūṣitamdarpaṇasāmānyarūpāt | adūṣitamabādhitamanusandhānasaṃsiddhamekaṃ doṣavivarjjitamsvarūpamanekavaicitryavapurapi caitanyamātrakammṛtpiṇḍasāmmukhye'pi darpaṇe ghaṭapratibimbāpatteḥpratibimbasya bhāve vāpyabhāve veva [kh: caiva] darpaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadabhāsanakāle ca sā parā citirnirvikalpaiva | citimātrarūpaiveti bhāvaḥsvāntarvibhāsayed bāhyamādarśe gaganaṃ yathāpūrṇasyāṃśenaiva bhānaṃ bāhyābhāsanamucyatesvavyatiriktadeśābhāsanāvinābhūtamiti spaṣṭamevaeṣaivāvyaktamityuktā jaḍaśaktiśca kathyateprāhuḥśivatattvamiti proktā śaktistadbhāsanaṃ bhavetjñeyamahambhāvācchādanena sadāśivamayaṃ smṛtamanayoḥ saṃvedanaṃ tu bhedābhedavimarśanamśuddhavidyātattvaṃ jñeyambhedaśakteraprarūḍhyā cābhedātmāvabhāsanātprakṛtyādipṛthivyantacaturviṃśatitattvasyeti bhāvaḥjaḍaśaktirdharmibhāvaṃ citirdharmātmatāṃ yayaumāyā vibhedabuddhistu bhedapracurabhāvanātbhāvanādvibhedabuddhisāmānyarūpiṇī māyā māyākhyaṃ tattvampañcakañcukasaṃvyāptā puruṣatvaṃ prapadyatepuruṣadharmatvena puruṣasya prādhānyādādau nirūpaṇaṃ jñeyamkalā kiñcitkartṛtā syādvidyā kiñcijjñatā bhavetkiñcitkartṛtvaṃ kalā | kiñcijjñatvaṃ vidyāniyatiḥ paratantratvametairyuktastu pūruṣaḥpratipuruṣaṃ bhinnaṃ tatsāmānyaṃ kalāditattvamiti bhāvaḥjanānāṃ vāsanāpiṇḍaḥ sthitaḥ prakṛtirucyateasyā avasthābhedo hi cittamityabhidhīyate- phalaṃ tviti | asyāḥ prakṛteḥ

sanskrit: vāsanāpiṇḍasahitā citiścittamudīritamcittamityucyata ityāha - vāsanetipuruṣāṇāṃ vibhedena cittaṃ bahuvidhaṃ bhavetcittaṃ bhinnam ato bahuvidhamityarthaḥprakṛtitvaṃ samāyāti tadante cittatāmiyātcittamiti bhāvaḥavyaktaprādhānyatastu cittaprakṛtitāmiyātviśiṣṭagranthatātparyamahaṅkārabuddhimanorūpeṇa nṛpasattamatrividhamityarthaḥśabdādigaganādīni bhūtāni sthūlasūkṣmataḥkrīḍāṃ karoti sṛṣtyādikrameṇa sarvasākṣiṇīsṛṣṭyādigataguṇadoṣairalepaḥ saṃvidātmano jñeyaḥhiraṇyagarbho yo brahmā tasyaitad bhāvanotthitambhāvanayaitajjagadutthitamiti sambandhaḥsā paraiva hi cicchaktistadbhedo na tu vidyatemahākāśabhedaḥ evamatrāpi bhedo na vidyatetadbhāvanopasaṃhāre nāsti bhedasya bhāsanam[atraiva ghamātṛkā'vasitā]tadāvaraṇahāne tu tava sā siddhimeṣyatisā bhāvanā siddhiṃ sarvasādhāraṇasṛṣṭisāmarthyam eṣyatitathā tattatra bhāseta dīrghasūkṣmatvabhedataḥbhāvitapradeśādau | bhāvanānurodhena dīrghasūkṣmatvabhedato bhāsetabrahmaṇā tāvadevātra dvādaśā'rbudarūpataḥbrahmasṛṣṭaloke | rūpato bhāvitamityanvayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ghamātṛkā'vasitā]deśe'pītyāha - brahmaṇetievaṃ ca dvayamapyatra satyaṃ cāsatyameva caanavabhāsanarūpabādhasattvāt paramārthato'satyamapivibhāvya bhūyastatraiva bhāvayānantayojanamsambandhaḥtasmād bhāvanamātrātmarūpametajjagad bahiḥsambandhaḥtasmād bāhyātmakāvyaktabhittau citramayaṃ jagattathā'vyaktabhitticitrakalpaṃ jagadvyaktabhittimātramiti sambandhaḥata eva cirād gamyo dūradeśo'pi yoginaḥcidātmavyatirekeṇa jagato'satyatvādeva | yoginaḥ paśyantītyanvayaḥtasmād dūraṃ samīpaṃ vā ciraṃ śīghramathāpi vāniścityaivaṃ tyaja bhrāntiṃ śuddhacidbhāvanakramātiti śrutvā munisutavacanaṃ munisattamaḥtataḥ satyatvābhimānanivṛttyanantaramsamādhyabhyāsayogena saṃsādhya nijabhāvanāmāśayo yasyadehābhāsamathonmūlya mahāgaganasaṃśrayaḥnirvikalpaparasaṃvitevaṃ jagat satyabhāvabhāvanāmātrahetutaḥvicāreṇa śamaṃ yāyād bhrāntiste cittasaṃśrayāmananarūpavicāreṇa bhrāntiḥ śamaṃ yāyātbhūyo'tyantaṃ vismito'bhūd rāmo bhṛgukulodvahaḥpunarāgatya saṃśayaṃ papracchetyāha - vimṛśyeti
