sanskrit: dattātreyaṃ punargatvā natvā papraccha sādaramtatra sāramiyajjñātaṃ mayā'tyantaṃ vicārataḥbhagavanniti | tvayā yatproktaṃ tatra mayā vicārata iyajjñātamiti yojanāādarśanagaraprakhyaṃ mṛṣaiva pravibhāvitamata eva mṛṣaiva pravibhāvitaṃ mithyābhūtamasadeva jñātamsvātmabhittau jagaccitramavyaktādiprabheditambrahmādīnāmapīśvarī niyantrī | avyaktaṃ bahiḥpadārthaḥetāvattu mayā jñātaṃ vicārya sūkṣmayā dhiyāsvātantryamātrāt svātantryaikanimittāt | nirupādānahetukaṃ jagatupalabdhumaśakyaiva savedyāyāḥ sadā sthiteḥupalambhaṃ vinā tasyāḥ puruṣārtho na vidyatena saṃbhavediti bhāvaḥvijñāne sati mokṣaḥ syānmukte vyavahṛtiḥ kathampraśnāntaramkathaṃ teṣāṃ hi saṃvedyamuktaṃ saṃvedanaṃ sthitamnirvikalpasaṃvedanaṃ kathaṃ sthitaṃ bhavetvijñānamekarūpaṃ vai mokṣo'pyekaḥ phalaṃ bhavet- vijñānamitikecit karma prakurvanti kāle sacchāstracoditambhinnāṃ sthitimevāha - kecidityādi | kāle tattatkālekecit samādhiparamāḥ saṃhṛtendriyamaṇḍalāḥbhinnavartmabhiḥ vaidikādimārgaiḥkecicchiṣyān bodhayanti pṛthakpravacanaiḥ sphuṭampravacanairupadeśavākyaiḥkecit pravādaṃ kurvanti sadassu prativādibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anye kevalamugdhatvamāvahanti sadaiva himugdhatvaṃ mūḍhatvamta ime jñānina iti prathitā bhūriśocanaiḥvigarhyāṃ nindyām | prathitāḥ vikhyātāḥkimete samavijñānāstāratamyamutāśritāḥśiṣye'nanyaśaraṇye te nisargasadayaṃ manaḥsarvaṃ praśnajātam | yato nisargasadayaṃ manaḥ ato'rhasīti sambandhaḥmatvā yogyaṃ praśnajātaṃ pravaktumupacakramesavimarśaparo yastvamato jñātuṃ prabhāvitaḥ[k, kh: sattarkaparaḥ nāsti] | prabhāvitaḥ samarthaḥbhagavacchaktipātena vinā kaḥ śreya āpnuyātyat sadvimarśanaṃ nityaṃ vardhayet suprasāditāprasanneśvarasya sutarkotpādanameva kṛtyamityāha - kṛtyamitikintu tat tādṛśamapi tvayoktaṃ apracidvapuḥparacidvapurna suviditamiti sambandhaḥtāṭasthyena tu yo yāvadveda tāvanna veda vaina vedeti | vedanamukhyaphalābhāvānna vedetyarthaḥtaṭasthasaṃvedanaṃ tu svapnasaṃvedanopamamparokṣajñānaṃ] jñānaṃ bhramarūpamevetyāha - svapnetitathā taṭasthavijñānamamukhyaphaladaṃ bhavetna bhavatyevamatrāpītyarthaḥpurā videheṣu kaścidāsīd rājā sudhārmikaḥatra taṭasthavijñānasyāmukhyaphalatvesa kadācit svātmadevīmīje kratubhiruttamaiḥkalābhijñā vaidikāśca yajvānaścāpi satriṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tenopahūtā viprādyā na yayustatra bhūriśaḥtatra varuṇayāge | bhūriśaḥ bahavaḥathājagāma varuṇadāyādo bauddhasampadātarkakuśala iti tātparyamāsādya yajñasadanaṃ nṛpaṃ saṃyojya cāśiṣānetumājagāma | kūṭavartmanā kapaṭamārgeṇarājaṃste yajñasadanamatyantaṃ naiva śobhatesabhā vidvatsamudayaiḥ śobhinī śobhatetarāmśobhinīti | svataḥ śobhamānā nitarāṃ śobhatetadatra vidyāviśadaṃ na paśyāmyekamapyalamsambandhaḥkathaṃ sabhāmimāṃ mūrkhapracurāṃ saṃviśāmyahamkimare dvijabandho tvamadhikṣipasi sarvataḥkruddhānāṃ vacanam - kimare iti | sarvataḥ sarvānvṛthā katthasi durbuddhe jitvā'smāṃstvaṃ gamiṣyasijitā bhavāma iti śeṣaḥkiṃ tvaṃ bhūlokamevādya jetumicchasi durmatebhūlokasaṃsthānāḥ bhūlokasthāḥ | atra saṅgatāḥ militā vartanta iti śeṣaḥityuktavatsu sabhyeṣu vāruṇiḥ punarāha tānahaṃ jito bhavadbhistu samudre syāṃ nikajjitaḥsamayena pratijñayā | samayamevāha - ahamitiupetyaivaṃ tu samayaṃ vivadantu mayā sahaupetya aṅgīkṛtyavivādaṃ cakruratyantaṃ tena vāruṇinā dvijāḥsammatiṃ pratijñāṅgīkāram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sindhau jimajjitā viprāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥnimajjitāḥvāruṇaṃ yajñamāsādya mumuduḥ pūjitā bhṛśamvaruṇena pūjitāḥaṣṭāvakraḥ samāgatya jñānavaitaṇḍyajalpakaḥsvapitaraṃ majjitamaṣṭāvakraḥ śrutvā | vaitaṇḍyaṃ vitaṇḍāatha prakāśamāpanno vāruṇirdvijamukhyakānvipraveṣaṃ parityaktavāniti yāvatathāgateṣu vipreṣu kaholatanayo bhṛśamaṣṭāvakreṇa vimatā viprāḥ khedamupāgatāḥvimatāḥ avamānitāḥ [k: apa]tān samāśvāsya viprān sā kāṣāyāmbaravāsinīaṣṭāvakradarpabhañjanāya śaraṇaṃ yayuḥsabhāmupetya provāca nṛpeṇābhisupūjitānityataruṇī yogena jarāvarjitātvayā vimocitā viprā vāde nirjitya vāruṇimyatpadaṃ viditaṃ sarvāmṛtatvapratipādakamsarvāmṛtatvamaparicchinnāmṛtatvamavijñātaṃ na kiñcit syādāśāsyaṃ vā na kiñcanaāśāsyaṃ vāñchitamtāpasyaivaṃ samāpṛṣṭaḥ kaholatanayo'bravītevaṃvidham avedyaṃ tatpadaṃ viditaṃ cedvada | māmupa matsamīpena me hyaviditaṃ loke hyasti kiñcit kiyattvidamatyalpamiti yāvatyat tvaṃ pṛcchasi tadvakṣye śṛṇu tāpasi tattvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃluṭhitāni saṃloḍitāni samyag vimṛṣṭānīti yāvatdeśakālānavacchinnaṃ śuddhākhaṇḍacidātmakamvijātīyasajātīyavastvantarāsambheda uktaḥādarśanagaraprakhyaṃ tadetatparamaṃ padamnīlarūpāderivetyāha - ādarśetiādarśe vidite yadvanna sandehaḥ kvacidbhavetpratibimbānāmādarśamātrātmatvātnāśāsyaṃ vā bhavet kiñcidevaṃ pravidite pareāśāsyaṃ vā na bhavediti bhāvaḥevaṃ tāpasi tat tattvaṃ śāstradṛṣṭyā vibhāvitamjñātammunidāraka sūktaṃ te yathāvat sarvasammatamte tvayā yathāvaduktaṃ tatsūktaṃ sarvasammataṃ caprāpnoti tadviditvaiva cāmṛtaṃ padamavyayamtatraitāvānaṃśo viruddha ityāha - yaduktamitiavedyaṃ cenna jānāmi nāstīti ca nirūpayabhāvaḥ [k, kh: tatvetaratatsattva]athaitattu tvayā vipra śāstradṛṣtyā vibhāvitamvākyajñānena vibhāvitaṃ viniścitamdṛṣṭvā pratyakṣataḥ sarvaṃ pratibimbaṃ yathāsthitambhāvaḥevaṃ vadan sabhāmadhye janakasyāsya vai puraḥvidvatsabhāmadhye tatrāpi janakasya vidvacchiromaṇeḥ puro'grataḥevamuktastayā tatra naiva provāca kiñcanasusandarbhatābhimānastu sutarāṃ mauḍhyapradyotaka iti bhāvaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: avāṅmukhaḥ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā vicāryāntastayeritamvimanā iva vyagracitta iva | antaḥ manasitāpasyahaṃ na jānāmi tvatpraśnasyottaraṃ vacaḥtasyāstāpasyāḥ praśnottaram | tāṃ tāpasīmnāhaṃ vadāmyanṛtakaṃ tapoharamanarthakamsaṅgatametadvada | aviditamapi jānāmītyanṛtakamaṣṭāvakraṃ pratyuvāca śṛṇvatāṃ ca sabhāsadāmtasya aṣṭāvakrasyaśuṣkatarkairavijñeyaṃ sarvatraiva sugopitametat proktavirodhasamādhānam | etadavijñeyam | sarvatra śāstreṣurājā'yaṃ vettyahaṃ vāpi vedmi nānyastu kaścanana vijānāti kaścanetyetadeva bhūyaḥ spaṣṭārthamāha - nānyastvitiprāyo vidurhi vidvāṃsastarkamātrasamāśrayāḥvinā sadgurusevāyā devatānugrahādvinānedaṃ śrutvāpi vijñeyaṃ tāṭasthyaprāṇayā dhiyābahirmukhyeti tātparyamtāvat sahasraśaḥ proktaṃ śrutaṃ cāpi nirarthakam| guruṇā proktaṃ svena śrutaṃ caavijñāya hṛtaṃ caurairmanyate mūḍhabhāvataḥsvātmānamanudāhṛtya yāvat kaṇṭhaṃ na paśyatitatrendriyavyāpāramakṛtvetyetatevaṃ munisutātmānaṃ svasvabhāvaṃ niśamya casvasvabhāvaṃ svasvarūpaṃ niśamya śrutvāyāvat tāvad bahiḥ kutra kathaṃ tadviditaṃ bhavettat ātmarūpam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svayaṃ prakāśyatāṃ naiti kvaciddīpasya kasyacitprakāśyatāṃ naitisthitāḥsvaprakāśe'nyānapekṣāḥ svataḥ prakāśantena santi na prakāśanta iti vaktuṃ hi yujyatekim | na yujyata ityarthaḥatyantamaprakāśyaṃ yaccittattvaṃ tatkuto vadasambandhaḥtasmāt tvamantarmukhayā dṛṣṭyā samyag vicarayasamyagvicārayasarvāvabhāsinī kutra kadā vā na prakāśateprakāśate ? sarvatra sarvadā sarvarūpeṇa ca prakāśata evetyarthaḥaprakāśenāpi saiva citiśaktiḥ prakāśatesiddhyediti bhāvaḥbhāti cet sā kathaṃ bhāti vimṛśaitat susūkṣmataḥsūkṣmadṛśā tvameva vimṛśetyāha - bhāsata itianantardṛṣṭayastena mohitāḥ saṃsaranti caanantardṛṣṭitvena hetunātāvadantardṛṣṭitāpi na syādeva kathañcanabhāvaḥantardṛṣṭirnirīhā syāt sehāyāḥ sā kathaṃ bhavetnirgatā īhā saṅkalpo yasyā dṛṣṭermanasaḥ sā antardṛṣṭiḥnirvimarśaḥ sthitaḥ | tataḥ paramasaṃvedyaṃ suvedyaṃ ca tadevaṃ tattvamucyateiti samastaṃ tvaṃ svata eva vetsi jñāsyasītyarthaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etatte'bhihitaṃ sarvaṃ muniputra namo'stu teamṛtāṃ sthitiṃ mokṣadaśām | upasaṃharati - etaditibodhayiṣyati tvāmeṣa rājā buddhimatāṃ varaḥsakṛcchruteḥ saṃkṣepeṇaikavāraṃ śravaṇātityuktvā pūjitā rājñā praṇatā ca sabhāsadaiḥatra yaḥ saṃśayaste syāt taṃ pṛccha | sabhāsadaiḥ sabhāsadbhiḥetat te'bhihitaṃ rāma vedanaprakriyātmanaḥvedanaprakāra ukta ityupasaṃhṛtaṃ guruṇeti jñeyambhūyaḥ papracchātrisūnumavitṛptaḥ kathāśruteḥkathāśruteḥ kathāśravaṇātbhūyaḥ papraccha rājānamaṣṭāvakro mahāmuniḥyat papracchetyanvayaḥaho'dbhutaṃ samākhyānaṃ na kvacicca mayā śrutamityevānuyukto'tha dattātreyo mahāmuniḥjanakāṣṭāvakrasaṃvādarūpamākhyānam | anuyuktaḥ pṛṣṭaḥśṛṇu bhārgava yat proktaṃ janakena mahātmanāsaṃvṛto bahubhirvipraiḥ sametya nṛpapuṅgavamnṛpapuṅgavaṃ janakamtaducyamānaṃ tu mayā samyak śṛṇu samāhitaḥmahānarthaḥ mokṣākhyo yasmāt | evaṃvidhaṃ tāpasyoktamtadahaṃ nāvidaṃ samyak saṃkṣepoktatvahetutaḥevaṃ janaka āpṛṣṭaḥ prāha taṃ vismayannivanāvedyaṃ sarvathā taddhi vedyaṃ cāpi na sarvathātat śuddhacidātmatattvamgururāvedayet tattvamata ādau guruṃ śrayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gururāvedayedato guruṃ śrayecca | ato nātyantamavedyamyaḥ parāvṛttadṛṣṭiḥ syāttasya tat sulabhaṃ bhavetanirūpyaṃ kevalaṃ tadavedyamapi sarvathāparāgdṛṣṭirbahirdṛṣṭiḥ | idamiti sarvathā'nirūpyamavedyaṃ cayadyad dṛśyaṃ paśyasīha tena tadvedyamucyatetacca] tasya tadatiriktena vedanāprasiddheriti dhyeyambhānaśaktirbhāsyahīnā sarvabhānasamāśrayāsarvabhānasamāśrayeti bhāvaḥvedyameva na vittiḥ syāt svato yanna prakāśatebhāvaḥvedyaṃ vibhinnarūpaṃ vai vittyaiva vedyate khaluvittervibhinnarūpambhedo hi vedyadharmaḥ syānna vittiṃ saṃspṛśet kvacitevaṃ sa bhedo ghaṭādivedyadharma eva vitterna bhedasparśo'pipaśya vedyaṃ pṛthakkṛtya buddhyā'kāravivarjitāmākāravivarjitāṃ vittiṃ paśyadṛśyākāradhṛternānārūpatāṃ pratipadyatesvata iti bhāvaḥna tu svabhāvato vedyā sā vittirviśvasaṃśrayāviśvasaṃśrayā'paricchinnā śuddhavittistu neyamiti vedyeti bhāvaḥvimṛśāṣṭāvakra rūpaṃ nijamevaṃvidhaṃ sphuṭamtaddaśāvimarśanena vedyamiva bhavediti | evaṃvidhaṃ veditrātmakamśarīraṃ dhātunikaraṃ tatte rūpaṃ kathaṃ bhavetdhātunikarādyasthirātmakaśarīrādi te rūpaṃ kathaṃ bhavetevaṃ prāṇo mano'pi syādahaṃbuddhivyatikramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evamiti | tvadrūpādbhinnamityarthaḥ | tameva hetumāha - ahaṃbuddhītitasmāccitiḥ sarvavettrī tvamaṣṭāvakra tattvataḥyasmādahaṃbuddhiṃ citirna vyatītya tiṣṭhati tasmāt sarvavettrī citireva tvamādeśakāla eva svaṃ paśyantyuttamabuddhayaḥśravaṇakāle evetyarthaḥ | svam ātmānamyena paśyasi svapneṣu taccakṣurmukhyamucyatecakṣūrūpatvena ca mana eva mukhyaṃ cakṣuriti bhāvaḥapratyāvṛttacakṣurvai naiva paśyati kiñcanapaśyatītyarthaḥpratyāvṛttya dṛḍhaṃ tasminneva saṃyojayedyadiniścalatvena dṛḍhatayā manaḥ saṃyojayettadā tadbhāsata ityanvayaḥanyadā tu purovṛtti na spaṣṭaṃ bhāsate kvacitviśeṣarūpeṇa spaṣṭaṃ bhāsata ityāha - anyadetievaṃ śrotratvagādīnāṃ bhūdevāvehi saṃsthitimpratyāvṛttamanasa eva śrotrādyaiḥ śabdādigrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥnāpratyāvṛttamanasā kiñcid veditumarhatipratyāvṛttaṃ manaḥ śuddhaṃ nijarūpāvabhāsakambhāvaḥagocaraścedātmāsau manasā gocaro'pi cagocaraścamanogocaratā bāhye dviprakāreṇa saṃsthitā- mana iti | bāhye anātmanianyebhyastu parāvṛttimātre'pi manasaḥ satianyaparāvṛttimātramevāstu tatparatā māstviti cedāha - anyebhya ititasmāttatparatāpyatra vyāpāro mānasaḥ paraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathāpi tatparatvamātramityatra mātrapadārtha evānyaparāvṛttiriti jñeyāavyāvṛttā citiryasmāttasmānnātra tathā bhavetvyāpāradvayāpekṣaṃ bhāsanaṃ bhavetyathā puraḥsthitādarśe kiñciddarśanahetavepratibimbadarśanahetaveapekṣyate darpaṇasya pratibimbadidṛkṣuṇābimbadidṛkṣuṇā'pekṣyatetadā'nyebhyaḥ parāvṛttimātreṇa hi kṛtārthatāpratibimbagaganāvabhāsanasiddhiḥavyāvṛttaṃ kintu cānyairabhicchannaṃ na bhāsateanyaiḥ pratibimbairityarthaḥatastebhyaḥ parāvṛttimātreṇaiva vibhāsatesarvakāle samāpūrṇā manasi vyomavad dvijagaganavanmanasi pūrṇāpaśya vipra citiḥ kutra kadā nāstyavabhāsinīnāpūrvasya tatparatvasyāpekṣeti | citiḥ sarvagatetyetat sādhayati - paśyetitasmāccidātmāvabhāse manaso'nyaparāvṛtiḥbhāvaḥ | tasmāt sarvagatatvādanyaparāvṛttiḥ kevalā'pekṣiteti sambandhaḥābhimukhyābhāvahetorevā'vedyatvamiṣyateanyebhyastu parāvṛttireva śuddhirhi mānasīcedāha - anyebhya itiyāvannahi manaḥ śuddhaṃ tāvajjñānaṃ kathaṃ bhavetmukhyasādhanatvamāha - yāvaditiupakṣīṇaṃ sarvamatra sādhanaṃ tasya śodhaneupakṣīṇamiti | atra asmin | tasya manasaḥ śodhane

sanskrit: manasaḥ śodhane eva viniyuktaṃ na cānyathāsākṣājjñāne viniyogaḥiti rājñeritaṃ śrutvā tvaṣṭāvakraḥ punarjagauśuddhacidvapurātmā | rājñā janakenakevalā cet sā parā cid manasā pravibhāsatetataḥ [k: tatra] kiṃ sādhanairanyaiḥ suptimātrāt kṛtārthatāsādhanānāṃ vaiyarthyamityāha - kiṃ sādhanairitisamāhitaḥ śṛṇu brahman samādhānaṃ vadāmi teparyanuyuktaḥ ākṣiptaḥlīnaṃ manastvaṃ cāpyasya kathaṃ tāmavabhāsayetanyebhyastu parāvṛttimātreṇa bhāsate kvacitatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ - kajjalenetiayogyatvādeva mano bhāsayenna citiṃ kvacitayogyatvādititasmādyogyena manasā śuddhena bhāsate hi sāathāpi śṛṇu vakṣyāmi maṣīlipte hi darpaṇesaṃśleṣānna vilakṣyeta svabhāvasyānapohanātmaṣīpratibimbanamāvaśyakamiti bhāvaḥato'nyebhyaḥ parāvṛtterabhāvād bhāsayenna tāmsuṣuptāvanyaparāvṛtterabhāvānmano na tāṃ śuddhāṃ citiṃ bhāsayetmūḍhatāpi ca yā tasyāṃ daśāyāmanubhūyatesambhavediti jñeyammanasastu dvidhā'vasthā prakāśāmarśabhedataḥsuṣuptisamādhyorbhedam | prakāśāvasthā āmarśo vimarśāvasthā cetiyastadvicāraḥ svasmin vai sa vimarśa udāhṛtaḥ

sanskrit: vimarśaḥ śabdasambhedād vibhedāt savikalpakaḥśabdasambhedād vastūnāṃ vimarśaḥ savikalpako bhavetvastudarśanarūpo'sau prakāśo nivikalpakaḥpunaretasyaiva vivaraṇaṃ ślokadvayena kriyate - ayamitiśabdasambhinnarūpo'sau vicārātmāvabhāsanaḥvicārātmā avabhāsanaṃ yasya saḥ savikalpaka iti śeṣaḥtatra yo'bhinavābhāsaḥ sa prokto'nubhavātmakaḥso'nubhavātmakaḥevaṃ mano dviprakāraśaktiyuktaṃ sadā sthitamprakāśāmarśātmakanirvikalpasavikalpakābhāsaśaktidvayayuktaṃ bhavaticchedaḥ]amūḍhadaśocyate | suṣuptāvāmarśābhāvānmūḍhateti tātparyamata eva hi dīpādeḥ prakāśanibiḍatvataḥtātparyamnidrā prathamajā'vyaktaṃ mahāśūnyamihocyateevākārādyabhāvād mahāśunyam | iha suṣuptau nidretyucyatevastudarśanakāle'pi jāgratyevaṃvidhaṃ manaḥsuṣuptāvavyaktaśaktiprakāśanibiḍatvataḥviviñcantīti sambandhaḥvastudarśanakāle'pi caivaṃ līnaṃ mano bhavetvastudarśanātmakaghaṭādinirvikalpakāle tulya ityāha - vastvitiyatra muhyanti vidvāṃso'pyatisūkṣmavivecakāḥtrayametaccaikavidhaṃ prakāśanibiḍatvataḥprakāśanibiḍatvamitibhāvaḥtatra heturbhāsyabhedādityeva praviniścayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śabdasambhedātmakavikalpatvā bhāvena teṣāṃ svarūpabhedābhāvātdarśane bhinnabhāso hi bhāsyamevaṃ tridhā sthitamataḥ prakāśanibiḍa ityeva saṃpracakṣateprakāśanibiḍa iti pracakṣateanantaraṃ spaṣṭatayā sarvairapi vimṛśyatecirakālebhavatvata iti | akṣaṇikatvādityarthaḥevaṃ samādhiḥ suptiśca kṣaṇikā na vimṛśyatekṣaṇikasamādhisuṣuptī na vimṛśyete ityāha - evamitisuṣuptirlakṣyate sūkṣmadṛgbhiḥ paricayāt khalu(suṣuptiriti) | kṣaṇiketyarthaḥsarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ brahman vyavahāradaśāsvapijāgradādiṣvapītyarthaḥ | samādhayaḥ santītyanvayaḥjāgratyavimṛśiryā syāt sa samādhirudīritaḥyā avimṛśiḥ yā vimarśābhāvadaśā sa samādhiḥsuṣuptau darśane cāpi samādhitvamataḥ sthitamsamādhitvaṃ sthitambhedāmarśanasaṃskāragarbhitatvānna mukhyatācidātmamātraviṣayatvena bhedo jñeyaḥtathāpi te pravakṣyāmi muniputrādarācchṛṇuprāptam tathāpi sūkṣmaṃ viśeṣaṃ pravakṣyāmītyarthaḥnāstītyeva hi tadbhānamatyantābhāvarūpakamtathā ca dṛśyasāmānyābhāva eva tadā bhāsamānaḥ siddhyatīti tātparyamdarśane bhāsamānaṃ ca nāstyābhāsapadaṃ yataḥsuṣupterjaḍarūpateti bhāvaḥsamādhau bhāsamānā yā citiḥ sā brahmarūpiṇī

sanskrit: brahmarūpiṇītyarthaḥsarvathā'stimayo devī suṣuptiḥ sā kathaṃ bhavetbhavedityarthaḥbodhayāmāsa janaka ityaṣṭāvakramuktibhiḥiti bodhayāmāsetyanvayaḥevaṃ jāgrati kṣaṇikasamādhayaḥ santītitat kṣaṇikasamādhisthānamevaṃ tenānuyukto'tha prāha rājā mahāśayaḥāśayaścittaṃ yasya | aparicchinnacidākāramānasaḥ nityasamāhita iti yāvatpriyayā sampariṣvakto navyayā prathamaṃ yadāsaṃpariṣvaktaḥ samyagāliṅgitaḥtiṣṭhenna nidrayākrāntaḥ sa samādhirudīritaḥyastiṣṭhet so'yaṃ vyavahāradaśāyāṃ kṣaṇasamādhiḥakasmāttasya saṃprāptiryadā bhavati vai muneyatkiñcid vastu cirakālādvāñchitam | akasmāt asambhāvitaprāptikālatiṣṭhenna nidrayākrāntaḥ sa samādhirudīritaḥtadā na vedetyādi kṛtārthamakasmādyadi sampaśyed vyāghrādi mṛtyusammitammṛtyutulyamtiṣṭhenna nidrayākrāntaḥ sa samādhirudīritaḥarogiṇaṃ yadā'kasmāt saṃśṛṇoti mṛtaṃ kilagṛhakarmaṇi vibhuṃ samarthamtiṣthenna nidrayākrāntaḥ sa samādhirudīritaḥjāgratsvapnasuṣuptīnāṃ madhye santi samādhayaḥmano dīrghātmatāṃ yāti jalūkeva tṛṇāliṣu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhye tannirvikalpākhyaṃ mano lakṣaya sarvadāsaṅgacchatevyavahāre na kasyāpi jñānamekaṃ tu bhāsatetat sarvamekameva jñānam ākārabhedasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvātata eva varṇayanti tairthikāḥ sarva eva hiprabhṛtayaḥ sarve varṇayantitadantarakṣaṇaugheṣu nirvikalpadaśā sthitānirvikalpatā'kṣataivasamādhirasti cānyasya samādhiḥ śaśaśṛṅgavatanyaḥ ajñātasamādhisvarūpaḥrājannevaṃ vyavahṛtau samādhirnirvikalpakaḥsambandhaḥsuṣuptau darśane cāpi jaḍāvyaktavibhāsataḥca vibhāsanāt [k: bhāsanāt] puruṣārthāsādhanatvamiti sambandhaḥśuddhasaṃvidvibhātātmā tad bhūyaḥ saṃsṛtiḥ kathambhūya evaṃvidhasamādhiprāptyanantaraṃ kathaṃ saṃsṛtiḥnirvikalpasamādhyākhyaṃ yanniḥśreyasakāraṇamtadetadevetyanvayaḥityāpṛṣṭo mahīpālaḥ prāha taṃ munipuṅgavamsarvasaṃśayanāśanametat praśnottaramajñānāt saṃsṛtiriyaṃ pravṛttā'nādikālataḥvaktumupakramate - ajñānāditi | iyaṃ sarvānubhavasiddhāsvapnavat santatā sarvaiḥ sarvadā hyanubhūyatesvapnavadanubhūyamānatvena na satyeti bhāvaḥtajjñānaṃ saṃvikalpaṃ syādajñānasya prabhādanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00344 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kiñcidastītyavadheyamnirvikalpakavijñānaṃ kenacinna viruddhyatecedaviruddhatvādityāha - nirvikalpaketivicitracitrābhāsānāṃ bhittivat suvyavasthitamnirvikalpakaṃ jñānamāśrayamityarthaḥtatraiva hi vikalpānāmullekhāt savikalpakamsavikalpateti [k: lpaketi] bhāvaḥtadanekavidhaṃ kāryakāraṇātmatayā sthitamkāryātmakamityanekavidhamcidātmā pūrṇa eva syādavacchedavivarjanātvivecayitumādau pūrṇatāṃ nirūpayati - cidātmetitathāvidhātmanaḥ khyātirapūrṇatvena yā sthitāpūrṇatvākhyātirityuktā mūlājñānaṃ bhavediti sambandhaḥtasyaiva pallavaprāyaṃ dehātmatvādibhāsanamkh: nivṛtte] mūlājñānatvamityādi jñeyamparokṣamaparokṣaṃ ca parokṣaṃ guruśāstrataḥjātamiti śeṣaḥ | guruśāstrata ityanāśritagurorna jñānamiti sūcanāyayādṛśaṃ te bhavejjjñānaṃ śāstraśrutisamudbhavamśāstraśrutyā śāstraśravaṇena samudbhavo yasya | parokṣamiti yāvataparokṣaṃ hi vijñānaṃ samādhiparipākajambhūyo'narthasaṅgaritisamādhirjñānapūrvastu vijñānaṃ janayet khaluaparokṣajñānamyathā'viditamāṇikyaḥ paśyan kośagṛhe maṇimmāṇikyaṃ paśyannapidaṃ tanmāṇikyamiti na jānātītyanvayaḥ
